Kale wa Kristo ekifo, naye abalala bonna obaggalire ebweru; kubanga bw’oba ne Kristo oba mugagga, era ye akumala. Ye alikulabirira. Alikuwa buli ky’obulwa, n’oteetaaga kwesiga bantu abanafu era abakyukakyuka. Kristo abeerawo emirembe gyonna, ng’ayimiridde nga munywevu naffe okutuusa ku nkomerero.

Teweesiganga nnyo muntu omunafu era afa, ne bw’aba ayamba era nga wa mukwano; era tonakuwalanga nnyo bw’akuziyiza oba bw’akuwakanya ebiseera ebimu. Abali naffe leero bayinza okutulwanyisa enkya, n’abatulwanyisa leero ne baba naffe enkya, kubanga abantu bakyuka ng’empewo. Essuubi lyo lyonna liteeke mu Katonda; abe gw’otya era gw’oyagala. Ye alikwanukulira; ye alikukolera ekisinga obulungi.

Wano tolinaawo maka ga lubeerera. Oli mugenyi era mutambuze buli gy’oba obeera, era tolifuna kiwummulo okutuusa lw’olyegatta ddala ne Kristo.

Lwaki otunulatunula wano nga kuno si kye kifo ky’okuwummuliramu kwo? Lowooza nnyo ku ggulu, era ebintu byonna eby’oku nsi obitunuulire mu kuyita bwokka. Byonna biggwaawo, naawe wamu nabyo. Kale weegendereze oleme okubinywererako, oleme okukwatibwa mu mutego n’ozikirira. Ebirowoozo byo bisimbe ku Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, era osabenga Kristo obutayosa.

Bw’oba tomanyi kufumiitiriza ku bya mu ggulu, ebirowoozo byo bitunuulize ku kubonaabona kwa Kristo, era otunuulire n’omutima ogwagala ebiwundu bye ebitukuvu. Bw’onookyukira n’okwemalira ku Katonda ebiwundu n’enkovu ez’omuwendo eza Kristo, olifuna okubudaabudibwa kungi mu kubonaabona, tolifaayo nnyo ku kunyoomebwa abantu, era oligumiikiriza mangu ebigambo byabwe eby’obuwaayiro.

Kristo bwe yali mu nsi, abantu baamunyooma; mu kiseera eky’obwetaavu abaali bamumanyi baamwabulira, ne mikwano gye ne bamuleka mu kunyoomebwa okw’amaanyi. Yakkiriza okubonaabona n’okunyoomebwa; ate ggwe weetantala okwemulugunya ku kintu kyonna? Yalina abalabe n’abamuwaayiriza; ggwe oyagala buli muntu abe mukwano gwo era akukolere ebirungi? Obugumiikiriza bwo buliweebwa butya empeera singa tewali kizibu kibugezesa? Oyinza otya okuba mukwano gwa Kristo nga toyagala kubonaabona mu ngeri yonna? Bonaabona wamu ne Kristo era ku lwa Kristo bw’oba oyagala okufugira wamu naye.

Singa wali oyingiddeko omulundi gumu gwokka mu kukolagana okutuukiridde ne Yesu, oba n’olegako katono ku kwagala kwe okwokya, tewandifuddeyo n’akatono ku ssanyu lyo wadde ku buzibu bwo, wabula wandisanyukidde okuvumibwa kw’ogumiikiriza; kubanga okumwagala kireetera omuntu okwenyooma.

Omuntu ayagala Yesu n’amazima, omuntu ow’omunda ddala atalina kwegomba okutafugika, ayinza okukyukira Katonda buli lw’ayagala, ne yeesukkulumya ku ye kennyini, n’anyumirwa emirembe egy’omwoyo.

Oyo alega ku bulamu nga bwe buli ddala, so si nga abantu bwe boogera oba bwe balowooza, ddala mugezi n’amagezi ga Katonda okusinga ag’abantu.

Oyo ayiga okubeera mu bulamu obw’omunda n’atafaayo nnyo ku bintu eby’ebweru, tanoonya bifo oba biseera bya njawulo okukoleramu ebikolwa eby’okwemalira ku Katonda. Omuntu ow’omwoyo akuŋŋaanya mangu ebirowoozo bye, kubanga tabimalirangako ku bya bweru. Tewali mulimu gwa bweru, wadde omulimu ogutayinza kulinda, gumuziyiza. Yeetereeza ng’ebintu bwe bibaawo. Oyo ow’omutima omutereevu tafaayo ku mpisa enkyamu era ez’ekyewuunyo ez’abalala; kubanga omuntu atabulwa era n’awugulibwa kyenkana nga bw’aba yeemalidde ku bya bweru.

Kale singa byonna byali bikutambulira bulungi, era nga otukuziddwa okuva mu kibi kyonna, buli kintu kyandikuyambye okubeera obulungi era ne kikugasa. Naye kubanga tonnafiira ddala ku bubwo, era tonnasumululwa ku kwegomba kwonna okw’ensi, waliwo bingi ebitera okukunyiiza n’okukutabula. Tewali kintu kyonoona era kicaafuya omutima gw’omuntu nga okwesiba okutali kulongoofu ku bitonde. Naye bw’oneegaana okubudaabudibwa okw’ebweru, oliyinza okufumiitiriza ku bya mu ggulu, era emirundi mingi n’owulira essanyu ery’omunda.

fields.title: Obwetoowaze
fields.body_html:
TEWEERALIIKIRIRANGA olw’abo abali naawe oba abakulwanyisa, naye fuba Katonda abeere naawe mu buli ky’okola. Kuuma omuntu wo ow’omunda nga mulongoofu, era Katonda alikukuuma; kubanga obubi bw’omuntu tebuyinza kukola kabi ku oyo Katonda gw’ayagala okuyamba. Bw’oba omanyi okubonaabona ng’osirise, tolirema kulaba buyambi bwa Katonda. Ye amanyi ddi era mu ngeri ki gy’anaakununulamu; kale weewaayo mu mikono gye, kubanga kya Katonda yekka okuyamba abantu n’okubanunula mu buli nnaku.

Kitera okutuganyula abalala okumanya ensobi zaffe n’okuzitunenyeza, kubanga kituwa obwetoowaze obusingako. Omuntu bwe yeetoowaza olw’ensobi ze, akkakkanya mangu abamwetoolodde, era aggyawo mangu obusungu bw’abo abamunyiigidde.

Omwetoowaze Katonda gw’akuuma era gw’anunula; abeetoowaze b’ayagala era b’abudaabuda. Abeetoowaze abakyukira, era abawa ekisa kingi, alyoke, oluvannyuma lw’okutoowazibwa kwabwe, abasitule mu kitiibwa. Abeetoowaze abikkulira ebyama bye, era n’abayita n’ekisa bajje gy’ali. Bwe kityo, omwetoowaze aba n’emirembe wakati mu bizibu bingi, kubanga yeesiga Katonda, so si nsi. Noolwekyo tolowooza nti oliko w’otuuse mu kukula kw’omwoyo okutuusa lw’olyetwala nti oli wansi w’abalala bonna.

fields.title: Obulungi n’Emirembe mu Muntu
fields.body_html:
SOOKA obe n’emirembe mu ggwe kennyini; olwo oliyinza okuleetera abalala emirembe. Omuntu ow’emirembe akola ebirungi bingi okusinga omuntu omuyivu. Omuntu ow’omutima ogutabuse n’ekirungi akifuula kibi, era akkiriza mangu ebibi; naye omuntu ow’emirembe, kubanga mulungi yennyini, buli kintu akifuula kirungi.

Omuntu atereddwa ddala mu mutima tabaako ky’akengera, naye omwoyo ogutabuse era ogutamatidde gutawaanyizibwa okukengera kungi. Tawummula ye yennyini, era taganya balala kuwummula. Atera okwogera ebitasaana kwogerwa, n’aleka ebisaana okukolebwa nga tabikoze. Afaayo ku mirimu gy’abalala naye n’alagajjalira egigye.

Kale obunyiikivu bwo sooka obutunuulize ku ggwe kennyini; olwo oyinza n’obwenkanya okubukozesa ku abo abakwetoolodde. Oli mukugu nnyo mu kubikka ebikolwa byo n’ensonga z’otoyinza kukkiriza nga ziva mu balala; so nga kyandibadde kya bwenkanya okusinga okwesalira omusango ggwe kennyini n’owolereza muganda wo. Bw’oba oyagala abantu bakugumiikirize, naawe olina okubagumiikiriza. Laba, nga bw’oli wala n’okwagala okw’amazima n’obwetoowaze, obutamanyi kusunguwalira muntu yenna, wadde okunyiiga okuggyako ku ggwe kennyini!

Si kintu kinene okubeera n’abalungi era abakkakkamu, kubanga okubeera nabo kisanyusa mu buzaaliranwa. Buli muntu anyumirwa obulamu obw’emirembe, era asinga kwagala abantu b’akwatagana nabo mu mpisa. Naye okusobola okubeera mu mirembe n’abantu abakambwe era abakyamu, oba abatalina mpisa n’abo abatunyiiza, kisa kinene, kintu kya kutenderezebwa era kya busajja.

Abantu abamu babeera mu mirembe nabo bennyini ne bantu bannaabwe; naye abalala tebabeera na mirembe nabo bennyini, era tebagireetera muntu mulala yenna. Abo bazitoowerera buli muntu, naye basinga kuzitoowerera bo bennyini. Ate abatono, ku nkomerero, babeera mu mirembe nabo bennyini era bafuba okugizzaawo mu balala.

Kale emirembe gyaffe gyonna mu bulamu buno obw’ennaku gisangibwa mu kugumiikiriza okubonaabona n’obwetoowaze, okusinga mu butabonaabona. Oyo asinga okumanya okubonaabona alifuna emirembe egisinga, kubanga ye muwanguzi wa ye kennyini, mukama w’ensi, mukwano gwa Kristo, era omusika w’eggulu.

fields.title: Omutima Omulongoofu n’Ekigendererwa Ekimu
fields.body_html:
Omuntu asitulibwa okuva ku nsi n’ebiwaawaatiro bibiri—obwesimbu n’obulongoofu. Obwesimbu bulina okubeera mu kigendererwa kye, n’obulongoofu mu kwegomba kwe. Obwesimbu butuusa eri Katonda, obulongoofu bumuwambaatira era bumunyumirwa.

Omutima gwo bwe guba nga teguliimu kwegomba okutali mu ntegeka, tewali kikolwa kirungi kirikuzibuwalira. Bw’oba toluubirira era tonoonya kintu kirala kyonna wabula ekisanyusa Katonda n’obulungi bwa muliraanwa wo, olifuna eddembe munda.

Singa omutima gwo gwali mutereevu, buli kitonde kyandibadde gy’oli ndabirwamu ey’obulamu era ekitabo eky’okuyigiriza okutukuvu; kubanga tewali kitonde kitono era ekitalina mugaso nga tekiraga bulungi bwa Katonda. Singa munda wali mulungi era mulongoofu, wandirabye ebintu byonna bulungi era n’obitegeera mu ngeri entuufu; kubanga omutima omulongoofu guyitamu okutuuka mu ggulu ne mu ggeyeena, era omuntu nga bw’ali munda, bw’atyo bw’asalira omusango ebiri ebweru. Singa waliwo essanyu mu nsi, abalina omutima omulongoofu be balina ddala; era singa waliwo obulumi n’okubonaabona wonna wonna, omuntu ow’omunda omubi akimanyi bulungi nnyo.

Ng’ekyuma bwe kisuulibwa mu muliro ne kiggwaako obusagwa ne kyakaayakana nga kitukula, bw’atyo n’oyo akyukira Katonda ddala aggibwako obugayaavu bwe n’afuulibwa omuntu omuggya. Omuntu bw’atandika okuddirira, atya akatawaana akatono, n’asanyukira okubudaabudibwa okw’ebweru; naye bw’atandika okwewangula ddala n’okutambulira n’obuzira mu makubo ga Katonda, olwo ebintu bye yali alowooza nti bizibu nnyo edda, abiraba nga byangu.

fields.title: Ffe Ffennyini
fields.body_html:
TETUSAANYE kwesiga nnyo ffe ffennyini, kubanga ekisa n’okutegeera bitera okutubulako. Tulina ekitangaala kitono kye twazaalibwa nakyo, era ekyo tukibuza mangu olw’obulagajjavu. Emirundi mingi tetumanya nti tuli bazibe nnyo mu mutima. Mu kiseera ekyo tukola ebibi, ate ne tweyongera okukola obubi nga tubyewolereza. Ebiseera ebimu tukulemberwa okwegomba, ne tulowooza nti bunyiikivu. Tunenya abalala olw’ensobi entono, ne tubuusa amaaso ensobi ennene eziri mu ffe. Tuwulira mangu era ne tufumiitiriza ku bye tubonaabona nabyo okuva mu balala, naye tetufaayo n’akatono ku ngeri abalala gye babonaabona olwaffe. Singa omuntu yapima ebikolwa bye bulungi era mu bujjuvu, teyandisanze nsonga nnyingi ezimuleetera okusalira abalala emisango emikakali.

Omuntu ow’omunda asooka okwefaako yennyini okusinga ebirala byonna, era oyo eyeekuuma n’obwegendereza takizibuwalirwa kusirikira bya balala. Tolibeera wa mutima ogwemalidde ku Katonda okuggyako ng’osirikira bwotyo ebiri ku balala, n’ofaayo nnyo ku ggwe kennyini. Bw’onoofaayo ddala ku Katonda ne ku ggwe kennyini, by’olaba ebikwetoolodde tebirikutabula nnyo.

Ebirowoozo byo biba ludda wa nga tebiri ku ggwe kennyini? Era bw’omala okwemalira ku bintu ebingi eby’enjawulo, ofunye ki bw’oba weerabidde ggwe kennyini? Bw’oba oyagala okufuna emirembe egy’amazima mu mutima n’ekigendererwa ekimu, olina okuteeka ebirala byonna ku bbali, n’osigaza ggwe wekka mu maaso go.

Olikula nnyo mu mwoyo bw’oneekuuma nga teweeraliikirira bya nsi biggwaawo; kubanga okutwala nga kya muwendo ekintu kyonna eky’ekiseera, nsobi nnene. Tolowooza nti waliwo ekinene, ekya waggulu, ekisanyusa, oba ekikkirizibwa, okuggyako Katonda yennyini oba ekyo ekiva eri Katonda. Okubudaabudibwa okuva mu bitonde kutwale nga butaliimu, kubanga emmeeme eyagala Katonda enyooma ebintu byonna ebiri wansi we. Katonda yekka, ataggwaawo era atalina kkomo, ye akkusa byonna, ng’aleetera emmeeme okubudaabudibwa n’omubiri essanyu ery’amazima.

fields.title: Essanyu ly’Omuntu ow’Omunda Omulungi
fields.body_html:
EKITIIBWA ky’omuntu omulungi bwe bujulizi bw’omuntu we ow’omunda omulungi. Kale kuuma omuntu wo ow’omunda nga mulungi, era onoobeeranga n’essanyu bulijjo; kubanga omuntu ow’omunda omulungi ayinza okugumiikiriza bingi, era ayinza okuleeta essanyu ne wakati mu bizibu. Naye omuntu ow’omunda omubi bulijjo aba atabuse era nga atya.

Ekiwummulo kyo kinaawoomanga omutima gwo bwe gutakunenya.

Tosanyukanga okuggyako ng’okoze bulungi. Aboonoonyi tebafuna ssanyu lya munda lya mazima wadde emirembe, kubanga “Tewali mirembe eri aboonoonyi,” bw’ayogera Mukama. Ne bwe bagamba nti: “Tuli mirembe, tewali kibi kinaatutuukako, era tewali yeetantala kutukola kabi,” tobakkiriza; kubanga obusungu bwa Katonda bulisituka mangu, ebikolwa byabwe ne bifuuka bwereere, n’ebirowoozo byabwe ne bizikirira.

Okwenyumiririza mu bizibu tekizibuwalira oyo ayagala, kubanga kwe kwenyumiririza mu musaalaba gwa Mukama. Naye ekitiibwa abantu kye bawaŋŋana kya kaseera katono, era ekitiibwa ky’ensi bulijjo kigenda wamu n’ennaku. Kyokka ekitiibwa ky’abalungi kiri mu muntu waabwe ow’omunda so si ku mimwa gy’abantu, kubanga essanyu ly’abatuukirivu liva eri Katonda era liri mu Katonda, n’okujaguza kwabwe kwesigamiziddwa ku mazima.

Omuntu ayaayaanira ekitiibwa eky’amazima era ekitaggwaawo tafaayo ku kitiibwa kya kiseera; n’oyo anoonya ettutumu eriggwaawo, oba atalinyooma mu mutima gwe, tewali kubuusabuusa nti tafaayo nnyo ku kitiibwa eky’omu ggulu.

Oyo atafaayo ku kutenderezebwa wadde ku kunenyezebwa aba n’emirembe mingi mu mutima, era bw’aba n’omuntu ow’omunda omulungi, anaamatiranga mangu n’abeera mu mirembe.

Okutenderezebwa tekukwongera ku butukuvu bwo, n’okunenyezebwa tekukutoolako. Oli bw’oli, era toyinza kwogerwako nti oli mulungi okusinga bw’oli mu maaso ga Katonda. Bw’onoolowooza obulungi ku ekyo ky’oli munda, tolifaayo ku abantu kye bakwogerako. Abantu batunuulira bya kungulu, naye Katonda atunuulira omutima. Bo balowooza ku kikolwa, naye Katonda apima ekigendererwa.

Kabonero k’emmeeme ewombeefu okukola ebirungi bulijjo n’okwetwala nga si kintu. Kabonero k’obulongoofu obungi n’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi obutanoonya kubudaabudibwa mu bitonde. Omuntu atanoonya kuwolerezebwa kuva bweru, kya lwatu nti yeewaddeyo eri Katonda: “Kubanga eyeetenda yekka, oyo si ye asiimibwa,” bw’ayogera Pawulo Omutukuvu, “wabula oyo Katonda gw’atenda.”

Okutambula ne Katonda munda, n’obutabaako kwegomba kwonna okw’ebweru—buno bwe bulamu bw’omuntu ow’omunda.

fields.title: Okwagala Yesu Okusinga Byonna
fields.body_html:
ALINA omukisa oyo ategeera kye kitegeeza okwagala Yesu, era eyeenyooma ku lwa Yesu. Leka okwagala okulala kwonna ku lw’okwagala kwe, kubanga ayagala ye yekka okwagalwa okusinga byonna.

Okwagala ebitonde kulimba era tekunywera, naye okwagala Yesu kwa mazima era kwa lubeerera. Oyo eyeesiba ku kitonde aligwa wamu n’obunafu bwakyo, naye oyo eyeewaayo eri Yesu anaanywezebwanga bulijjo.

Kale mwagale; mukuume ng’omukwano gwo. Tajja kukuleka ng’abalala bwe bakola, wadde okukuganya okufa okutaggwaawo. Ekiseera kirituuka, oba oyagala oba toyagala, n’olekayo buli kintu. Kale nywerera ku Yesu mu bulamu ne mu kufa; weewaayo eri ekitiibwa ky’oyo yekka ayinza okukuyamba ng’abalala bonna balemereddwa.

Muganzi wo ali bw’atyo nti takkiriza kitali kikye—ayagala omutima gwo gube gugwe yekka, atuule omwo nga Kabaka ku bubwe. Singa wali omanyi okwesumulula ddala ku bitonde byonna, Yesu yandisanyuse okubeera mu ggwe.

Oliraba nti, awatali ye, kumpi obwesige bwonna bw’oteeka mu bantu bufa bwereere. Kale teweesiga era teweesigama ku kintu ekiri ng’olumuli olunyeenyezebwa n’empewo, kubanga “Abantu bonna bali ng’omuddo,” n’ekitiibwa kyabwe kyonna, ng’ekimuli ky’omuddo, kiriwotoka.

Olirimbibwa mangu bw’onootunuuliranga endabika y’abantu ey’okungulu yokka, era emirundi mingi olimalibwamu amaanyi bw’onoonoonya mu bo okubudaabudibwa n’amagoba. Naye bw’onoonoonya Yesu mu bintu byonna, ddala olimusanga. Era bw’otyo, bw’onoonoonya ggwe kennyini, olyesanga—okuzikirira kwo. Kubanga omuntu atanoonya Yesu yeekola akabi kanene nnyo okusinga ensi yonna n’abalabe be bonna bwe bandiyinzizza okumukola.

fields.title: Omukwano ogw’oku Lusegere ne Yesu
fields.body_html:
YESU bw’abeera kumpi, byonna biba bulungi era tewali kirabika nga kizibu. Bw’atabaawo, byonna bizibu. Yesu bw’atayogera munda, okubudaabudibwa okulala kwonna kuba kwa bwereere, naye bw’ayogera ekigambo kimu kyokka, kireeta okubudaabudibwa kungi.

Malyamu Magudaleena teyasituka mangu ago okuva mu kukaaba kwe, Maliza bwe yamugamba nti: “Omuyigiriza azze, akuyita”? Essaawa erina omukisa, Yesu mw’ayitira omuntu okumuggya mu maziga amutuuse mu ssanyu ly’omwoyo.

Ng’oli mukalu era mukakanyavu nga tolina Yesu! Ng’oli musirusiru era wa butaliimu bw’oyagala ekintu kyonna okuggyako ye! Ekyo tekiri kufiirwa kunene okusinga okufiirwa ensi yonna? Kubanga, awatali Yesu, ensi eyinza kukuwa ki? Obulamu awatali ye ggeyeena etasaasira, naye okubeera naye Lusuku lwa Katonda oluwooma. Yesu bw’aba naawe, tewali mulabe ayinza kukukola kabi.

Oyo asanga Yesu asanga eky’obugagga eky’ebbula, ddala ekirungi ekisinga buli kirungi; naye oyo amufiirwa afiirwa ekisinga ensi yonna. Omuntu abeera awatali Yesu y’asinga obwavu mu baavu, naye tewali mugagga ng’omuntu abeera mu kisa kye.

Kikugu kinene okumanya okunyumya ne Yesu, era magezi mangi okumanya okumukuuma. Beera mwetoowaze era ow’emirembe, era Yesu anaabanga naawe. Beera eyeemalidde ku Katonda era mukkakkamu, era anaasigalanga naawe. Oyinza okumugoba mangu n’ofiirwa ekisa kye, bw’oddayo eri ensi ey’ebweru. Era bw’onoomugoba n’omufiirwa, onoodduka eri ani, era ani gw’olinoonya okuba mukwano gwo? Toyinza kubeera bulungi awatali mukwano, era Yesu bw’ataaba mukwano gwo okusinga byonna, olibeera mu nnaku nnyingi era ng’oli wekka. Bwe kityo, okola kya busirusiru bw’oneesiga oba bw’onoosanyukira omulala yenna. Londa okuwakanyizibwa ensi yonna okusinga okunyiiza Yesu. Mu bonna b’oyagala, ye abeere omwagalwa wo ow’enjawulo. Ebintu byonna byagalwe ku lwa Yesu, naye Yesu ku lulwe yennyini.

Yesu Kristo y’alina okwagalwa yekka mu kwagala okw’enjawulo, kubanga ye yekka, mu mikwano gyonna, ye mulungi era omwesigwa. Ku lulwe era mu ye olina okwagala mikwano gyo n’abalabe bo kyenkanyi, era omusabe bonna bamumanye era bamwagale.

Teweegombanga kutenderezebwa oba kwagalwa kwa njawulo, kubanga ebyo bya Katonda yekka atalina amwenkana. Teweegombanga kwagala kwa muntu yenna kukussibwako ggwe, era teweemaliranga ku kwagala muntu yenna, wabula Yesu abeere mu ggwe ne mu buli muntu omulungi. Beera mulongoofu era wa ddembe munda, nga teweesibye ku kitonde kyonna.

Olina okuleeta eri Katonda omutima omulongoofu era oguggule bw’oba oyagala okussaayo omwoyo n’olaba nga Mukama bw’awooma. Ddala tolituuka ku ssanyu lino okuggyako ng’ekisa kye kikuteekateeka era nga kikusika, olyoke oleke byonna weegatte naye yekka.

Ekisa kya Katonda bwe kijja eri omuntu, ayinza byonna; naye bwe kimuvaako, afuuka mwavu era munafu, ng’alekeddwa, nga bwe kiri, mu kubonaabona. Naye mu mbeera eyo tasaanye kuggwamu maanyi wadde okuggwamu essuubi. Wabula asaanye okulindirira n’obukkakkamu Katonda by’ayagala, n’agumiikiriza buli ekimutuukako mu kutendereza Yesu Kristo; kubanga oluvannyuma lw’obutiti wajja ekyeya, oluvannyuma lw’ekiro, emisana, era oluvannyuma lw’omuyaga, okukkakkana okunene.

fields.title: Okubulwa Okubudaabudibwa Kwonna
fields.body_html:
SI kizibu okunyooma okubudaabudibwa okw’abantu nga tulina okwa Katonda. Naye kintu kinene ddala okusobola okubeera awatali kubudaabudibwa kwa Katonda wadde okw’abantu, n’okugumiikiriza n’omutima ogwagala, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, obuwaŋŋanguse buno obw’omutima, obuteenoonya mu kintu kyonna, n’obutalowooza nti olina ky’osaanidde.

Kikulu nnyo, ekisa bwe kijja, okubeera omusanyufu era eyeemalidde ku Katonda? Eyo y’essaawa buli muntu gy’ayagala, kubanga oyo ekisa kya Katonda gwe kiwanirira atambula bulungi ddala. Kyewuunyo ki bw’atawulira mugugu ng’asitulibwa Ayinzabyonna era ng’akulemberwa Omulagirizi Asinga Byonna! Kubanga bulijjo tusanyuka okubeera n’ekintu ekitubudaabuda, era omuntu yeeyambula ye kennyini n’obuzibu bwokka.

Lawrence omujulizi omutukuvu, wamu ne kabona we, yawangula ensi kubanga yanyooma buli kimu ekyalimu ekyalabika ng’ekimusanyusa, era olw’okwagala Kristo n’agumiikiriza n’obukkakkamu okuggibwako kabona asinga obukulu owa Katonda, Sixtus, gwe yali ayagala ennyo. Bw’atyo olw’okwagala Omutonzi n’awangula okwagala omuntu, era mu kifo ky’okubudaabudibwa abantu n’alonda Katonda by’asiima. Kale naawe olina okuyiga okwawukana ku mukwano gwo ow’oku lusegere era gw’oyetaaga ennyo olw’okwagala Katonda. Tokitwala nnyo ku mutima mukwano gwo bw’akuleka, ng’omanyi nti ku nkomerero ffenna tulina okwawukana.

Omuntu alina okulwana ennyo era n’obuzira ne ye kennyini nga tannayiga kwefuga ddala n’okutunuuliza okwegomba kwe kwonna eri Katonda. Bwe yeesiga yekka, adduka mangu eri okubudaabudibwa kw’abantu. Naye omwagazi wa Kristo ow’amazima, anoonya empisa ennungi n’omutima gwe gwonna, taddayo eri okubudaabudibwa, era tanoonya masanyu ga mubiri ng’ago, wabula asinga kwagala okugezesebwa okw’amaanyi n’emirimu emizibu ku lwa Kristo.

Kale okubudaabudibwa okw’omwoyo bwe kuweebwa Katonda, kufune n’okwebaza, naye tegeera nti kirabo kye so si kye wasaanira. Tojaganya, tosanyuka kisukkiridde, teweekulumbaza, wabula yeeyongere okwetoowaza olw’ekirabo, era beera mwegendereza era mwekuumi mu bikolwa byo byonna, kubanga essaawa eno eriyita, okukemebwa ne kujja oluvannyuma lwayo.

Okubudaabudibwa bwe kukuggibwako, toggwamu ssuubi mangu, naye lindirira n’obwetoowaze n’obugumiikiriza okukyalirwa okuva mu ggulu, kubanga Katonda ayinza okukuddiza okubudaabudibwa okusingawo obungi.

Kino si kipya era si kya kyewuunyo eri oyo amanyi amakubo ga Katonda, kubanga enkyukakyuka ng’eyo yatera okutuuka ku batukuvu abakulu ne bannabbi ab’edda. Bw’atyo waliwo omu, ekisa bwe kyali naye, eyagamba nti: “Bwe namala okunywera ne njogera nti, ‘Sigenda kusiguukululwa.’” Naye ekisa bwe kyamuggibwako, n’ayongerako bye yalaba mu ye: “Bwe wankweka amaaso go ne neeraliikirira.” Wakati mu ebyo taggwaamu ssuubi; wabula yeeyongera okusaba Mukama n’amaanyi, ng’agamba nti: “Ggwe gwe nnaakoowoolanga, Ayi Mukama; era Katonda wange gwe nnaawanjagiranga.” Ku nkomerero afuna ebibala by’okusaba kwe, era ng’ategeeza nti yawulirwa, agamba nti: “Mukama awulidde, era ansaasidde; Mukama afuuse omuyambi wange.” Era yayambibwa atya? “Ofudde,” bw’agamba, “okukungubaga kwange essanyu, era onneetoolodde n’ekisanyusa.”

Kale bwe kiba bwe kityo eri abatukuvu abakulu, ffe abanafu era abaavu tetusaanye kuggwamu ssuubi kubanga ebiseera ebimu tubeera na bbugumu ate ebiseera ebirala tunnyogoga, kubanga omwoyo ajja era agenda nga bw’ayagala. Ku kino Yobu, alina omukisa, yagamba nti: “Omukyalira ku makya ennyo, era omugezesa mangu ago.”

Kale nnyinza okusuubira mu ki, oba nsaanye okwesiga ani, okuggyako okusaasira kwa Katonda okunene n’essuubi ly’ekisa eky’omu ggulu? Kubanga newakubadde nga ndi n’abantu abalungi, ab’oluganda abeemalidde ku Katonda, mikwano gyange abeesigwa, ebitabo ebitukuvu, ebiwandiiko ebirungi, ennyimba ennungi n’ebitendo, ebyo byonna biyamba era bisanyusa katono nnyo nga ekisa kindese era nga nsigadde mu bwavu bwange. Mu biseera ng’ebyo tewali ddagala lisinga bugumiikiriza n’okwewaayo eri Katonda by’ayagala.

Sinnasangako muntu eyeewaayo eri Katonda era eyeemalidde ku Katonda bw’atyo nga tafunangako kiseera ekisa we kimuviirako n’awulira obunyiikivu bwe nga bukendedde. Tewali mutukuvu eyatwalibwa mu mwoyo waggulu bw’atyo era n’ayakirwa ekitangaala nga tekemebwanga nga tannaba n’oluvannyuma. Ddala tasaanira kufumiitiriza okw’ekitiibwa ku Katonda oyo atagezesebwanga mu kubonaabona ku lwa Katonda. Kubanga okukemebwa ebiseera ebisinga kabonero akakulembera okubudaabudibwa okujja oluvannyuma, era okubudaabudibwa okw’omu ggulu kusuubizibwa bonna abagezesebwa mu kukemebwa. “Oyo awangula,” bw’ayogera Kristo, “ndimuwa okulya ku muti ogw’obulamu.” Kale okubudaabudibwa okwa Katonda kuweebwa omuntu alyoke abeere omuzira okusingawo mu kugumiikiriza ebizibu, n’okukemebwa ne kujja aleme okwekulumbaza olw’ebirungi by’akoze.

Setaani teyeebaka, n’omubiri tegunnafa; noolwekyo tolekeranga ddala kwetegekera lutalo, kubanga ku ddyo ne ku kkono waliwo abalabe abatawummula.

fields.title: Okusiima Ekisa kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
LWAKI onoonya okuwummula ng’ate wazaalibwa kukola? Weemalire ku bugumiikiriza mu kifo ky’okubudaabudibwa, ku kwetikka omusaalaba gwo mu kifo ky’okweyagala.

Muntu ki mu nsi, singa yali asobola okubifuna bulijjo, ataandikkirizza mangu okubudaabudibwa n’essanyu ery’omwoyo, ebirungi ebisinga ebinyumu byonna eby’ensi n’amasanyu g’omubiri? Kubanga ago ag’oluvannyuma oba ga butaliimu oba ga kiswaza, so ng’essanyu ery’omwoyo, erizaalibwa mu mpisa ennungi era Katonda ly’afuka mu mitima emirongoofu, lye lyokka eriwoomerera ddala era ery’ekitiibwa.

Naye, okuva ekiseera ky’okukemebwa bwe kiba kumpi bulijjo, era okuva eddembe ery’obulimba ery’ebirowoozo n’okwesiga ennyo omuntu yekka bwe biri ebiziyiza eby’amaanyi eri okukyalirwa kuno okuva mu ggulu, omuntu tasobola kubyeyagaliramu bulijjo nga bw’ayagala.

Katonda akola bulungi okugaba ekisa eky’okubudaabudibwa, naye omuntu akola bubi bw’atazzaayo buli kintu eri Katonda ng’amwebaza. Bwe kityo ebirabo by’ekisa tebisobola kukulukuta mu ffe nga tetusiima Oyo abigaba, nga tetubizzaayo eri Ensulo yaabyo. Ekisa kiweebwa bulijjo oyo asiima nga bw’asaanidde, era ekyo ekitera okuweebwa abawombeefu kiriggyibwako ab’amalala.

Saagala kubudaabudibwa okunzigyako okunakuwala olw’ebibi, so sifaayo ku kufumiitiriza okuleeta amalala; kubanga si buli kya waggulu nti kitukuvu, so si buli kiwoomerera nti kirungi, so si buli kwegomba nti kulongoofu, so si buli kye twagala ennyo nti kisanyusa Katonda. Nkkiriza n’essanyu ekisa ekindeetera okweyongera okuba omuwombeefu n’okunakuwala olw’ebibi, n’okweyongera okwagala okwefiiriza.

Omuntu eyayigirizibwa ekirabo ky’ekisa, era ayiga okuyita mu kibooko ky’okukiggyibwako, talyetantala n’akatono kwetwalira kirungi kyonna, wabula alikkiriza obwavu bwe n’obwereere bwe. Ebya Katonda biwe Katonda, weetwalire ebibyo. Kale mwebaze olw’ekisa kye, naye weetikke ggwe wekka omusango n’ekibonerezo ekisaanira ensobi yo.

Bulijjo tuula mu kifo ekisembayo wansi, era ekisinga waggulu kiriweebwa ggwe, kubanga ekisinga waggulu tekiyinza kubaawo awatali ekisinga wansi. Abatukuvu abasinga obukulu mu maaso ga Katonda be abo abeetwala okuba abasinga obutono, era gye bakoma okwetoowaza munda yaabwe, gye bakoma n’okuba ab’ekitiibwa. Olw’okuba tebeegomba kitiibwa kya bwereere, bajjudde amazima n’ekitiibwa eky’omu ggulu. Nga banywezeddwa era nga bagumiziddwa mu Katonda, tebayinza n’akatono kuba na malala. Buli kirungi kye baafuna bakiwa Katonda; tebanoonya kitiibwa okuva mu bannaabwe, wabula ekyo kyokka ekiva eri Katonda yekka. Beegomba okusinga byonna nti atenderezebwe mu bo ne mu batukuvu be bonna—kino kye kigendererwa kyabwe eky’olutentezi.

Kale siima ekirabo ekisinga obutono, olyoke osaanire okufuna ekisingako obunene. Ekirabo ekisinga obutono kitwale ng’ekisinga obunene, n’ekinyoomebwa ennyo ng’ekintu eky’enjawulo. Era, bw’onootunuulira obukulu bw’Oyo agaba, tewali kirabo kinaakulabikira nga kitono nnyo oba nga tekirina mugaso. Ne bw’aba ng’agaba ebibonerezo n’emiggo, bikkirize, kubanga buli ky’akkiriza okutujjira akikola lwa bulungi bwaffe.

Oyo ayagala okukuuma ekisa kya Katonda asaanidde okusiima nga kiweereddwa, n’okugumiikiriza nga kiggyiddwawo. Asabe kikomewo; yeegendereze era abeere muwombeefu aleme okukibulwa.

fields.title: Batono Abaagala Omusaalaba gwa Yesu
fields.body_html:
YESU bulijjo alina bangi abaagala obwakabaka bwe obw’omu ggulu, naye batono abeetikka omusaalaba gwe. Alina bangi abeegomba okubudaabudibwa, naye batono abafaayo ku kugezesebwa. Afuna bangi abagabana naye ku mmeeza ye, naye batono abeetaba mu kusiiba kwe. Bonna beegomba okusanyuka naye; batono abaagala okubonaabona n’akatono ku lulwe. Bangi bamugoberera okutuuka ku kumenya omugaati, naye batono okutuuka ku kunywa ekikompe ky’okubonaabona kwe. Bangi bassaamu ekitiibwa ebyamagero bye; batono abasemberera ensonyi z’Omusaalaba. Bangi bamwagala ebbanga lyonna nga tebasisinkana buzibu; bangi bamutendereza era bamugulumiza ebbanga lyonna nga bafuna okubudaabudibwa okumu okuva gy’ali. Naye Yesu bw’akweka n’abaleka okumala akabanga, bagwa oba mu kwemulugunya oba mu kuggwaamu amaanyi ennyo. Naye abo abamwagala ku lulwe yennyini so si lwa kubudaabudibwa kwabwe bokka, bamugulumiza mu kugezesebwa kwonna ne mu kulumwa kw’omutima nga bwe bamugulumiza mu ssanyu ly’okubudaabudibwa. Ne bwe yandibadde nga tabawa kubudaabudibwa n’akatono, bandyeyongedde okumutendereza era ne beegomba okumwebaza bulijjo. Nga waliwo amaanyi mangi mu kwagala Yesu okulongoofu—okwagala okutaliimu kwenoonyeza kwonna n’okwagala omuntu kwe yeeyagala!

Abo abanoonya bulijjo okubudaabudibwa tebasaanira kuyitibwa bapangisebwa? Abo abalowooza bulijjo ku magoba gaabwe n’ebyo bye bafuna tebalaga nti beeyagala bokka okusinga Kristo? Omuntu ayagala okuweereza Katonda awatali mpeera alisangibwa wa? Kizibu nnyo okusanga omuntu ow’omwoyo ennyo ng’ayinza okweyambulako ebintu byonna. Era ani alisanga omuntu omwavu mu mwoyo ddala nga teyeesibye ku kitonde kyonna? Omuwendo gwe guli ng’ogw’ebintu ebireetebwa okuva mu nsi ezisinga okuba ewala.

Omuntu ne bw’agaba obugagga bwe bwonna, si kintu; ne bw’akola okwenenya okw’amaanyi, kitono; ne bw’afuna okumanya kwonna, akyali wala; ne bw’aba n’empisa ennungi ennyingi n’okwemalira ku Katonda okw’ebbugumu, akyabulwako bingi, naddala ekintu ekimu ekisinga okumwetaagisa. Ekintu ekyo ekimu kye kiruwa? Nti bw’amala okuleka byonna, yeeleke yennyini, yeefiirize ddala, era alekeraawo okwagala kwe kwonna okw’obwannannyini. Olwo, bw’amala okukola byonna by’amanyi nti biteekwa okukolebwa, abitwale nga si kintu, akitwale nga kitono ekyo ekiyinza okutwalibwa nga kinene; era mu mazima gonna yeeyite muddu atasaanira. Kubanga Amazima gennyini gaagamba nti: “Nammwe bwe mutyo bwe mumalanga okutuukiriza ebyo ebyabagambibwa okukola, mugambenga nti, ‘Ffe abaddu bo abatasaanira.’”

Olwo aliba omwavu ddala era nga yeeyambudde mu mwoyo, era ayinza okwogera ne nnabbi nti: “Ndi bw’omu era ndi mwavu.” Naye tewali muntu alina bugagga okusinga omuntu ng’oyo; tewali wa maanyi okumusinga, tewali wa ddembe okusinga oyo amanyi okuleka ebintu byonna n’okwetwala ng’asinga bonna obutono.

fields.title: Ekkubo ery’Obwakabaka ery’Omusaalaba Omutukuvu
fields.body_html:
ERI bangi ekigambo kino nti, “Weefiirize, weetikke omusaalaba gwo, ongoberere,” kirabika nga kizibu, naye kirisinga nnyo obuzibu okuwulira ekigambo ekyo ekisembayo nti: “Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire, mulage mu muliro ogutazikira.” Abo abawulira ekigambo ky’omusaalaba ne bakigoberera n’omutima gumu kaakano, tebeetaaga kutya nti baliwulira okusalirwa omusango ogw’okuzikirira okw’emirembe gyonna ku lunaku olw’okusala emisango. Akabonero kano ak’omusaalaba kaliba mu ggulu Mukama bw’alijja okusala emisango. Olwo abaddu bonna ab’omusaalaba, abaafuuka obumu n’Oyo Eyakomererwa nga bakyali balamu, balisemberera Kristo, Omulamuzi, nga beesiga nnyo.

Kale lwaki otya okwetikka omusaalaba ng’okuyita mu gwo osobola okufuna obwakabaka? Mu musaalaba mwe muli obulokozi, mu musaalaba mwe muli obulamu, mu musaalaba mwe muli obukuumi eri abalabe, mu musaalaba mwe muli okufukibwamu obuwoomi obw’omu ggulu, mu musaalaba mwe muli amaanyi g’ebirowoozo, mu musaalaba mwe muli essanyu ly’omwoyo, mu musaalaba mwe muli empisa ennungi esinga obukulu, mu musaalaba mwe muli obutukuvu obutuukiridde. Tewali bulokozi bwa mmeeme newaakubadde essuubi ery’obulamu obutaggwaawo okuggyako mu musaalaba.

Kale weetikke omusaalaba gwo, ogoberere Yesu, era oliyingira mu bulamu obutaggwaawo. Ye yennyini yakuggulira ekkubo ng’asitula omusaalaba gwe, era ku gwo n’afiirako ku lulwo, naawe olyoke weetikke omusaalaba gwo era oyaayaanire okugufiirako. Bw’onoofiira wamu naye, era olibeera mulamu wamu naye, era bw’onoogabana naye ku kubonaabona kwe, era oligabana naye ku kitiibwa kye.

Laba, mu musaalaba mwe muli buli kimu, era buli kimu kyesigamye ku kufa kwo ku musaalaba. Tewali kkubo ddala eridda mu bulamu ne mu mirembe egy’amazima egy’omunda okuggyako ekkubo ery’omusaalaba omutukuvu n’okwefiiriza okwa buli lunaku. Genda gy’oyagala, noonya ky’oyagala, tolisanga kkubo lisinga waggulu, newaakubadde ekkubo eritali lya waggulu nnyo naye nga lya bulabe butono, okusinga ekkubo ery’omusaalaba omutukuvu. Tegeka era olongoose buli kimu nga bw’oyagala era nga bw’olowooza, naye era olisanga nti okubonaabona okumu kuteekwa okugumiikirizibwa bulijjo, oba oyagadde oba toyagadde, era bw’otyo bulijjo olisanga omusaalaba.

Oba olirumwa mu mubiri, oba oliyita mu kubonaabona kw’omwoyo mu mmeeme yo. Ebiseera ebimu Katonda alikuleka, ebiseera ebirala abo abakwetoolodde balikutawaanya, era ekisinga obubi, emirundi mingi olyekoowa ggwe kennyini. Toyinza kudduka, toyinza kuweweezebwa ddagala lyonna wadde okubudaabudibwa kwonna, wabula oteekwa okukigumiikiriza ebbanga lyonna Katonda ly’ayagala. Kubanga ayagala oyige okugumiikiriza okugezesebwa awatali kubudaabudibwa, okumwewaayo ddala olyoke ofuuke omuwombeefu okusingawo ng’oyita mu kubonaabona. Tewali ategeera kubonaabona kwa Kristo mu bujjuvu era mu mutima nga omuntu oyo omugabo gwe kwe kubonaabona mu ngeri y’emu.

Kale omusaalaba bulijjo gweteeseteese; gukulindirira buli wamu. Yonna gy’oyinza okugenda, toyinza kuguwona, kubanga buli gy’ogenda weetwala, era bulijjo olyesanga ggwe kennyini. Kyuka gy’oyagala—waggulu, wansi, ebweru, oba munda—olisanga omusaalaba mu buli kimu, era buli wamu oteekwa okuba n’obugumiikiriza bw’oba oyagala emirembe munda n’okusaanira engule ey’emirembe gyonna.

Bw’onoositula omusaalaba n’omutima gumu, gwe gulikusitula ne gukutuusa ku kigendererwa ky’oyaayaanira, awataliba nate kubonaabona, wadde nga wano kujja kubaawo. Bw’onoogusitula nga toyagala, weetikka omugugu era ne weeyongeza obuzito, so ng’ate oteekwa okugusitula. Bw’olisuula omusaalaba gumu, olisanga omulala, era oboolyawo ogusingako obuzito. Osuubira okuwona ekyo omuntu yenna afa ky’atayinza kwewala? Mutukuvu ki eyali awatali musaalaba oba kugezesebwa ku nsi kuno? Wadde Yesu Kristo, Mukama waffe, eyalumwa okubonaabona kwe buli ssaawa gye yamala ku nsi. “Kristo kimugwanira okubonaabona, n’okuzuukira mu bafu, . . . n’oluvannyuma alyoke ayingire mu kitiibwa kye.” Kiki ekikunoonyesa ekkubo eddala okuggyako lino, ekkubo ery’obwakabaka ery’omusaalaba omutukuvu?

Obulamu bwa Kristo bwonna bwali musaalaba era kufiirira kukkiriza, naye ggwe onoonya okuwummula n’okweyagala? Weerimba, osobya bw’onoonya ekirala kyonna okuggyako okubonaabona, kubanga obulamu buno obw’okufa bujjudde ennaku era buliko emisaalaba enjuyi zonna. Mazima, omuntu gy’akoma okukulaakulana mu mwoyo, gy’akoma okusanga emirundi mingi ng’omusaalaba gweyongedde obuzito, kubanga okwagala kwe nga bwe kweyongera, n’obulumi bw’obuwaŋŋanguse bwe bweyongera.

Naye omuntu ng’oyo, wadde ng’abonyaabonyezebwa mu ngeri nnyingi, taba awatali ssuubi lya kubudaabudibwa, kubanga amanyi nti empeera ennene emujjira olw’okwetikka omusaalaba gwe. Era bw’agusitula n’omutima gumu, buli bulumi bw’okubonaabona bufuuka essuubi ly’okubudaabudibwa okuva eri Katonda. Ate era, omubiri gye gukoma okunyigirizibwa n’ebizibu, omwoyo gye gukoma okunywezebwa ekisa eky’omunda. Emirundi egitali mitono omuntu anywezebwa nnyo olw’okwagala kwe eri ebigezo n’ebizibu mu kwegomba kwe okufaanana omusaalaba gwa Kristo, n’atayagala kubeera awatali nnaku oba bulumi, kubanga akkiriza nti ajja kweyongera okusiimibwa Katonda bw’anaasobola okugumiikiriza ebintu ebizibu ennyo era ebyeyongera ku lulwe.

Kye kisa kya Kristo, so si mpisa nnungi ya muntu, ekiyinza era ekireeta nti, olw’ebbugumu ly’omwoyo, omubiri omunafu guyiga okwagala n’okufuna ekyo kye gukyawa mu butonde bwagwo era kye gwewala.

Okwetikka omusaalaba, okwagala omusaalaba, okukangavvula omubiri n’okugufuga, okudduka ekitiibwa, okugumiikiriza okunyoomebwa n’essanyu, okwenyooma n’okwagala okunyoomebwa, okugumiikiriza ebizibu byonna n’okufiirwa, obuteegomba nnaku za kweyagala ku nsi—kino si kkubo lya muntu. Bw’onoosigama ku ggwe wekka, toyinza kukola na kimu ku bino, naye bw’oneesiga Mukama, oliweebwa amaanyi okuva mu ggulu, n’ensi n’omubiri biriteekebwa wansi w’ekigambo kyo. Tolitya na mulabe wo, Setaani, bw’onooba nga weesibye okukkiriza era nga oteereddwako akabonero k’omusaalaba gwa Kristo.

Kale weeteeketeeke, ng’omuddu wa Kristo omulungi era omwesigwa, okwetikka n’obuvumu omusaalaba gwa Mukama wo, eyakomererwa ku lulwo olw’okwagala. Beera mwetegefu okubonaabona mu bizibu bingi n’emitawaana egy’engeri nnyingi mu bulamu buno obw’ennaku, kubanga obulamu bulijjo buliba bwa mitawaana era bwa nnaku, k’obe wa; era bw’otyo olibusanga buli w’oneekweka. Bwe kiteekwa okuba bwe kityo; era tewali kkubo lya kwewala bigezo n’ennaku z’obulamu okuggyako okubigumiikiriza.

Nywa ku kikompe kya Mukama n’okwagala bw’oba oyagala okuba mukwano gwe n’okuba n’omugabo wamu naye. Okubudaabudibwa kulekere Katonda; akole nga bw’asinga okusiima. Ku ludda lwo, beera mwetegefu okugumiikiriza okubonaabona era okutwale ng’okubudaabudibwa okusinga obunene, kubanga ne bw’oba ggwe wekka eyandiyise mu kwo kwonna, okubonaabona kwe tubonaabona kaakano kutono nnyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa.

Bw’olituuka ku ddaala okubonaabona we kufuukira okuwoomerera era okusiimibwa ku lwa Kristo, olwo weetwale nti oli wa mukisa, kubanga ozudde olusuku lwa Katonda ku nsi. Naye ebbanga lyonna okubonaabona nga kukunyiiza era ng’onoonya okukudduka, ebbanga eryo lyonna oliba nga tolina mukisa, era okubonaabona kw’oyagala okwewala kulikugoberera buli wamu. Singa wateeka ebirowoozo byo ku bintu by’osaanidde okulowoozaako, kwe kugamba, ku kubonaabona n’okufa, wandibadde mangu mu mbeera esingako obulungi era wandizudde emirembe.

Wadde wandibadde otwaliddwa mu ggulu ery’okusatu wamu ne Pawulo, ekyo tekyandikuwonyezza kubonaabona. Yesu yagamba nti: “Era nnaamulaga nga bw’ateekwa okubonaabona ku lw’erinnya lyange.” Kale okubonaabona kusigala nga gwe mugabo gwo, bw’oba ogenderera okwagala Yesu n’okumuweereza emirembe gyonna.

Singa wali osaanira okubonaabona akatono ku lw’erinnya lya Yesu, kitiibwa ki ekinene ekyandikuterekeddwa, ssanyu ki eddene eri abatukuvu ba Katonda bonna, kuzimbibwa ki okunene eri abo abakwetoolodde! Kubanga abantu bonna batendereza obugumiikiriza wadde nga batono abaagala okubutambuliramu.

N’olwekyo osaanidde ddala okukkiriza okubonaabona akatono ku lwa Kristo, kubanga bangi babonaabona nnyo okusingawo ku lw’ensi.

Tegeera nti oteekwa okubeera mu bulamu obw’okufa; omuntu gy’akoma okufa eri ye kennyini, gy’akoma okutandika okubeera omulamu eri Katonda.

Tewali muntu asaanira kweyagalira mu ggulu okuggyako nga yeewaddeyo okugumiikiriza ebizibu ku lwa Kristo. Tewali kisinga kusiimibwa Katonda, tewali kisinga kukugasa ku nsi kuno, okusinga okubonaabona ku lwa Kristo n’omutima gumu. Singa wali olina okulonda, wandisaanidde okwagala okubonaabona ku lwa Kristo okusinga okufuna okubudaabudibwa okungi, kubanga bw’otyo wandifaananye Kristo okusingawo era wandifaananye abatukuvu bonna. Okusaanira kwaffe n’okukulaakulana kwaffe tebiri mu masanyu mangi n’okuwummula, wabula biri mu kugumiikiriza ebizibu ebinene n’okubonaabona.

Mazima, singa waaliwo ekintu kyonna ekisinga obulungi oba ekisinga okugasa obulokozi bw’omuntu okusinga okubonaabona, Kristo yandikiraze mu kigambo ne mu kyokulabirako. Naye akubiriza lwatu abayigirizwa abamugoberera n’abo bonna abaagala okumugoberera okwetikka omusaalaba, ng’agamba nti: “Omuntu yenna ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka yeetikke omusaalaba gwe buli lunaku, angoberere!”

Kale bwe tuba tumaze okusoma n’okunoonyereza byonna ebyawandiikibwa, kino kibe kye tufundikira ekisembayo—nti kitugwanidde okuyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda nga tuyita mu bibonoobono ebingi.

fields.title: Emboozi ya Kristo ey’Omunda n’Emmeeme Ey’obwesigwa
fields.body_html:
“Nnaawulirizanga Mukama Katonda by’agamba munda mu nze.”

Alina omukisa emmeeme ewulira Mukama ng’ayogera munda mu yo, efuna ekigambo eky’okubudaabudibwa okuva mu kamwa ke. Galina omukisa amatu agakwata eddoboozi lya Katonda ery’okwogerera mpola, era agatafaayo ku kuwuuma kw’ensi eno. Mazima galina omukisa amatu agawuliriza, si eddoboozi eriwulikika ebweru, wabula amazima agayigiriza munda. Galina omukisa amaaso agazibiddwa eri ebintu eby’ebweru era agatunuulidde ebyo eby’omunda. Balina omukisa abo abayingira munda, abafuba buli lunaku okweteekateeka okusingawo n’okusingawo okutegeera ebyama. Balina omukisa abo abeegomba okuwa Katonda ebiseera byabwe, era abeesalako ebiziyiza eby’ensi.

Lowooza ku bintu bino, ggwe emmeeme yange, oggale oluggi lw’obusimu bwo, olyoke osobole okuwulira Mukama Katonda wo by’ayogera munda mu ggwe. “Nze bulokozi bwo,” bw’ayogera Omwagalwa wo. “Nze mirembe gyo era nze bulamu bwo. Beera nange ojja kusanga emirembe. Leka ebintu byonna ebiggwaawo onoonye ebyo eby’emirembe gyonna. Ebintu byonna eby’ekiseera kino kiki okuggyako emitego? Era ebitonde byonna biriyinza bitya okukuyamba singa Omutonzi akuleka?” Kale leka ebintu bino byonna, weefuule asanyusa era omwesigwa eri Omutonzi wo olyoke otuuke ku ssanyu ery’amazima.

fields.title: Amazima Gayogerera Munda Awatali Ddoboozi lya Bigambo
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

“YOGERA, Ayi Mukama kubanga omuweereza wo awulira.” “Ndi muddu wo, mpa okwawula ekirungi n’ekibi; ndyoke ntegeere ebiragiro byo . . . Okyuse omutima gwange ogulaze eri ebyo bye walagira . . . Ebigambo byo bitonnye ng’omusulo.”

Abaana ba Isirayiri lumu baagamba Musa nti: “Ggwe yogera naffe, tujja kubiwuliriza. Naye Katonda aleme kwogera naffe tuleme okufa.”

Si bwe kityo, Ayi Mukama, si bwe kityo bwe nsaba. Wabula wamu ne Samwiri nnabbi nkwegayirira n’obwetoowaze era n’omutima gwonna nti: “Yogera, Ayi Mukama kubanga omuweereza wo awulira.” Toleka Musa newaakubadde omu ku bannabbi okwogera nange; wabula ggwe yogera, Ayi Mukama Katonda, eyaluŋŋamya era eyamulisa bannabbi bonna; kubanga ggwe wekka, awatali bo, oyinza okunjigiriza mu bujjuvu, so nga bo, awatali ggwe, tebayinza kukola kintu na kimu. Mazima boogera ebigambo ebirungi, naye tebayinza kugaba mwoyo gwabyo. Mazima boogera bulungi nnyo, naye bw’osirika tebayinza kukoleeza mutima. Bo batuusa obubaka; ggwe obikkula amakulu gaabwo. Bo batuteekako ebyama, naye ggwe osumulula amakulu gaabyo. Bo balangirira ebiragiro; ggwe otuyamba okubikwata. Bo balaga ekkubo; ggwe ogaba amaanyi ag’olugendo. Bo bakola bweru bwokka; ggwe oyigiriza era omulisa emitima gyaffe. Bo bafukirira ku ngulu; ggwe ogaba okukula.

Bo baleekaana ebigambo; ggwe ogaba okutegeera eri awulira.

Kale Musa aleme kwogera nange, wabula ggwe, Mukama Katonda wange, amazima ag’emirembe gyonna, yogera nneme okufa n’okusangibwa nga sibala bibala bwe mba nga mpeereddwa magezi ga bweru gokka nga sikoleezeddwa munda; ekigambo ekiwuliddwa ne kitakwatibwa, ekimanyiddwa ne kitaagalibwa, ekikkiriziddwa ne kitagonderwa, kireme okugolokoka okunsalira omusango.

Kale yogera, Ayi Mukama, kubanga omuweereza wo awuliriza. “Ggwe wekka gw’olina ebigambo by’obulamu obutaggwaawo.” Yogera nange olw’okubudaabudibwa kw’emmeeme yange n’olw’okutereeza obulamu bwange, olw’ettendo lyo, olw’ekitiibwa kyo, n’olw’okugulumizibwa kwo okw’emirembe gyonna.

fields.title: Wuliriza n’Obwetoowaze Ebigambo bya Katonda. Bangi Tebabissaako Mwoyo
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, wulira ebigambo byange, ebigambo ebisingira ddala obuwoomi, ebisinga okumanya kwonna okw’abafirosoofo n’abagezi b’ensi. Ebigambo byange gwe mwoyo era bwe bulamu, era tebipimibwa na kutegeera kwa muntu. Tebiteekwa kukozesebwa mu butaliimu, wabula biteekwa okuwulirwa mu kusirika, n’okukkirizibwa n’obwetoowaze bwonna era n’okwagala okungi.

Omuyigirizwa

“Ayi Mukama , alina omukisa oyo gw’ogunjula, gw’oyigiriza eby’omu mateeka go; omuwummuzaako mu kabi kaalimu,” era aleme kusigala yekka mu nnaku ku nsi.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Nayigiriza bannabbi okuva ku lubereberye, era n’okutuusa leero nkyagenda mu maaso n’okwogera n’abantu bonna. Naye bangi bakakanyavu. Bangi baggala amatu eri eddoboozi lyange. Abantu abasinga obungi bawuliriza ensi n’omutima gumu okusinga Katonda. Beetegefu okugoberera okwegomba kw’omubiri gwabwe okusinga ekyo Katonda ky’asiima. Ensi, esuubiza ebintu ebitono era ebiggwaawo, eweerezebwa n’obunyiikivu bungi: nze nsuubiza ebintu ebinene era eby’emirembe gyonna, naye emitima gy’abantu ne gigayaala. Ani aweereza era angondera mu byonna n’obwegendereza bungi nga obwo ensi n’abakama baayo bwe baweerezebwamu?

“Okwatibwe ensonyi ggwe Sidoni, kubanga ennyanja eyogedde.” Era bw’obuuza lwaki, wuliriza ensonga: olw’amagoba amatono batambula olugendo luwanvu; naye olw’obulamu obutaggwaawo bangi tebasitula wadde ekigere okuva ku ttaka. Banoonya empeera entono, era oluusi balwanira mu mbuga z’amateeka mu ngeri ey’ensonyi olw’ensimbi emu yokka. Tebatya kukola emisana n’ekiro olw’akantu akatali ka mugaso oba olw’ekisuubizo ekitaliimu. Naye olw’ekirungi ekitakyuka, olw’empeera etapimika, olw’ekitiibwa ekisinga obunene n’olw’ettendo ery’emirembe gyonna, kiteekwa okwogerwa nga kibaswaza nti abantu beerema n’okukoowa okusinga obutono. Kale kwatibwa ensonyi, ggwe omuddu omugayaavu era eyeemulugunya, kubanga bo basangibwa nga banyiikira okunoonya okuzikirira okusinga ggwe bw’onyiikira okunoonya obulamu, era basanyukira obutaliimu okusinga ggwe bw’osanyukira amazima.

Oluusi mazima bye basuubira bibalema, naye ekisuubizo kyange tekirimba n’akatono, so tekisiibula oyo anneesiga ng’alina emikono emyereere. Kye nsuubizza ndikiwa. Kye njogedde ndikituukiriza, kasita omuntu asigala nga mwesigwa mu kwagala kwange okutuusa ku nkomerero. Nze ngaba empeera eri abalungi bonna, era nze nkakasa n’amaanyi abo bonna abanneemalidde.

Wandiika ebigambo byange mu mutima gwo era obifumiitirizeeko n’obunyiikivu, kubanga mu kiseera eky’okukemebwa birikwetaagisa nnyo. Ky’otategeera ng’osoma, olikiyiga ku lunaku olw’okukyalirwa. Ntera okukyalira abalonde bange mu ngeri bbiri—mu kukemebwa ne mu kubudaabudibwa. Mbasomera buli lunaku amasomo abiri—erimu nga linenya obubi bwabwe, eddala nga libakubiriza okukulaakulana mu mpisa ennungi. Oyo alina ebigambo byange n’abinyooma alina ekirimusalira omusango ku lunaku olw’enkomerero.

Okusaba olw’Ekisa eky’Okwemalira ku Katonda

Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, ggwe bulungi bwange bwonna. Nze ani ndyoke neetantale okwogera naawe? Nze muddu wo asinga obwavu era asinga okunyoomebwa, ekiwuka ekyonoonefu, omwavu era anyoomebwa okusinga nga bwe mmanyi oba nga bwe nnyinza okwetantala okwogera. Naye nzijukira, Ayi Mukama, kubanga siri kintu, sirina kintu, era siyinza kukola kintu. Ggwe wekka oli mulungi, oli mutuukirivu, era oli mutukuvu. Oyinza byonna, ogaba byonna, ojjuza byonna: omwonoonyi yekka gw’oleka n’emikono emyereere. Jjukira okusaasira kwo okunene ojjuze omutima gwange ekisa kyo, ggwe atakkiriza mirimu gyo kuba gya bwereere. Nnyinza ntya okugumiikiriza obulamu buno obw’ennaku okuggyako ng’ombudaabudira n’okusaasira kwo n’ekisa kyo? Tonkyusaako maaso go. Tolwawo kunkyalira. Tonzigyaako kubudaabudibwa kwo, emmeeme yange ereme kufuuka mu maaso go ng’ettaka ery’eddungu. Njigiriza okukola by’oyagala, Ayi Mukama. Njigiriza okubeera mu bulamu obusaanidde era obw’obwetoowaze mu maaso go, kubanga ggwe magezi gange, ggwe ammanyi mu mazima, era eyammanya na kale ng’ensi tennatondebwa era nga sinnazaalibwa mu yo.

fields.title: Tulina Okutambulira mu Maaso ga Katonda mu Bwetoowaze ne mu Mazima
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tambuliranga mu maaso gange mu mazima, era onnoonyenga bulijjo mu bwesimbu bw’omutima gwo. Oyo atambulira mu maaso gange mu mazima alikuumibwa eri okulumbibwa kw’obubi, era amazima galimununula eri abo abamusendasenda n’eri okuwaayiriza kw’abantu ababi. Kubanga amazima bwe gaba nga gakufudde wa ddembe, olibeerera ddala wa ddembe, era toofeenga ku bigambo bya bantu ebitaliimu.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, kino kye kituufu. Nkwegayiridde kibe gye ndi nga bw’oyogera. Amazima go ganjigirizenga. Gankuumenga, era gantereke nga siriiko kabi okutuusa ku nkomerero. Gannunule mu kwegomba kwonna okubi ne mu kwagala okutategekeddwa bulungi, nange nnaatambulanga naawe mu ddembe eddene ery’omutima.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Nja kukuyigiriza ebyo ebituufu era ebinsanyusa. Lowooza ku bibi byo ng’obinyiigidde nnyo era ng’onakuwadde, era tolowoozanga n’akatono nti oli muntu wa kitalo olw’ebikolwa byo ebirungi. Mazima ddala oli mwonoonyi. Ofugibwa okwegomba kungi era kukusibyeko. Bw’olekebwa wekka, bulijjo oserengeta okudda mu butaba kintu. Ogwa mangu, owangulwa mangu, weeraliikirira mangu, era omalibwamu amaanyi mangu. Tolina ky’oyinza kwenyumirizaamu, naye olina bingi ebisaanidde okukwetwaza ng’omuntu omunyoomebwa, kubanga onafuye nnyo okusinga bw’oyinza okutegeera. N’olwekyo tewabanga na kimu ku by’okola ekikulabikira ng’ekikulu. Tewabanga kintu kikulabikira nga kikulu, oba kya muwendo, oba ekyegombebwa, okuggyako ekyo ekibeerera emirembe gyonna. Amazima agataggwaawo gakusanyusenga okusinga byonna, era obutasaanira bwo obw’ekitalo bukunyiizenga bulijjo. Totyanga kintu kyonna, tokyawanga kintu kyonna, era toddukanga kintu kyonna nga bw’otya, bw’okyawa era bw’odduka empisa zo embi n’ebibi byo; ebyo bisaanidde okukunyiiza okusinga okufiirwa kwonna okw’ebintu eby’ensi.

Abantu abamu batambulira mu maaso gange nga si beesimbu. Nga basikirizibwa okwagala okumanya n’amalala, baagala okumanya ebyama byange n’okutegeera ebintu ebigulumivu ebya Katonda, ne balagajjalira bo bennyini n’obulokozi bwabwe. Olw’amalala gaabwe n’okwagala kwabwe okumanya, era kubanga mbalwanyisa, abantu ng’abo batera okugwa mu kukemebwa okunene ne mu bibi.

Tyanga emisango gya Katonda! Tyanga obusungu bw’Oyo Ayinzabyonna! Tokubaganyanga birowoozo ku bikolwa by’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, wabula weekebere ebibi byo—mu bintu ki ebikulu bye wanyiiza Katonda, n’ebirungi bimeka bye walagajjalira.

Abamu okwemalira kwabwe ku Katonda bakusitulira mu bitabo byokka, abalala mu bifaananyi, abalala mu bubonero n’ebifaananyi eby’okungulu. Abamu banjogerako n’emimwa gyabwe so nga mu mitima gyabwe sirimu nnyo. Abalala bo, nga amagezi gaabwe gamulisiddwa era nga okwegomba kwabwe kutukuziddwa, bulijjo beegomba ebintu ebitaggwaawo; tebaagala kuwulira bya nsi, era ebyetaago by’omubiri babikolako nga tebaagala. Abo bawulira Omwoyo ow’amazima by’abagambira munda mu bo: kubanga abayigiriza okunyooma eby’ensi n’okwagala eby’omu ggulu, okulekayo ensi, n’okwegomba eggulu emisana n’ekiro buli lunaku.

fields.title: Ekikolwa eky’Ekitalo eky’Okwagala kwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

NKUTENDEREZA, Ayi Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu, Kitaawe wa Mukama wange Yesu Kristo, olw’okwetoowaza n’onzijukira, nze ekitonde ekyavu. Weebale, Ayi Kitaffe ow’okusaasira era Katonda azaamu bonna amaanyi, ggwe ambudaabuda oluusi n’okubudaabuda kwo, newaakubadde nga sikisaanira. Nkutenderezanga bulijjo era nkugulumizenga wamu n’Omwana wo omu yekka n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omubudaabuzi, emirembe n’emirembe.

Ayi Mukama Katonda, Omwagalwa wange omutukuvu, bw’oliyingira mu mutima gwange, byonna ebiri munda mu nze birisanyuka. Ggwe kitiibwa kyange era ggwe ssanyu ery’omutima gwange. Ggwe ssuubi lyange, era ggwe kiddukiro kyange mu buzibu bwange. Naye olw’okuba nga okwagala kwange kukyali kunafu n’empisa zange ennungi nga tezinnatuukirira, kinsaanira okunywezebwa n’okubudaabudibwa ggwe. Kale nkyaliranga emirundi mingi, onjigirize okukangavvula kwo okutukuvu. Nnunula mu kwegomba okubi, olongoose omutima gwange mu kwegomba kwonna okutali kwa nteeko, bwe ndimala okuwonyezebwa n’okulongoosebwa munda, nsobole okusaanira okwagala, mbe n’amaanyi okubonaabona, era mbe munywevu okunyiikira okutuusa ku nkomerero.

Okwagala kintu kya kitalo, mukisa munene nnyo ddala. Kufuula buli kizibu ekyangu, era kugumira ebibi byonna bye kukolebwa nga tekutabuse. Kubanga kusitula omugugu nga tekuzitoowereddwa, era kufuula ekiwoomerevu buli ekikaawa. Okwagala okw’ekitiibwa okwa Yesu kukubiriza okukola ebikolwa ebikulu era kuzuukusa okwegomba eri ekyo ekisinga okutuukirira. Okwagala kwolekera waggulu; tekukkiriza kukkakkanyizibwa wansi na kintu kyonna ekya wansi. Okwagala kwagala okuba okw’eddembe era okweyawula ku kwegomba kwonna okw’ensi, amaaso gaakwo ag’omunda galemenga okuziyizibwa, kireme kusibibwa mu nsonga yonna ey’ekiseera kino, wadde okuwangulwa ebizibu.

Tewali kiwoomu okusinga okwagala, tewali kya maanyi okukisinga, oba ekigulumivu, oba ekigazi; tewali kisanyusa okukisinga, tewali kijjuvu okukisinga, era tewali kirungi okukisinga mu ggulu oba ku nsi, kubanga okwagala kuva eri Katonda era tekuyinza kuwummula wabula mu Katonda, ali waggulu w’ebitonde byonna.

Oyo ayagala abuuka, adduka, era asanyuka; wa ddembe, tasibiddwa. Awaayo byonna ku lwa byonna era alina byonna mu byonna, kubanga awummudde mu Kirungi ekimu eky’oku ntikko, Oyo ali waggulu w’ebintu byonna, era gy’ava buli kirungi ne kikulukuta. Tatunuulira kirabo, wabula yeesitula n’asukka ebirabo byonna, n’akyukira Oyo Agaba.

Okwagala emirundi mingi tekumanya kkomo, wabula kubooga ne kusukka ensalo zonna. Okwagala tekuwulira mugugu, tekufaayo ku bizibu, kugezaako okukola ebisukka ku busobozi bwakwo, era tekwekwasa nti tekisoboka, kubanga kukkiriza nti kuyinza era kusobola okukola byonna. Olw’ensonga eyo, kusobola okukola byonna, ne kutuukiriza ne kukola bingi, awo oyo atalina kwagala w’alemererwa n’agwa.

Okwagala kutunula. Nga kwebase, tekusumagira. Nga kukooye, tekuggwaamu maanyi. Nga kunyigirizibwa, tekufunda. Nga kutiisiddwa, tekutabuka, wabula ng’omuliro omulamu, ng’omumuli ogwaka, kwekamba ne kulinnya waggulu era ne kuyita mu buli kiziyiza nga tekulumiddwa.

Omuntu bw’aba ayagala, alitegeera eddoboozi lino. Kubanga okwegomba kuno okw’ebbugumu okw’emmeeme ddoboozi ddene erikaabirira mu matu ga Katonda, era ligamba nti: “Katonda wange, okwagala kwange, oli wange yenna, nange ndi wuwo yenna. Nnyongera okwagala, ndyoke njige okuloza n’emimwa egy’omunda egy’omutima gwange nga bwe kiwooma okwagala, nga bwe kiwooma okusaanuuka mu kwagala n’okunaaba mu kwo. Okwagala ka kuntwale. Ka nneeyimuse okusukka nze kennyini mu bbugumu eringi ne mu kwewuunya. Ka nnyimbe oluyimba lw’okwagala, era ka nkugoberere, Okwagala kwange, okutuuka waggulu ennyo. Emmeeme yange ka yeemalire mu kukutendereza, nga esanyuka olw’okwagala. Ka nkwagale okusinga bwe nneeyagala, era nneme kweyagala okuggyako ku lulwo. Mu ggwe ka njagale bonna abakwagala mu mazima, ng’etteeka ly’okwagala eryakaayakana okuva gy’oli bwe lilagira.”

Okwagala kwa mangu, kwesimbu, kwa kisa, kusanyusa era kuwoomerera. Okwagala kwa maanyi, kugumiikiriza era kwesigwa, kwa magezi, kulwawo okusunguwala, era kwa buvumu. Okwagala tekunoonya byakwo n’akatono, kubanga buli omuntu w’anoonyeza ebibye, awo w’ava mu kwagala. Okwagala kwegendereza, kwetoowaze, era kwa mazima. Tekuli kugonvu wadde okw’olusaago, era tekumalira birowoozo ku bintu ebitaliimu. Kwefuga, kwa butukuvu, kunywevu era kukkakkamu, era kukuuma obulungi ebiwulirwa byonna. Okwagala kugondera era kuwulira abakulu. Kwetwala nga kwa wansi era ekinyoomebwa mu maaso gaakwo, kwemalidde ku Katonda era kumwebaza; bulijjo kumwesiga era kumusuubira ne bw’aba nga takuwoomera, kubanga tewali kubeera mu kwagala awatali nnaku. Oyo atali mwetegefu kubonaabona mu byonna n’okwewaayo eri ebyo Omwagalwa by’ayagala tasaanira kuyitibwa muntu ayagala. Ayagala alina okwaniriza n’essanyu byonna ebizibu n’ebikaawa ku lw’Omwagalwa, era tasaanidde kumuvaako olw’ebizibu.

fields.title: Okugezesebwa kw’Omuntu Ayagala mu Mazima
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tonnaba kuba muntu ayagala omuzira era ow’amagezi.

Omuyigirizwa

Lwaki, Ayi Mukama?

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Kubanga olw’akazibu akatono olekayo ky’oba otandise, era oyanguyiriza nnyo okunoonya okubudaabudibwa.

Ayagala omuzira anywera mu kukemebwa era tafaayo ku kusendasenda okw’obukuusa okw’omulabe. Nga bwe musanyusa mu biseera eby’okweyagala, bwe ntyo ne mu bizibu simunyiiza. Ayagala ow’amagezi tatunuulira nnyo kirabo ky’Oyo amwagala, wabula okwagala kw’Oyo agaba. Atunuulira okwagala kw’Agaba okusinga omuwendo gw’ekirabo, era Omwagalwa we amuteeka waggulu w’ebirabo byonna. Ayagala ow’ekitiibwa tawummulira mu kirabo, wabula mu Nze ali waggulu wa buli kirabo.

N’olwekyo, si byonna nti bifudde, bw’owulira oluusi nga tewemalidde ku Nze oba ku batukuvu bange nga bw’oyagala. Okuwulira okwo okulungi era okuwoomu kw’ofuna oluusi kye kibala ky’ekisa ekiriwo kati, era kye kulegako okw’ennyumba yo ey’omu ggulu. Tosaanidde kukwesigamako nnyo, kubanga kujja era kugenda. Naye okulwanyisa ebirowoozo ebibi ebikulumba kabonero ka mpisa nnungi era ka mpeera nnene. Kale tokkirizanga birowoozo ebyewuunyisa okukuteganya, ne bwe biba bikwata ku ki. Nywerera ddala ku kumalirira kwo, era kuuma ekigendererwa ekituufu eri Katonda.

Si bulimba nti oluusi otwalibwa mu kwewuunya okw’omwoyo, olwo n’okomezebwawo mangu mu busirusiru obw’omutima gwo obwa bulijjo. Kubanga ebyo bibi by’obonyaabonyezebwa okusinga by’okola; era kasita bikunyiiza era ng’obirwanyisa, kifuuka ekya mpeera so si kufiirwa.

Olina okumanya nti omulabe ow’edda agezaako mu buli ngeri gy’asobola okuziyiza okwegomba kwo okw’ebirungi n’okukuggya ku buli kikolwa eky’okwemalira ku Katonda, naddala ku kussaamu ekitiibwa abatukuvu, ku kufumiitiriza okw’okwemalira ku Katonda ku kubonaabona kwange, ne ku kumalirira kwo okunywevu okweyongera mu mpisa ennungi. Akuleetera ebirowoozo bingi ebibi asobole okukukooya n’okukutiisa, bw’atyo akuggye ku kusaba ne ku kusoma ebitukuvu. Okwatula okw’obwetoowaze tekumusanyusa, era singa yali asobola, yandikulekesezza okusembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu.

Tomukkirizanga era tomuwuliranga, newaakubadde ng’emirundi mingi atega emitego okukulimba. Bw’akuleetera ebirowoozo ebibi era ebitali birongoofu, mulumirize. Mugambe nti: “Vaawo, ggwe omwoyo ogutali mulongoofu! Kwatibwa ensonyi, ggwe ekitonde eky’ennaku! Oli bucaafu bwereere okuleeta ebintu ng’ebyo mu matu gange. Genda, ggwe omusendasenzi asinga obubi! Tolina mugabo gwonna mu nze, kubanga Yesu y’aliba amaanyi gange, naawe oliswazibwa. Nandisinze okufa n’okubonaabona mu buli kibonoobono okusinga okukkiriziganya naawe. Kkakkana! Sirika! Ne bw’onandeetera ebizibu bingi, siriba na kakwate naawe. Mukama gwe musana gwange n’obulokozi bwange; ani gwe nnaatyanga? Newaakubadde ng’eggye linaasiisira okunneebungulula, omutima gwange teguutyenga, kubanga Mukama ye Mubeezi wange, era Omununuzi wange.”

Lwana ng’omuserikale omulungi, era bw’ogwa oluusi olw’obunafu, golokoka nate n’amaanyi agasinga ag’olubereberye, ng’owesiga ekisa kyange ekingi ennyo. Naye weekuume okwesiima okutaliimu n’amalala. Kubanga bangi bakyamizibwa olw’ebisobyo bino, era oluusi bagwa mu bumuzibe obunaatera okubeerera emirembe gyonna. Okugwa kw’abo abeekulumbaza nga beesiga bo bennyini kubeerenga gy’oli kulabula era ekikukubiriza bulijjo okwetoowaza.

fields.title: Ekisa Kisaanidde Okukwekebwa mu Kyambalo ky’Obwetoowaze
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

KIRUNGI era kya bukuumi okusingawo gy’oli okukweka ekisa eky’okwemalira ku Katonda, obutakyenyumirizaamu, obutakyogerako wadde okukirowoozaako ennyo, wabula okwetoowaza n’otya nti oboolyawo kiweereddwa oyo atakisaanira. Tokwatirira nnyo ku kuwulira kuno, kubanga kuyinza okukyuka amangu ne kufuuka ekikontana nakwo. Bw’oba mu kisa, lowooza nga bw’oba omwavu era ali mu bwetaavu awatali kyo. Okukula kwo mu bulamu obw’omwoyo tekuli mu kuba n’ekisa eky’okubudaabudibwa, wabula mu kugumira okukiggibwako n’obwetoowaze, n’okwewaayo, n’obugumiikiriza, oleme okuddirira mu kusaba wadde okulagajjalira emirimu gyo emirala n’akatono; wabula ku ludda olulala, kola ky’osobola okukola nga bw’omanyi obulungi, era teweerekereranga ddala olw’obukalu bwo oba olw’okweraliikirira kw’ebirowoozo.

Mazima waliwo bangi abaggwaamu amangu obugumiikiriza ne bagayaala ebintu bwe bitabagendera bulungi. Naye ekkubo ly’omuntu si buli kiseera nti liri mu buyinza bwe. Kiri mu buyinza bwa Katonda yekka okugaba ekisa n’okubudaabuda ekiseera ky’ayagala, obungi bw’ayagala, era oyo gw’ayagala, nga bwe kimusanyusa, so si okusingawo.

Abantu abamu abatafaayo, nga bakozesa bubi ekisa eky’okwemalira ku Katonda, beezikiriza bokka kubanga baayagala okukola ebisukka ku busobozi bwabwe. Tebaafaayo ku bunafu bwabwe, ne bagoberera okwegomba kw’omutima gwabwe okusinga okusalawo kw’amagezi gaabwe. Awo, kubanga beetulinkiriza mu bintu ebinene okusinga ebyo ebyasanyusa Katonda, ne bafiirwa mangu ekisa kye. Abo abaali bazimbye ennyumba zaabwe mu ggulu ne bafuuka abatalina buyambi, abagobe abanyoomebwa, abatoowaziddwa era abaavuwaziddwa, balyoke bayige obutabuuka na biwaawaatiro byabwe, wabula okwesiga ebyange.

Abo abakyali abapya era abatannaba kumanyiira kkubo lya Mukama bayinza okulimbibwa amangu ne basuulibwa, okuggyako nga beekulembera ku magezi g’abantu abeegendereza. Naye bwe baagala okugoberera ebirowoozo byabwe okusinga okwesiga abalala abasinga obumanyirivu, baliba mu kabi ak’okukoma obubi, naddala bwe batakkiriza kuggyibwa mu butaliimu bwabwe. Batono ku abo abeerowooza okuba ab’amagezi abagumira n’obwetoowaze okuluŋŋamizibwa abalala. Naye okumanya okutono okunoonyezebwa n’obwetoowaze era mu bukkakkamu kusinga obugagga obungi obw’okuyiga obunoonyezebwa mu kwesiima okutaliimu. Kirungi gy’oli okuba n’ekitono okusinga okuba n’ebingi ebiyinza okufuuka ensibuko y’amalala.

Oyo eyeewaayo yenna eri okweyagala akola eky’obusirusiru ennyo, kubanga yeerabira obutaba na buyambi bwe obw’edda, n’okutya Mukama okw’obwegendereza okutya okufiirwa ekisa ekiweereddwa. Era si muzira wadde ow’amagezi oyo aggwaamu ennyo amaanyi mu biseera eby’ebizibu n’okubonaabona, n’andowoozaako n’obwesige obutono okusinga bw’asaanidde. Oyo ayagala okubeera nga teyeeraliikirira n’akatono mu biseera eby’emirembe, emirundi mingi aliggwaamu nnyo amaanyi era alitya nnyo mu biseera eby’okugezesebwa.

Singa wali wa magezi ekimala okusigala bulijjo nga oli mwetoowaze era omutono mu maaso go, n’okuziyiza n’okufuga obulungi omwoyo gwo, toyandigudde mangu bw’otyo mu kabi ne mu kwesittala.

Omwoyo ogw’ebbugumu bwe gukoleezebwa munda mu ggwe, kirungi ofumiitirize ku ngeri gy’oliwuliramu ebbugumu eryo bwe liriggwaawo. Awo, ekyo bwe kibaawo, jjukira nti omusana gwe nkuggyeeko okumala akaseera ng’okukulabula era olw’ekitiibwa kyange guyinza okudda nate. Okugezesebwa ng’okwo emirundi mingi kugasa okusinga singa ebintu bulijjo byakugenderanga nga bw’oyagala. Kubanga ebirungi by’omuntu tebipimibwa na kwolesebwa kungi oba okubudaabudibwa, oba na kumanya Ebyawandiikibwa, oba na kuba mu kifo ekisinga eky’abalala, wabula bipimibwa n’obwetoowaze bwe obw’amazima, n’obusobozi bwe okwagala okwa Katonda, n’obunywevu bwe mu kunoonya ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu bulongoofu era mu bujjuvu, n’obutefaako bwe n’okwenyooma ddala, era okusingawo, n’okwagala okunyoomebwa n’okutoowazibwa okusinga okuweebwa ekitiibwa abalala.

fields.title: Okwetoowaza mu Maaso ga Katonda
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

NNAAYOGERA ne Mukama wange, nze enfuufu n’evvu. Bwe neerowooza okuba ekintu kyonna ekisinga kino, laba, onnwanyisa, n’ebibi byange bijulira amazima ge siyinza kuwakanya. Naye bwe neetoowaza, bwe neekkakkanya okutuuka ku butaba kintu, bwe nneewala okwegulumiza kwonna ne nneetwala ng’enfuufu gye ndi, ekisa kyo kirinkwatirwa, omusana gwo gulibikka omutima gwange, era okwegulumiza kwonna, ne bwe kuba kutono kutya, kulibbira mu buziba bw’obutaba kintu bwange ne kuzikirira emirembe gyonna.

Awo w’ondagira nze kennyini—kye ndi, kye nnali, ne kye ndigenda okuba; kubanga siri kintu, so nga saakimanya. Bwe ndekebwa nzekka, siri kintu wabula obunafu bwereere. Naye bw’ontunuulira akaseera akatono, amangu ago nfuulibwa wa maanyi era ne nzijuzibwa essanyu eppya. Kyewuunyisa nnyo nti nze, olw’obuzito bwange bwennyini abbira bulijjo wansi ennyo, nsitulibwa mangu bwe ntyo, era nwambaatirwa ggwe n’ekisa bwe kityo.

Okwagala kwo kwe kukola kino, nga kunnyweza n’ekisa, nga kunnyamba mu bwetaavu obungi bwe butyo, nga kunkuuma mu kabi kangi ak’amaanyi, era nga kunsikayo, nga bwe nnyinza okwogera mu mazima, mu bibi ebitabalika. Mazima ddala, olw’okweyagala obubi neebula; naye olw’okunoonya ggwe wekka n’okukwagala mu mazima, nzizudde nze kennyini era ne ggwe, era olw’okwagala okwo neekkakkanyizza okusingawo okutuuka ku butaba kintu. Kubanga ggwe, Ayi Mukama asinga okuwooma, onkolera okusinga byonna bye nsaanira era okusinga byonna bye nneetulinkiriza okusuubira oba okusaba.

Weebazibwe, Katonda wange, kubanga newaakubadde nga sisaanira birungi byonna, naye obukulu bwo n’obulungi bwo obutaliiko kkomo tebirekeraawo kukola birungi ne eri abo abatasiima era abali ewala naawe. Tukomyewo gy’oli, tulyoke tusiime, tube beetoowaze era abeemalidde ku Katonda, kubanga ggwe bulokozi bwaffe, obuvumu bwaffe, era amaanyi gaffe.

fields.title: Ebintu Byonna Bisaanidde Okuzzibwa eri Katonda ng’Ekigendererwa Kyabyo eky’Enkomerero
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, Nze nnina okuba ekigendererwa kyo ekisinga byonna era eky’enkomerero, bw’oba ng’oyagala ddala okuba n’omukisa. Olw’ekigendererwa kino okwegomba kwo, okutera ennyo okukyamira ku ggwe wennyini ne ku bitonde, kulirongoosebwa. Kubanga bw’onoonya ggwe wennyini mu kintu kyonna, amangu ago oddirira munda era omutima gwo ne gukala.

N’olwekyo, buli kintu kizzenga gyendi okusooka byonna, kubanga Nze nnabikuwa byonna. Lowooza ku buli kintu ng’ekiva mu kirungi ekisingayo, era n’olwekyo gyendi, ng’ensibuko yaabyo esingayo, ebintu byonna we birina okuzzibwa.

Okuva gyendi, abato n’abakulu, abaavu n’abagagga, basena amazzi ag’obulamu ng’okuva mu nsulo ennamu, era abo abampeereza n’omutima omwangu era nga beeyagalidde balifuna ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa. Naye oyo ayagala okwenyumiriza mu bintu awatali Nze, oba okusanyukira ekirungi kyonna ng’ekikye, talinywezebwa mu ssanyu lya mazima wadde okusanyusibwa mu mutima gwe, wabula alizitoowererwa era alibonaabona mu ngeri nnyingi. N’olwekyo tosaanidde kwetwaliramu kirungi kyonna wadde okugereka empisa ennungi ku muntu yenna, wabula byonna biwe Katonda, awatali ye omuntu talina kintu.

Nze nnawa ebintu byonna. Njagala byonna binzirireyo nate, era mbanja nnyo ddala okwebazibwa. Gano ge mazima agagoba okwenyumiriza okutaliimu.

Ekisa eky’omu ggulu n’okwagala okw’amazima we biyingira, awo obuggya, wadde okufunda kw’omutima, wadde okweyagala tebiibeewo. Okwagala kwa Katonda kuwangula byonna era kugaziya amaanyi g’emmeeme.

Bw’oba ow’amagezi mu mazima, onoosanyukiranga Nze nzekka, kubanga tewali mulungi n’omu wabula Katonda yekka, asaanidde okutenderezebwa okusinga byonna era okwebazibwa okusinga byonna.

fields.title: Kiwooma Okunyooma Ensi n’Okuweereza Katonda
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

KAAKANO nate nnaayogera, Ayi Mukama, era sijja kusirika. Nnaayogera nga Katonda wange awulira, Mukama wange era Kabaka wange ali mu ggulu. Ayi Mukama, nga kungi nnyo okusaasira kwo kwe waterekera abo abakwagala! Naye ggwe oli ki eri abo abakwagala? Oli ki eri abo abakuweereza n’omutima gwabwe gwonna?

Mazima ddala, okuwooma kw’okufumiitiriza kw’owa abo abakwagala kusukka ebigambo. Nze ondaze okuwooma kw’okwagala kwo, naddala bwe wantonda nga sinnabaawo, bwe wankomyawo okukuweereza nga nnali mbuze nnyo okuva gy’oli, ne bwe wandagira okukwagala.

Ayi Ensulo y’okwagala okutakoma, nnaakwogerako ki? Nnyinza ntya okukwerabira, ggwe eyasiima okunzijukira ne bwe nnali mmaze okukoozimba n’okuzikirira? Okwolesezza omuddu wo okusaasira okusukka essuubi lyonna, era omulaze ekisa n’omukwano okusukka ku by’asaanira.

Nnaakusasula ki olw’ekisa kino? Kubanga si buli muntu aweebwa okuleka byonna, okweyawula ku nsi, n’okuyingira obulamu bw’abamonaki. Kintu kinene nti nkuweereza ggwe, buli kitonde gwe kirina okuweereza? Tekisaanidde kundabikira ng’ekinene; wabula kisaanidde kundabikira ng’ekikulu era eky’ekitalo nti weetoowaza n’oyaniriza mu buweereza bwo omuntu omwavu era atasaanira bwe nti. Laba, ebintu byonna bibyo, ne bye nnina era bye nkuweerereza. Laba, eggulu n’ensi bye watonda okuweereza omuntu, biyimiridde nga byetegefu, era buli lunaku bikola buli ky’olagira. Naye ne kino kitono, kubanga ne bamalayika wabateekawo okuweereza omuntu—weewaawo okusinga bino byonna—ggwe wennyini weetoowaza n’oweereza omuntu era n’omusuubiza okumuwa ggwe wennyini.

Nnaakusasula ki olw’ebirungi bino byonna enkumi n’enkumi? Singa nnali nsobola okukuweereza ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange! Singa nnali nsobola okukuweereza nga bwe kikugwanira wadde olunaku lumu lwokka! Mazima ddala osaanira obuweereza bwonna, ekitiibwa kyonna, n’ettendo eritaggwaawo. Mazima ddala ggwe Mukama wange, nange ndi muddu wo omwavu, ateekwa okukuweereza n’amaanyi gange gonna, nga nkutendereza awatali kukoowa n’akatono. Kino kye njagala okukola—kye kyegomba kyange. Ggwe ojjuze buli ekibulamu mu nze.

Kitiibwa kinene, ekitiibwa ekisukkulumu, okukuweereza n’okunyooma byonna ku lulwo. Abo abeewaayo n’essanyu eri obuweereza bwo obutukuvu ennyo balifuna ekisa kinene. Abo abasuula eri okweyagala kwonna okw’omubiri olw’okukwagala balifuna okubudaabudibwa okusinga okuwooma okw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Abo abayingira mu kkubo effunda olw’erinnya lyo ne basuula eri okweraliikirira kwonna okw’ensi balituuka ku ddembe ddene ery’ebirowoozo.

Ayi obuweereza bwa Katonda obuwoomu era obw’essanyu, obufuula omuntu ow’eddembe mu mazima era omutukuvu! Ayi embeera entukuvu ey’obuddu bw’abeewaayo eri Katonda, efuula omuntu okwenkana ne bamalayika, asiimibwa Katonda, atiisa dayimooni, era asaanira okutenderezebwa abakkiriza bonna! Ayi obuweereza obusaanidde okwanirizibwa n’okwegombebwa bulijjo, mwe muweerwa ekirungi ekisingayo, era mwe mufunirwa essanyu eriribeerera emirembe gyonna!

fields.title: Ebyo Emitima Gyaffe bye Gyegomba Biteekwa Okwekenneenyezebwa n’Okukkakkanyizibwa
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, kikwetaagisa okuyiga ebintu bingi by’otannaba kuyiga bulungi.

Omuyigirizwa

Bye biruwa ebyo, Ayi Mukama?

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Okuteeka by’oyagala byonna wansi w’ekyo ekinsanyusa, oleme kuba eyeeyagala yekka, wabula obeere omukozi anyiikira ow’ebyo bye njagala. Okwegomba emirundi mingi kukwokya ne kukusindiikiriza ng’omulalu; naye fumiitiriza obanga okola olw’ekitiibwa kyange oba olw’amagoba go ggwe. Bwe mba nze ensonga, ojja kumatira n’ekyo kyonna kye nnaalagira. Naye bwe wabaawo okwenoonyeza ebibyo okukwekeddwamu, kwe kukweraliikiriza ne kukuzitoowereza. Kale weegendereze oleme okwesigama ennyo ku kwegomba kw’oteeseteese nga tonneebuuzizza ku Nze, oleme okwejjusa oluvannyuma n’otasanyukira kye wasooka okusanyukira, kye wayagala ng’okiraba ng’ekisinga obulungi. Si buli kwegomba okulabika obulungi kwe kulina okugobererwa amangu ago; era si buli kwagala okukontana nakwo kwe kulina okusuulibwa amangu ago.

Oluusi kirungi okwekomako katono ne mu kwegomba okulungi n’ebyo omutima bye gwagala, oleme olw’okuyaayaana okuyitiridde okweretera okutaataaganyizibwa mu birowoozo; oleme olw’obuteefuga bwo okuleetera abalala okwesittala; oba oleme okutabulwa amangu ago n’ogwa olw’abalala abakuziyiza. Naye oluusi oteekwa okukozesa amaanyi n’olwanyisa n’obuvumu okwegomba kw’omubiri. Tofaayo ku mubiri kye gwagala oba kye gutayagala, naye fubanga gufugibwe omwoyo, ne bwe kiba nga kya maanyi. Era gulina okukangavvulwa n’okukakibwa okusigala nga gufugibwa, okutuusa lwe gunaaba nga gwetegefu ku buli kintu, era nga guyigiridde okumatira ne kitono, okusanyukira ebintu ebyangu, n’obuteemulugunya olw’ebitali bya ssanyu.

fields.title: Okufuna Obugumiikiriza mu Kulwanyisa Okwegomba kw’Omubiri
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

OBUGUMIIKIRIZA, Ayi Mukama Katonda, ndaba nga bunneetaagisa nnyo, kubanga mu bulamu buno mulimu ebizibu bingi. Ne bwe nteekateeka ntya okufuna emirembe gyange, obulamu bwange tebuyinza kuba nga tebulimu kulwana na nnaku.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Mwana wange, oli mutuufu; naye kye njagala si kwe kunoonya emirembe egitaliimu kukemebwa oba egitasisinkana kuziyizibwa, wabula olowooze nti ozudde emirembe ng’omaze okubonyaabonyezebwa mu kubonaabona kungi n’okugezesebwa mu bizibu bingi.

Bw’ogamba nti tosobola kugumira bingi, olwo oligumira otya omuliro gwa purgatoriyo? Ku bibi bibiri, bulijjo kirondwa ekisinga obutono. Noolwekyo, olw’okuwona ebibonerezo ebitaggwaawo ebigenda okujja, fuba okugumiikiriza ebibi ebiriwo kaakano ku lwa Katonda.

Olowooza nti abantu b’ensi tebalina kubonaabona, oba nti kutono kwokka? Buuza n’abo abasinga okweyagala, ojja kuzuula nti si bwe kiri. “Naye,” ojja kugamba, “balina amasanyu mangi era bakola bye baagala; noolwekyo ebizibu byabwe tebabiwulira nnyo.” Kale ka tugambe nti balina buli kye baagala; olowooza kinaamala bbanga ki? Laba, abo abagaggawalira mu nsi baliggwaawo ng’omukka, era essanyu lyabwe eryayita teririjjukirwa. Ne mu bulamu buno tebafuna kiwummulo mu masanyu gano nga tegatabuddwamu bukaawu, kukoowa n’okutya. Kubanga emirundi mingi ekintu kyennyini kye balowooza nti kye kibaleetera essanyu, kye kibaleetera ekibonerezo eky’ennaku. Era kino kya bwenkanya: nga bwe banoonya era ne bagoberera amasanyu awatali magezi, tebasaanidde kugeyagaliramu awatali nsonyi na bukaawu.

Amasanyu gano gonna nga ga kaseera katono, nga ga bulimba, nga tegalina magezi era nga ga nsonyi! Naye abantu, nga bazibye amaaso ng’abatamiivu, tebakitegeera, wabula ng’ensolo ezitalina magezi, beereetera okufa kw’emmeeme olw’okweyagalira akatono mu bulamu obuvunda.

Noolwekyo, mwana wange, togobereranga kwegomba kwo okubi, era weewale by’oyagala ggwe. “Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga.” Bw’oba oyagala okusanyuka ddala n’okubudaabudibwa ennyo okuva gye ndi, laba, mu kunyooma ebintu byonna eby’ensi ne mu kwesalako amasanyu gonna ag’ensonyi mw’onoosanga omukisa gwo, era ojja kuweebwa okubudaabudibwa okungi. Era gy’onookoma okwewala okubudaabudibwa kwonna okuva mu bitonde, gy’onookoma okusanga mu Nze okubudaabudibwa okusinga okuwooma n’okuba okw’amaanyi.

Mu kusooka tojja kufuna mikisa gino awatali nnaku, kutegana n’okulwana. Empisa gy’omaze okukwata ejja kukuziyiza, naye ejja kuwangulwa empisa esinga obulungi. Omubiri gujja kukwemulugunyiza, naye gujja kuzibirwa n’obunyiikivu bw’omwoyo. Omusota ogw’edda gujja kukubojja n’okukutawaanya, naye okusaba kujja kugugoba, era olw’okukola n’obunyiikivu obw’omugaso, ekkubo lijja kuguggalirwawo.

fields.title: Obuwulize bw’Oyo Agonda mu Bwetoowaze ng’Agoberera Ekyokulabirako kya Yesu Kristo
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, oyo agezaako okwewala obuwulize yeeggya mu kisa. Era n’oyo eyeenoonyeza ebirungi bye yekka afiirwa ebyo bonna bye bagabana. Oyo ateegondeza mukulu we ku bubwe era n’omutima omwangu, alaga nti omubiri gwe tegunnamuwulira mu bujjuvu, wabula emirundi mingi gumujeemera ne gumwemulugunyiza.

Kale yiga mangu okugondera omukulu wo bw’oba oyagala okuwangula omubiri gwo. Kubanga omulabe ow’ebweru awangulwa mangu singa omuntu ow’omunda tazikiriziddwa. Tewali mulabe w’emmeeme asinga kukutawaanya era asinga obubi okukira ggwe wennyini, bw’oba nga tokkiriziganya na mwoyo. Kikwetaagisa ddala okwenyooma mu mazima bw’oba oyagala okuwangula omubiri n’omusaayi.

Olw’okuba okyeyagala ekisukkiridde, otya okwewaayo ddala eri okwagala kw’abalala. Kya kitalo nnyo ggwe, ali enfuufu era atali kintu, okwegondeza omuntu ku lwa Katonda, so nga Nze, Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna, Ali Waggulu Ennyo, eyatonda ebintu byonna nga tewali kintu, neegondeza omuntu mu bwetoowaze ku lulwo? Nnafuuka asinga okwetoowaza era asinga okuba owa wansi mu bantu bonna, olyoke owangule amalala go olw’obwetoowaze bwange.

Yiga okuwulira, ggwe ali enfuufu obufuufu! Yiga okwetoowaza, ggwe ali ettaka n’ebbumba, weekakkanye wansi w’ebigere bya buli muntu! Yiga okumenya by’oyagala ggwe, n’okugondera buli bufuge! Beera mukambwe gy’oli ggwe kennyini! Tokkiriza malala gonna kubeera mu ggwe, naye weeyoleke nga oli mwetoowaze era wa wansi nnyo, bonna bakutambulireko era bakulinnyirire ng’enfuufu mu nguudo!

Ggwe omuntu ataliimu, olina kiki eky’okwemulugunya? Ggwe omwonoonyi omubi, onoddamu ki abo abakuvunaana, ggwe eyanyiiza Katonda emirundi mingi bwe zityo, n’osaanira ggeyeena emirundi emingi? Naye eriiso lyange lyakusaasira kubanga emmeeme yo yali ya muwendo mu maaso gange, olyoke omanye okwagala kwange era osiimenga bulijjo olw’ebirungi bye nkukolera, olyoke weewengayo bulijjo mu bugonvu obw’amazima n’obwetoowaze, era ogumiikirizenga okunyoomebwa.

fields.title: Fumiitiriza ku Misango gya Katonda Egyekusifu, Oleme Okwekulumbaza olw’Ebikolwa Byo Ebirungi
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

GGWE olangirira emisango gyo ku nze ng’eggulu bwe libwatuka, Ayi Mukama. Osagasagaza amagumba gange gonna n’entiisa n’okukankana, era emmeeme yange etidde nnyo. Nnyimirira nga nkwatiddwa ensisi bwe ndowooza nti eggulu si ttukuvu mu maaso go. Obanga wasanga obubi mu bamalayika n’otobasaasira, nze nnaaba ntya? Emmunyeenye zaagwa okuva mu ggulu, ate nze — nze ali enfuufu obufuufu — nnyinza ntya okwekulumbaza? Abo abaalabikanga ng’ebikolwa byabwe bisaanira ettendo bagudde mu buziba, era ndabye abo abaalyanga emmere ya bamalayika nga beesanyusa n’ebikuta by’embizzi.

Kale tewali butukuvu bw’oggyayo omukono gwo, Ayi Mukama. Tewali magezi bw’olekera awo okulungamya, tewali buvumu bw’olekera awo okukuuma. Tewali bulongoofu bwa mubiri bunywevu bw’otobukuuma. Okutunula kwaffe tekugasa bwe kutakuumibwa kutunula kwo okutukuvu. Bwe tulekebwa fekka tubbira ne tuzikirira, naye bw’otukyalira tusitulibwa ne tuba balamu. Mazima tetuli banywevu, naye ggwe otunyweza. Tufuuka ab’ekibuguumirize, naye ggwe otukoleezaamu omuliro.

Ayi, nga nsaanidde okwetwala ng’owa wansi era atali wa kitiibwa! Nga sisaanidde kutwala nga kya muwendo ekintu kyonna ekirabika ng’ekirungi mu nze! Nga nsaanidde okwewaayo wansi ddala eri emisango gyo egitanoonyezeka, Ayi Mukama, mwe nneesanga nga siri kintu!

Ayi obuzito obutapimika! Ayi ennyanja etasomokeka, mwe nneesanga nga siri kintu kirala wabula obutaba kintu bwereere! Kale ekitiibwa kyekweka wa? Obwesige bwonna mu mpisa zange ennungi buyinza kuva wa? Okwenyumiriza kwonna okutaliimu kumiriddwa mu buziba bw’emisango gyo ku nze.

Omubiri gwonna kye ki mu maaso go? Ebbumba liyinza okwenyumiriza okwolekera oyo eyalibumba? Oyo omutima gwe ogugondera Katonda mu mazima ayinza atya okwegulumiza olw’ekitiibwa ekitaliimu? Ensi yonna terimuleetera malala oyo amazima gwe gaafuga ne gamufuula owaago. Era oyo eyateeka essuubi lye lyonna mu Katonda tajja kuwuguka olw’ennimi z’abawaanyi. Kubanga laba, n’abo aboogera si kintu; bajja kuggwaawo awamu n’eddoboozi ly’ebigambo byabwe, naye amazima ga Mukama gabeerera emirembe gyonna.

fields.title: Engeri Omuntu gy’Asaanidde Okuwulira n’Okwogera ku Buli Kintu Ekyegombebwa
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, bw’oti bw’olina okwogeranga buli lwe kibaawo: “Ayi Mukama, bwe kiba nga kikusanyusa, kibeere bwe kityo. Bwe kiba nga kya kitiibwa kyo, Ayi Mukama, kikolebwe mu linnya lyo. Ayi Mukama, bw’oba olaba nga kinsaanira era nga kya mugaso gye ndi, kale nzikiriza nkikozese olw’ekitiibwa kyo. Naye bw’oba omanyi nti kijja kunkola bubi, era nga tekirina kirungi kye kigasa obulamu bw’emmeeme yange, kale nzigyako okwegomba kuno.”

Si buli kwegomba nti kuva eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne bwe kuba nga kulabika nga kutuufu era kulungi. Kizibu okumanya obanga mwoyo mulungi oba mubi oguleetera omuntu okukola kino oba kiri, era n’okumanya obanga otambuzibwa mwoyo gwo ggwe kennyini. Bangi abaalabika mu kusooka ng’abakulemberwa omwoyo omulungi baalimbibwa ku nkomerero.

Kyonna ebirowoozo kye birabamu ekirungi, kisabe era kyegombe ng’otya Katonda era n’omutima omwetoowaze. Okusinga byonna, ensonga yonna gikwasizenga Nze ng’owaayo ddala by’oyagala, ogambe nti: “Ayi Mukama, ggwe omanyi ekisinga okunsaanira; kino kikolebwe oba kiri kikolebwe nga bw’oyagala. Mpa ky’oyagala, ekigero ky’oyagala, ekiseera ky’oyagala. Nkolera nga bw’omanyi nti kye kisinga, nga bwe kinaakusanyusa ennyo, era nga bwe kinaaleeta ekitiibwa kyo ekisingako. Nteeka w’oyagala era onkolere nga bw’oyagala mu byonna. Ndi mu mukono gwo; onkyuse gy’oyagala yonna. Laba, ndi muddu wo, nneetegese okuwulira mu byonna. Seegomba kubeera mulamu ku lwange nze, wabula ku lulwo — singa nnali nsobola okukikola nga bwe kisaanidde era mu bujjuvu!”

Okusaba olw’Okwagala kwa Katonda Kukolebwe

Mpa ekisa kyo, Ayi Yesu asinga okusaasira, kibeerenga nange, kikolere wamu nange, era kisigale nange okutuusa ku nkomerero ddala. Mpa bulijjo okwegomba n’okwagala ekyo ekisinga okukkirizibwa gy’oli n’okukusanyusa. Okwagala kwo kubeere kwange. Okwagala kwange kugoberere bulijjo okwagala kwo era kukkiriziganye nakwo ddala. Okwagala kwange kubeere kumu n’okwo mu kwagala ne mu butayagala, era nneme kusobola kwagala oba obutayagala kintu kyonna okuggyako ky’oyagala oba ky’otoyagala. Mpa nfe eri ebintu byonna eby’ensi, era ku lulwo njagale okunyoomebwa n’obutamanyibwa mu bulamu buno. Okusinga okwegomba kwonna, mpa okwegomba okuwummulira mu ggwe, era mu ggwe omutima gwange gubeere n’emirembe. Ggwe mirembe gya mazima egy’omutima. Ggwe wekka kiwummulo kyagwo. Awatali ggwe, ebintu byonna bizibu era bitabuddwa. Mu mirembe gino, gyennyini egiri mu ggwe, Ali Waggulu Ennyo, Omulungi ow’emirembe n’emirembe, nnaagalamira ne nneebaka. Amiina.
