fields.title: Okubudaabudibwa okw’Amazima Kulina Okunoonyezebwa mu Katonda Yekka
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

KYONNA kye nnyinza okwegomba oba okulowooza olw’okubudaabudibwa kwange, sikinoonya wano wabula mu bulamu obugenda okujja. Kubanga singa nze nzekka nnali na byonna ebibudaabuda eby’ensi era nga nsobola okweyagalira mu masanyu gaayo gonna, kya mazima nti tebyandisobodde kubeerawo bbanga ddene. Noolwekyo, emmeeme yange, tosobola kufuna kubudaabudibwa kujjuvu oba essanyu eryatuukirira okuggyako mu Katonda, Omubudaabuzi w’abaavu era Omuyambi w’abeetoowaze. Lindako katono, emmeeme yange, linda ekisuubizo kya Katonda, era ojja kuba n’ebirungi byonna mu bungi mu ggulu. Bw’oyegomba ennyo ebintu bino ebiriwo kaakano, ojja kufiirwa ebyo ebitaggwaawo era eby’omu ggulu. Kozesa ebintu eby’akaseera, naye yegomba ebintu ebitaggwaawo. Tosobola kumatira na birungi byonna eby’akaseera, kubanga tewatondebwa kubyeyagaliramu.

Ne bw’oba nga wandibadde n’ebintu byonna ebyatondebwa, tewandisobodde kuba musanyufu era wa mukisa; kubanga mu Katonda, eyatonda ebintu bino byonna, mwe muli omukisa gwo gwonna n’essanyu lyo — si ssanyu ng’eryo erirabibwa era eritenderezebwa abaagala ensi, wabula ng’eryo abaddu ba Kristo abalungi era abeesigwa lye balindirira, era abo ab’omwoyo n’abalongoofu mu mutima, obutaka bwabwe obuli mu ggulu, lye balegako oluusi.

Okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’abantu kwa butaliimu era kwa kaseera katono. Naye okwo okufunibwa munda okuva eri Amazima kwa mukisa era kwa mazima. Omuntu eyeemalidde ku Katonda atambula n’Omubudaabuzi we, Yesu, buli gy’alaga, era amugamba nti: “Beera nange, Mukama Yesu, mu buli kifo ne mu biseera byonna. Kino kibe okubudaabudibwa kwange: okukkiriza okwefiiriza okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’abantu. Era bwe mbulwa okubudaabudibwa kwo, by’oyagala n’okungezesa kwo okw’obwenkanya bibe okubudaabudibwa kwange okusinga. Kubanga tosibenga busungu ku mwoyo bulijjo, era tootiisetiisenga emirembe gyonna.”

fields.title: Okweraliikirira Kwaffe Kwonna Kulina Okukwasibwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, nzikiriza nkukole kye njagala. Nze mmanyi ekisinga okukugasa. Olowooza ng’omuntu; mu bintu bingi owulira nga okwagala kw’obuntu bwe kukusikiriza.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, ky’oyogera kya mazima. Okunfaako kwo kusinga okwefaako kwonna kwe nnyinza okukola. Kubanga oyo atakukwasa byonna by’aweraliikirira ayimiridde mu kabi nnyo. Kasita okwagala kwange kusigala nga kutuufu era nga kunywevu gy’oli, Ayi Mukama, nkolera kyonna ekikusanyusa. Kubanga kyonna ky’onookola nange tekiyinza kuba kirala okuggyako ekirungi.

Bw’oba oyagala mbeere mu kizikiza, nnaakutenderezanga. Era bw’oba oyagala mbeere mu kitangaala, era nnaakutenderezanga. Bw’okka okumbudaabuda, nnaakutenderezanga, era bw’oba oyagala mbonyaabonyezebwe, nnaakutenderezanga emirembe gyonna.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Mwana wange, guno gwe mutima gw’olina okuba nagwo bw’oba oyagala okutambula nange. Olina okuba nga weetegefu okubonaabona nga bw’oli okusanyuka. Olina okukkiriza n’omutima omwangu okuba omwavu era atalina kantu nga bw’okkiriza okuba omugagga era omukkufu.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, nnaabonaabonanga n’omutima omwangu ku lulwo kyonna ky’oyagala okumpeereza. Ndi mwetegefu okukkiriza okuva mu mukono gwo ebirungi n’ebibi kyenkanyi, ebiwoomu n’ebikaawa wamu, ennaku awamu n’essanyu; era olwa byonna ebintuukako nkwebaza. Nkuuma mu kibi kyonna, era sijja kutya kufa wadde ggeyeena. Tonsuula wala emirembe gyonna, era tonsangula mu kitabo ky’obulamu, olwo okubonaabona kwonna okunantuukako tekujja kunkola kabi.

fields.title: Okubonaabona okw’Akaseera Kulina Okugumiikirizibwa, nga Tugoberera Ekyokulabirako kya Kristo
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, nnava mu ggulu ne nzika olw’obulokozi bwo, ne nneetikka ennaku zo, si lwa kuba nti nnali nkakibwa, wabula olw’okwagala, olyoke oyige okugumiikiriza n’okugumira okubonaabona kw’obulamu buno awatali kwemulugunya. Okuva lwe nnazaalibwa okutuusa lwe nnafiira ku musaalaba, okubonaabona tekwanvaako. Nnabulwa nnyo ebintu eby’akaseera. Emirundi mingi nnawulira okwemulugunya kungi okunnwanyisa. Okuswazibwa n’okuvumibwa nnabigumiikiriza. Olw’ebirungi bye nnakola nnasasulwa obuteebaza, olw’ebyamagero byange nnavvoolebwa, era olw’okuyigiriza kwange nnanyoomebwa.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, olw’okuba wali mugumiikiriza mu bulamu bwo, okusingira ddala mu kutuukiriza ekigendererwa kya Kitaffe, kinsaanira nze, omwonoonyi asinga okuba ow’ennaku, okubeera omulamu n’obugumiikiriza nga bw’oyagala, era, okumala ebbanga lyonna ly’onooyagala, okwetikka omugugu gw’omubiri guno ogwonooneka olw’obulamu obulungi obw’emmeeme yange. Kubanga newaakubadde obulamu buno obwa kaakano bulabika nga buzitowa, naye olw’ekisa kyo bufuuka obw’empeera, era bufuulibwa obw’ekitangaala era obugumiikirizika eri abanafu olw’ekyokulabirako kyo n’amakubo g’abatukuvu. Era bulimu okubudaabudibwa okusinga okw’edda mu mateeka ag’edda, emiryango gy’eggulu bwe gyali nga giggaddwa, ekkubo eridda eyo bwe lyali nga lirabika nga lya kizikiza okusinga kaakano, era nga batono nnyo abaafangayo okunoonya obwakabaka obutaggwaawo. Abatuukirivu, abalonde, tebaasobola kuyingira mu ggulu ng’okubonaabona kwo n’okufa kwo okutukuvu tebinnasasula bbanja.

Ayi, nga nnina okukwebaza ennyo, ggwe eyandaga nze n’abeesigwa bonna ekkubo eddungi era ettuufu erigenda mu bwakabaka bwo obutaggwaawo! Obulamu bwo lye kkubo lyaffe, era mu bugumiikiriza bwo obutukuvu tukusemberera ggwe engule yaffe. Singa tewasooka kugenda mu maaso n’otuyigiriza, ani yandifuddeyo okugoberera? Woowe, bangi nga bandisigadde emabega wala, singa tebaalina mu maaso gaabwe kyokulabirako kyo ekitukuvu! Laba, ne ffe abaawulira ebyamagero byo n’okuyigiriza kwo okungi tukyali ba kibuguumirize; kale kyandibadde kitya singa tetwalina kitangaala kyenkana awo kye tugoberera nga tukugoberera?

fields.title: Obugumiikiriza obw’Amazima mu Kubonaabona
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

KIKI ky’oyogera, mwana wange? Lowooza ku kubonaabona kwange n’okw’abatukuvu, olekere awo okwemulugunya. Tonnalwanagana okutuusa ne kukuyiwa omusaayi. By’obonaabona bitono nnyo bw’obigeraageranya n’ebinene abo bye baabonaabona, abaakemebwa ennyo bwe batyo, abaatawaanyizibwa ennyo, abaagezesebwa era ne babonyaabonyezebwa mu ngeri nnyingi. Kale kirungi ojjukire ennaku ez’amaanyi ez’abalala, olyoke ogumire ezizo entono nga tekikuzibuwalira nnyo. Era bwe zitakulabikira nga ntono, wekkaanye obanga si butagumiikiriza bwo bwe buzifuula okulabika ng’ennene; era ne bwe ziba nnene oba ntono, fuba okuzigumiikiriza zonna. Gy’onookoma okwetegekera okubonaabona, gy’onookoma okukola n’amagezi, era n’empeera gy’osuubiziddwa gy’enookoma okuba ennene. Bw’otyo onoobonaabonanga nga tekikuzibuwalira singa ebirowoozo byo n’empisa zo bitendekebwa n’obunyiikivu mu kino.

Togambanga nti: “Sisobola kugumira kino okuva ku muntu oyo, era sisaanidde kubonaabona bintu bya ngeri eno, kubanga ankoze ekibi kinene. Anvunaanye ebintu bingi bye sirowoozangako n’akatono. Naye okuva ku muntu omulala nnaagumiikiriza n’essanyu ebyo byonna bye ndowooza nti nsaanidde okugumira.”

Ekirowoozo ng’ekyo kya busirusiru, kubanga tekifaayo ku mpisa ya bugumiikiriza oba ku Oyo aligisasula, wabula kipima omuntu n’ekisobyo ekikoleddwa. Omuntu ayagala kubonaabona ebyo byokka ebimulabikira ng’ebirungi, era akkiriza okubonaabona okuva eri abo bokka b’ayagala, tali mugumiikiriza ddala. Kubanga omuntu omugumiikiriza ddala tafaayo okubonaabona kuva wa — oba eri omukulu we, oba eri munne bwe benkana, oba eri ali wansi we, oba eri omuntu omulungi era omutukuvu oba eri omukyamu era atasaanira; naye ne bwe kiba kizibu kinene kyenkana wa ekimutuukako, ne bwe kiba kimujjira emirundi emeka, oba ne bwe kiva eri ani, akikkiriza n’okwebaza ng’akiggya mu mukono gwa Katonda, era akitwala ng’amagoba amangi. Kubanga eri Katonda tewali kibonaabonebwa ku lulwe, ne bwe kiba kitono kyenkana wa, ekiyinza okuyita awatali mpeera. Kale weetegekere olutalo, bw’oba oyagala okuwangula. Awatali kulwana tosobola kufuna ngule ya bugumiikiriza, era bw’ogaana okubonaabona oba ogaana engule. Naye bw’oba oyagala okutikkirwa engule, lwana n’obuvumu era gumiikiriza. Awatali kutegana tewali kiwummulo, era awatali kulwana tewali buwanguzi.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, ekyo ekirabika ng’ekitasoboka gye ndi mu buzaaliranwa kisoboke olw’ekisa kyo. Omanyi nti nsobola okubonaabona kitono nnyo, era nti nzigwamu amaanyi mangu buli lwe wajjawo ekizibu ekitono. Okubonyaabonyezebwa mu kubonaabona olw’erinnya lyo kumbeerere kwa ssanyu era kwegombebwe, kubanga okubonaabona n’okutawaanyizibwa ku lulwo kugasa nnyo emmeeme yange.

fields.title: Okwatula Obunafu Bwaffe mu Nnaku z’Obulamu
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

NNAAWA obujulirwa nga nneerumiriza olw’obutali butuukirivu bwange, era gy’oli, Ayi Mukama, nnaayatula obunafu bwange.

Emirundi mingi kintu kitono ekinzigwamu amaanyi ne kinnakuwaza. Nteesa okukola n’obuvumu, naye ne bwe wajja okukemebwa okutono, nneesanga mu buzibu bunene. Oluusi ekintu ekitali kya nsonga n’akatono kye kireeta okukemebwa okw’amaanyi. Bwe ndowooza nti ndi mu bukuumi, era nga sikisuubira, emirundi mingi nneesanga kumpi nga mpanguddwa embuyaga entono. Kale, Ayi Mukama, tunuulira embeera yange eya wansi n’obunafu bwange by’omanyi obulungi ennyo. Onsaasire. Onnyinyulule mu ttosi nneme okutubira, era nneme okusigala emirembe gyonna nga nnennyamivu ddala.

Okuba nti ngwa mangu bwe ntyo era nga ndi munafu bwe ntyo okulwanyisa okwegomba kwange, kunzitoowerera emirundi mingi ne kunswaza mu maaso go. Newaakubadde nga sikkiriziganya nakwo ddala, naye okulumba kwakwo kunteganya nnyo era kunnuma, era kinkooya nnyo okubeera bwe ntyo mu lutalo buli lunaku. Kyokka obunafu bwange bweyoleka gye ndi mu kuba nti ebirowoozo eby’omuzizo binjuumuukirira mangu nnyo okusinga bwe binvaako.

Ayi, singa ggwe, Katonda wa Isirayiri ow’amaanyi ennyo, Omwagazi ow’obuggya ow’emmeeme ezeesigwa, otunuulira okutegana n’ennaku y’omuddu wo, n’omuyamba mu byonna by’akola! Nnyweza n’obuvumu obw’omu ggulu, omuntu ow’ebweru, omubiri ogw’ennaku, gwe nteekwa okulwanyisa ebbanga lyonna lye nkyassa omukka mu bulamu buno obw’ennaku, era ogutannafugibwa mwoyo, gulemenga kuwangula ne gunfuga.

Woowe! Bulamu ki buno, obutaggwaamu bizibu na nnaku, omuli buli kintu nga kijjudde emitego n’abalabe? Kubanga ekizibu kimu oba okukemebwa kumu bwe kuvaawo, okulala ne kujja. Era ne lutalo olusooka nga lukyabuubuuka, endala nnyingi zitandika nga tezisuubirwa. Kiyinzika kitya okwagala obulamu obulimu obukaawu obungi bwe butyo, obutuukwako emitawaana n’ennaku ennyingi bwe zityo? Ddala, buyinza butya n’okuyitibwa obulamu, so nga buzaala okufa kungi bwe kutyo n’ebibonoobono? Kyokka bwagalibwa, era bangi beenoonyeza essanyu mu bwo.

Abantu bangi emirundi mingi banenya ensi olw’obulimba n’obutaliimu bwayo, naye tebagireka mangu kubanga okwegomba kw’omubiri kulina amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo. Ebintu ebimu bibasikiriza okwagala ensi, ebirala bibaleetera okuginyooma. Okwegomba kw’omubiri, n’okwegomba kw’amaaso, n’okwekuluntaza okw’obulamu bireeta okwagala, so ng’obulumi n’ennaku, ebiva mu bintu ebyo nga bwe kisaanira, bizaala obukyayi n’okukoowa ensi.

Essanyu ery’obubi liwangula emmeeme eyeewaayo eri ensi. Erowooza nti wansi w’amaggwa gano mulimu amasanyu, kubanga tennaba kulaba wadde okuwoomerwa obuwoomi bwa Katonda wadde essanyu ery’omunda ery’empisa ennungi. Naye abo abanyooma ensi ddala ne banoonya okubeera abalamu ku lwa Katonda wansi w’etteeka ly’empisa entukuvu, bamanyi bulungi obuwoomi bwa Katonda obusuubiziddwa abo abaleka ensi mu mazima. Balaba bulungi ensi bw’ekyamye ennyo, n’engeri nnyingi gy’erimbamu.

fields.title: Okuwummulira mu Katonda Okusinga Ebirungi Byonna n’Ebirabo Byonna
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

WAGGULU w’ebintu byonna era mu bintu byonna, ggwe emmeeme yange, wummulira bulijjo mu Katonda, kubanga ye kiwummulo eky’olubeerera eky’abatukuvu.

Ayi Yesu asinga obuwoomi n’okwagala, ompe nnoonye okuwummula kwange mu ggwe okusinga ekitonde kyonna; okusinga obulamu obulungi bwonna n’obulungi bw’endabika bwonna; okusinga ekitiibwa kyonna n’ettendo lyonna; obuyinza bwonna n’obukulu bwonna; okusinga okumanya kwonna n’obukalabakalaba bwonna, obugagga bwonna n’ebyobukugu byonna, essanyu lyonna n’okujaguza kwonna; okusinga erinnya eddungi lyonna n’okutenderezebwa kwonna, obuwoomi bwonna n’okubudaabudibwa kwonna; okusinga essuubi lyonna n’ekisuubizo kyonna, empeera yonna n’okwegomba kwonna; okusinga ebirabo byonna n’ebirungi byonna by’oyinza okumpa oba okuntonnyesaako; okusinga essanyu lyonna n’okujaguza kwonna ebirowoozo bye biyinza okufuna n’okuwulira; era ku nkomerero, okusinga bamalayika ne bamalayika abakulu n’eggye lyonna ery’omu ggulu; okusinga ebintu byonna ebirabika n’ebitalabika; era nnoonye okuwummula kwange mu ggwe okusinga buli kintu ekitali ggwe, Katonda wange.

Kubanga ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, osinga byonna obulungi. Ggwe wekka ali waggulu ddala, ggwe wekka asinga amaanyi. Ggwe wekka amala ddala era akkusa ddala, ggwe wekka asinga obuwoomi n’okubudaabuda. Ggwe wekka asinga obulungi n’okwagala, ggwe wekka asinga obukulu n’ekitiibwa okusinga byonna. Mu ggwe mwe muli buli kutuukirira okwali kubaddewo oba okulibaawo. Noolwekyo, kyonna ky’ompa ng’oggyeeko ggwe kennyini, kyonna ky’ombikkulira ku ggwe kennyini, ne kyonna ky’osuubiza, kiba kitono nnyo era tekimala bwe siraba ggwe wekka ne sikunyumirwa mu bujjuvu. Kubanga omutima gwange tegusobola kuwummula wadde okumatira ddala okutuusa lwe gulisukka ebirabo byonna na buli kitonde, ne guwummulira mu ggwe.

Ani, Ayi Omugole asinga okwagalwa, Yesu Kristo, Omwagazi asinga obulongoofu, Mukama w’ebitonde byonna, ani alimpa ebiwaawaatiro eby’eddembe ery’amazima ndyoke mbuuke ŋŋende mpummulire mu ggwe? Ddi lwe ndiweebwa eddembe mu bujjuvu okulaba nga bw’oli omuwoomu, Ayi Mukama, Katonda wange? Ddi lwe ndikuŋŋaanyiza ddala omwoyo gwange mu ggwe, olw’okwagala kwo ne siwulira nze kennyini, wabula ggwe wekka, okusinga okuwulira kwonna n’ekipimo kyonna, mu ngeri etamanyiddwa muntu yenna? Naye kaakano emirundi mingi nkungubaga era nnakuwala olw’obunaku bwange, kubanga ebibi bingi bintuukako mu kiwonvu kino eky’ennaku, emirundi mingi ne bintabula, ne binnakuwaza era ne bimbuutikira ekisiikirize, emirundi mingi ne binziyiza era ne binkyamya, ne binsendasenda era ne bineezingiriza, ne sisobola kutuuka gy’oli mu ddembe, wadde okunyumirwa okuwambaatira okuwoomu okuba okwetegefu bulijjo eri emmeeme ezirina omukisa. Okusinda kwange n’okulekebwa kwange okw’engeri nnyingi wano ku nsi bikukwatako.

Ayi Yesu, Obumasamasi bw’ekitiibwa eky’olubeerera, Okubudaabudibwa kw’emmeeme etambula ng’omugenyi, emimwa gyange tegyogera kigambo gy’oli, era okusirika kwange kwe kwogera naawe. Mukama wange alirwawo kutuusa ddi okujja? Ajje eri omuddu we omwavu amusanyuse. Agolole omukono gwe aggye ekitonde kino eky’ennaku mu bulumi bwakyo. Jjangu, Ayi jjangu, kubanga awatali ggwe tewaliba lunaku wadde essaawa ey’essanyu, kubanga ggwe ssanyu lyange, era awatali ggwe emmeeza yange njereere. Ndi munaku, ng’ali mu kkomera era ng’azitoowereddwa enjegere, okutuusa lw’olinjjuza ekitangaala eky’okubeerawo kwo, n’onzizaawo eddembe, n’ondaga amaaso ag’omukwano. Abalala banoonye kyonna kye baagala mu kifo kyo, naye tewali kinsanyusa wadde ekirinsanyusa wabula ggwe, Katonda wange, Essuubi lyange, Obulokozi bwange obw’olubeerera. Sijja kusirika, sijja kulekayo kusaba okutuusa ekisa kyo lwe kirikomawo gye ndi n’oyogera nange munda, ng’ogamba nti: “Laba, Ndi wano. Laba, nzize gy’oli kubanga onkowodde. Amaziga go n’okwegomba kw’emmeeme yo, obwetoowaze bwo n’okunakuwala kw’omutima gwo olw’ebibi bye binsikirizza ne bindeeta gy’oli.”

Mukama, nkukowodde, era nkwegombye, era mbadde mwetegefu okunyooma byonna ku lulwo. Kubanga ggwe wasooka okunkubiriza okukunoonya. Otenderezebwe, n’olwekyo, Ayi Mukama, olw’okulaga omuddu wo obulungi buno olw’okusaasira kwo okungi.

Kiki ekirala omuddu wo ky’ayinza okukugamba, okuggyako okwetoowaza mu maaso go, ng’ajjukira bulijjo obutali butuukirivu bwe n’obubi bwe? Mu byewuunyo byonna eby’omu ggulu n’ensi tewali ali nga ggwe. Emirimu gyo mirungi nnyo, emisango gyo gya mazima, era okulabirira kwo kufuga ensi yonna. Otenderezebwe era oweebwe ekitiibwa, n’olwekyo, Ayi Magezi ga Kitaffe. Emimwa gyange n’emmeeme yange n’ebitonde byonna byegatte okukutendereza n’okukwebaza.

fields.title: Jjukira Ebirabo bya Katonda Ebitabalika
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

GGULAWO omutima gwange, Ayi Mukama, eri amateeka go, era onjigirize okutambulira mu kkubo ly’ebiragiro byo. Mpa okutegeera by’oyagala. Mpa okujjukira emikisa gyo — gyonna awamu na buli gumu ku gyo — n’okussaamu ekitiibwa kungi n’obwegendereza, ndyoke okuva kaakano nkwebaze nga bwe kisaanidde. Mmanyi nti sisobola kukwebaza nga bwe kisaanidde wadde ku kirabo kyo ekisinga obutono. Sisaanira birungi by’ompadde, era bwe ndowooza ku bugabi bwo, omwoyo gwange guzirika mu maaso g’obunene bwabwo. Byonna bye tulina eby’emmeeme n’eby’omubiri, kyonna kye tulina munda oba kungulu, mu buzaaliranwa oba olw’ekisa, bye birabo byo, era birangirira obulungi bwo n’okusaasira kwo, mwe twafunira ebirungi byonna.

Omu bw’afuna ebisingawo ate omulala ebitono, naye byonna bibyo, era awatali ggwe tewali kiyinza kufunibwa. Oyo afuna ebinene tasobola kwenyumiririza mu bisaanira bye ye, wadde okwerowooza nti asinga abalala, wadde okweyisa n’amalala eri abo abafuna ebitono. Oyo eyeetwalira ebitono, era ng’asinga obwetoowaze n’okwemalira ku Katonda mu kwebaza, ddala ye asinga obukulu n’obulungi; ate oyo eyeetwala okuba wansi w’abantu bonna era ne yeesalira nti y’asinga obutasaanira, ye asinga okusaanira okufuna omukisa ogusinga obunene.

Ku luuyi olulala, oyo afunye ebirabo ebitono tasaanidde kunakuwala, wadde okubulwa obugumiikiriza, wadde okukwatirwa obuggya oyo amusinga obugagga. Wabula asaanidde okukyusiza ebirowoozo bye gy’oli era akuwe ettendo erisinga obunene, kubanga ogaba mu bungi bwe butyo, ku bwereere era n’omutima ogwagala, nga tososola bantu. Byonna biva gy’oli; noolwekyo, osaanidde okutenderezebwa mu byonna. Ggwe omanyi ekirungi eri buli omu ku ffe; era lwaki omu afuna ebitono ate omulala ebingi, si ffe tusaanidde okukisalawo, wabula ggwe eyapima ebisaanira bya buli muntu.

Noolwekyo, Ayi Mukama Katonda, ntwala nga mukisa munene obutaba na bintu bingi abantu bye batwala okuba eby’ettendo n’ekitiibwa; kubanga oyo ategeera obwavu bwe n’obubi bwe tasaanidde kunakuwala wadde okuggwaamu amaanyi olw’ekyo, wabula okubudaabudibwa n’okusanyuka, kubanga ggwe, Ayi Katonda, walonda abaavu, abeetoowaze, n’abanyoomebwa mu nsi muno okuba mikwano gyo n’abaweereza bo. Amazima g’ekyo gakakasibwa Abatume bo, be wafuula abalangira ku nsi yonna. Naye baabeera mu nsi muno nga tebeemulugunya, nga beetoowaze era nga ba mutima mwangu, nga tebalina ttima wadde obulimba, ne kiba nti baasanyuka n’okuvumibwa olw’erinnya lyo, era ne bawambaatira n’okwagala okungi ekyo ensi ky’ekyawa.

Noolwekyo omuntu akwagala era ategeera ebirungi by’omukoledde, tewali kintu kisaanidde kumusanyusa ng’ebyo by’oyagala, n’ekyo ekikusanyusa mu kiragiro kyo eky’olubeerera. Ekyo kisaanidde okumumatiza n’okumubudaabuda ennyo n’ayagala okuba asembayo obutono ng’abalala bwe baagala okuba abasinga obukulu; abeere n’emirembe era amatire mu kifo eky’enkomerero nga bw’abeera mu kisooka, era abeere mwetegefu okunyoomebwa, obutamanyibwa n’okwerabirwa, nga bw’abeera okuweebwa abalala ekitiibwa n’okuba n’erinnya okubasinga. Asaanidde okukulembeza by’oyagala n’okwagala ekitiibwa kyo okusinga ebirala byonna, era ekyo kisaanidde okumubudaabuda okusinga ebirungi byonna by’aweereddwa oba by’aliweebwa.

fields.title: Ebintu Bina Ebireeta Emirembe Emingi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, kaakano nja kukuyigiriza ekkubo ery’emirembe n’eddembe ery’amazima.

Mwana wange, fuba okukola abalala bye baagala okusinga ggwe by’oyagala.

Bulijjo londa okuba n’ebitono okusinga ebingi.

Bulijjo noonya ekifo eky’enkomerero era fuba okuba wansi w’abalala bonna.

Bulijjo yagala era saba Katonda by’ayagala bituukirire ddala mu ggwe.

Laba, omuntu ow’engeri eyo aliyingira mu bwakabaka obw’emirembe n’okuwummula.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, ekigambo kyo kino ekimpi kirimu okutuukirira kungi. Kimpi mu bigambo naye kijjudde amakulu era kibala ebibala bingi. Mazima singa nnali nsobola okukikuuma n’obwesigwa, sanditabuddwa mangu bwe ntyo. Kubanga buli lwe nneesanga nga ntabuse era nga mpweddemu amaanyi, nzuula nga nvudde ku kuyigiriza kuno. Naye ggwe asobola byonna, era bulijjo ayagala ekyo ekiganyula emmeeme yange, onjongere ekisa, ndyoke nkuume ebigambo byo era ntuukirize obulokozi bwange.

Okusaba okulwanyisa Ebirowoozo Ebibi

Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, tombera wala, Ayi Katonda wange, yanguwa ojje ombeere, kubanga ebirowoozo eby’engeri nnyingi n’okutya okungi bigolokokedde munda yange, ne bibonyaabonya emmeeme yange. Nnaabiwona ntya nga sirumiddwa? Nnaabigoba ntya?

“Ndikukulembera,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “era ndikkakkanya abakulu b’ensi. Ndiggulawo enzigi z’ekkomera, era ndikubikkulira ebyama ebyakwekebwa.”

Kola nga bw’ogambye, Mukama, era ebirowoozo byonna ebibi bidduke mu maaso go. Lino lye ssuubi lyange era kwe kubudaabudibwa kwange kwokka — okuddukira gy’oli mu kubonaabona kwonna, okukwesiga, n’okukukoowoola okuva mu buziba bw’omutima gwange, n’okulindirira n’obugumiikiriza okubudaabuda kwo.

Okusaba olw’Okutangaaza Amagezi

Ntangaaza, Yesu omulungi, n’okumasamasa kw’ekitangaala eky’omunda, era oggyewo ekizikiza kyonna mu kifo omutima gwange mwe gubeera. Ziyiza ebirowoozo byange ebibungeeta era otoowaze okukemebwa okunnumba n’amaanyi bwe gatyo. Nnwanirira n’amaanyi, owangule ensolo zino embi — okwegomba okusendasenda okw’omubiri — emirembe gijje olw’obuyinza bwo, era ettendo lyo mu bujjuvu liwuumire mu mpya entukuvu, nga gwe muntu ow’omunda omulongoofu. Lagira empewo n’embuyaga; gamba ennyanja nti: “Tteeka, sirika,” n’empewo ey’obukiikakkono nti, “Tokunta,” era wanaabaawo okuteeka okunene.

Kale tuma omusana gwo n’amazima, byakaayakane ku nsi, kubanga ndi ng’ensi eyali njereere nga yeetabuddetabudde okutuusa lw’ontangaaza. Fukira ekisa kyo okuva waggulu. Tonnyesa ku mutima gwange omusulo ogw’omu ggulu. Ggulawo ensulo ez’okwemalira ku Katonda zifukirire ensi, ebale ebibala ebisinga obulungi. Yimusa omutima gwange ogunyigirizibwa obuzito bw’ebibi, era oluŋŋamye okwegomba kwange kwonna eri ebintu eby’omu ggulu, ndyoke, nga mmaze okuwooma obuwoomi bw’essanyu ery’omu ggulu, sibe na ssanyu lyonna mu kulowooza ku bintu eby’ensi.

Nnyakula onnunule mu kubudaabudibwa kwonna okuggwaawo okw’ebitonde, kubanga tewali kitonde kiyinza kukkakkanya ddala n’okukkusa okwegomba kwange. Ngatta naawe mu kisiba ky’okwagala ekitayawukana; kubanga ggwe wekka osobola okukkusa oyo akwagala, era awatali ggwe ebintu byonna tebiriiko mugaso.

fields.title: Okwewala Okubuuliriza ku Bulamu bw’Abalala
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tobanga na kwagala kumanya kwa bwereere. Teweetawaanya na byakufaako ebitaliiko mugaso. Kino oba kiri kikukwatako ki? Ggwe goberera Nze. Kikukwatako ki omuntu bw’aba bw’ati oba bw’ati, oba omulala bw’akola oba bw’ayogera kino oba kiri? Tolibuuzibwa ku balala, naye olyennyonnyolako ggwe kennyini. Kale lwaki weeyingiza mu nsonga zaabwe?

Laba, mmanyi abantu bonna. Ndaba ebintu byonna ebikolebwa wansi w’enjuba, era mmanyi embeera ya buli omu bw’eri — ekiri mu birowoozo bye, n’ekiri mu mutima gwe, n’ekigendererwa ky’aluubirira. Noolwekyo kwasa byonna gye ndi, weekuume ng’oli mu mirembe emirungi. Oyo atabuse aleke abe mweraliikirivu nga bw’ayagala. Kyonna ky’ayogedde oba ky’akoze kirimukomako ye kennyini, kubanga tasobola kunnimba.

Teweeraliikiriranga olw’ekisiikirize ky’erinnya ekkulu, wadde olw’omukwano ogw’oku lusegere n’abangi, wadde olw’okwagalibwa abantu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Ebintu ebyo bireeta okutaataaganyizibwa era biteeka ekizikiza kinene ku mutima. Nnandyagadde okwogera ekigambo kyange n’okukubikkulira ebyama byange, singa obadde otunula n’obunyiikivu ng’olindirira okujja kwange era n’oggulawo omutima gwo gye ndi. Kale beera mwegendereza. Tunula mu kusaba, era weetoowaze mu byonna.

fields.title: Omusingi gw’Emirembe egy’Omutima Egyannamaddala n’Okukula okw’Amazima
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, nayogera nti: “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi.”

Abantu bonna baagala emirembe, naye si bonna abafaayo ku bintu ebireeta emirembe egy’amazima. Emirembe gyange gibeera n’abeetoowaze n’abawombeefu mu mutima: emirembe gyo giriba mu bugumiikiriza bungi. Bw’onompulira n’ogoberera eddoboozi lyange, onoosobola okunyumirwa emirembe mingi.

Omuyigirizwa

Kale, kiki kye nnaakola, Mukama?

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Weekuume mu byonna, mu by’okola ne mu by’oyogera. Kyonna ky’ogenderera kiruubirire kunsanyusa nze nzekka, era tobanga na kye weegomba ebweru wange. Toyanguyirizanga kusalira musango bikolwa na bigambo bya balala, era teweeyingizanga mu nsonga ezitali zizo. Bw’otyo, kirituukawo nti otaataaganyizibwanga katono era emirundi mitono.

Wabula, obutatabulwa n’akatono wadde okulumwa mu mutima oba mu mubiri tekiri kya bulamu buno obwa kaakano, wabula kya mbeera ya kuwummula okw’olubeerera. Noolwekyo, tolowoozanga nti ozudde emirembe egy’amazima bw’otowulira nnaku, oba nti byonna bigenda bulungi kubanga tewali akuziyiza. Tolowoozanga nti byonna bituukiridde buli kintu bwe kibaawo nga bw’oyagala. Era teweerowoozanga nti oli mukulu oba nti oyagalibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo bw’ojjula okwemalira ku Katonda okungi n’obuwoomi. Kubanga oyo ayagala ennyo empisa ennungi tamanyibwa olw’ebintu ebyo, era okukula n’okutuukirira kw’omuntu tebiri mu byo.

Omuyigirizwa

Biri mu ki, Mukama?

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Biri mu kwewaayo n’omutima gwo gwonna eri Katonda by’ayagala, nga tonoonya bibyo mu nsonga entono wadde ennene, mu bintu eby’akaseera wadde eby’olubeerera, olyoke obeerenga n’omutima ogutakyukakyuka era weebazenga mu birungi ne mu bizibu, ng’olaba ebintu byonna mu kitangaala kyabyo ekituufu.

Bw’onooba omuzira era omugumiikiriza mu ssuubi ennyo n’osobola okuteekateeka omutima gwo okubonaabona n’okusingawo, ne bwe kubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’omunda kuggyibwawo, era bw’oteewolereza ng’eyandibadde tasaanidde kubonyaabonyezebwa bintu binene bwe bityo, wabula n’okkiriza nti ndi mutuukirivu mu bikolwa byange byonna era n’otendereza erinnya lyange ettukuvu — olwo olitambulira mu kkubo ery’amazima era ettuufu ery’emirembe, olwo oyinza okuba n’essuubi erikakafu ery’okulaba nate amaaso gange mu ssanyu. Bw’olituuka ku kwenyooma ddala ggwe kennyini, olwo manya nti olinyumirwa emirembe mingi, nga bwe kisoboka mu bulamu buno obw’oku nsi.

fields.title: Obulungi bw’Omwoyo Ogw’eddembe, Ogufunibwa mu Kusaba Okusinga mu Kusoma
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

KYE KABONERO, Mukama, eky’omuntu atuukiridde, obutaganya birowoozo bye kuddiriza mu kufaayo ku bintu eby’omu ggulu, n’okuyita mu byakufaako bingi ng’atalina na kimu; si nga bw’akola omugayaavu, wabula olw’enkizo enkakafu ey’omwoyo ogw’eddembe, nga talina kwagala kwonna okutali kwa mu nteeko eri ekitonde kyonna.

Nkwegayiridde, Ayi Katonda asinga okusaasira, nkuuma eri ebyeraliikiriza eby’obulamu buno, nneme okubyezingiramu ennyo. Nkuuma eri ebyetaago ebingi eby’omubiri, nneme okukwasibwa mu mutego gw’essanyu. Nkuuma eri ekizikiza kyonna eky’ebirowoozo, nneme okumenyebwa ebizibu ne mpangulwa. Sisaba kununulwa mu bintu ebyo obutaliimu bw’ensi bye bwegomba ennyo bwe butyo, wabula mu nnaku ezo, olw’ekikolimo ekyagwa ku bantu bonna, ezinyigiriza emmeeme y’omuddu wo nga kibonerezo, ne zimuziyiza okuyingira mu ddembe ly’omwoyo buli lw’ayagala.

Katonda wange, Obuwoomi obusukkiridde ebigambo, fuula ekikaawa okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’omubiri okunzigya ku kwagala eby’olubeerera ne kunsendasenda okudda ku bubi bwakwo nga kundaga ekirungi ekisanyusa eky’akaseera kano. Kireme okumpangula, Katonda wange. Omubiri n’omusaayi bireme okumpangula. Ensi n’ekitiibwa kyayo eky’akaseera akatono bireme okunnimba, wadde Setaani okunneesittaza olw’obukalabakalaba bwe. Mpa obuzira okuziyiza, obugumiikiriza okugumira, n’obunywevu okunyiikira. Mpa amafuta agawoomerera ag’Omwoyo wo okusinga okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’ensi, era mu kifo ky’okwagala okw’omubiri, fuka mu nze okwagala erinnya lyo.

Laba, okulya, okunywa, okwambala, n’ebyetaago ebirala ebiyimirizaawo omubiri, mugugu eri emmeeme eyaka. Mpa ekisa okukozesa ebibudaabuda ng’ebyo mu kigero, nneme okwezingira mu kubyegomba ennyo. Tekikkirizibwa kubisuulira ddala, kubanga obutonde bulina okuyimirizibwawo, naye amateeka go amatukuvu gatugaana okusaba ebintu ebisukkiridde n’ebintu ebiri olw’essanyu lyokka, kubanga omubiri gwandijeemedde omwoyo. Mu nsonga zino, nkwegayiridde, omukono gwo gunkulembere era gunnuŋŋamye, nneme okusukka amateeka mu ngeri yonna.

fields.title: Okwagala Omuntu kwe Yeeyagala kye Kiziyiza Ekisinga eri Ekirungi Ekisingayo
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, osaanidde okuwaayo byonna olw’okufuna byonna, era obutaba wuwo ggwe kennyini mu ngeri yonna. Olina okumanya nti okwagala kwe weeyagala kukutuusaako obulabe okusinga ekintu kyonna mu nsi. Okusinziira ku kwagala n’omukwano by’olina eri ekintu, bwe kityo bwe kinaakwekwatako ennyo oba katono. Okwagala kwo bwe kunaaba okulongoofu, okutaliimu bukuusa era okutegekeddwa obulungi, tolibeera muddu wa kintu kyonna. Teweegombanga ky’otakkirizibwa kuba nakyo. Tobanga na kintu kyonna ekiyinza okukuziyiza oba okukunyagako eddembe lyo.

Kyewuunyisa nti teweewaayo gye ndi n’omutima gwo gwonna, awamu ne byonna by’oyinza okwegomba oba okuba nabyo. Lwaki omalibwamu amaanyi ennaku ey’obusirusiru? Lwaki okooye olw’okweraliikirira okutali kwetaagisa? Weewaayo eri bye njagala era tolifiirwa kintu.

Bw’onoonya kino oba kiri, bw’oyagala okubeera mu kifo kino oba kiri, okuba n’okuwummula n’essanyu ebisingawo, tolifuna kuwummula wadde okuba nga toli na kweraliikirira, kubanga buli kintu kirimu akamogo, era buli wantu wabaawo omuntu anaakunyiiza. N’olwekyo, okufuna n’okwongera ebintu by’ensi tekijja kukuyamba, wabula okubinyooma n’okubikuula mu mutima gwo kye kinaakuyamba. Kino, tegeera, si kituufu ku ssente n’obugagga kyokka, naye ne ku kululunkanira ekitiibwa n’okwegomba ettendo ery’obwereere, byonna ebiriggwaawo awamu n’ensi eno.

Ekifo tekirina makulu mangi singa omwoyo ogw’okwaka teguliiyo; era emirembe tegijja kuwangaala singa ginoonyezebwa ebweru; omutima gwo bwe gutaba na musingi gwa mazima, kwe kugamba, bw’otoba nga wazimbibwa ku nze, oyinza okukyuka, naye tojja kweyongera kuba mulungi. Kubanga omukisa bwe gujja ne gukkirizibwa, ojja kusanga ekyo kye wadduka, n’ekisingawo obubi.

Okusaba olw’Okulongoosa Omutima n’Okufuna Amagezi ag’omu Ggulu

Nnyweza n’ekisa ky’Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu, Ayi Katonda. Mpa amaanyi okunywezebwa munda n’okuggya mu mutima gwange okweraliikirira kwonna okw’obwereere n’okutya, nneme kusikirizibwa kwegomba kungi, oba kwa bintu bya muwendo oba bya wansi. Ndabe buli kintu ng’ekiggwaawo, era nze kennyini ng’ali kumpi okuggwaawo awamu nabyo, kubanga tewali kya lubeerera wansi w’enjuba, gye byonna biri butaliimu na kubonaabona kwa mwoyo. Nga wa magezi oyo alowooza bw’atyo!

Mpa, Mukama, amagezi ag’omu ggulu okuyiga okusinga byonna okukunoonya n’okukuzuula, okukunyumirwa n’okukwagala okusinga ekintu kyonna, n’okutwala ebintu ebirala nga bwe biri, nga amagezi go bwe gabitegese. Mpa obwegendereza okwewala omuntu awaana mu bulimba, n’okugumiikiriza oyo atakkiriziganya nange. Kubanga magezi mangi obutakyusibwa ddoboozi lya bigambo, wadde okuwuliriza omusendasenzi omubi awaana mu bulimba. Olwo nditambulira mirembe mu kkubo lye natandika.

fields.title: Amaanyi Okulwanyisa Okuwaayirizibwa
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tokissanga ku mutima abantu abamu bwe bakulowoozaako obubi ne boogera ebitali birungi ku ggwe. Osaanidde okwerowoozaako ebisingawo obubi, n’okukkiriza nti tewali muntu akusinga bunafu. Ate era, bw’onootambulira mu mwoyo, tojja kufaayo nnyo ku bigambo ebiyitawo. Si magezi matono okusirika mu biseera ebibi, okukyukira gye ndi munda, n’obutatabulwa ndowooza z’abantu. Emirembe gyo gireme kwesigama ku bigambo by’abantu. Okukulowoozaako obulungi oba obubi tekikufuula mulala okuva ku ky’oli. Emirembe egy’amazima n’ekitiibwa biri ludda wa? Tebiri mu nze? Oyo atafaayo kusanyusa bantu era atatya kubanyiiza aliba n’emirembe mingi, kubanga obutateredde bwonna n’okutaataaganyizibwa kw’ebiwulizi biva mu kwagala okutali kwa mu nteeko n’okutya okw’obwereere.

fields.title: Engeri gye Tulina Okukoowoola Mukama n’Okumutendereza Ennaku Bw’etunyigiriza
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

ERINNYA lyo litenderezebwe emirembe gyonna, Ayi Mukama, ggwe eyayagala okukemebwa kuno n’ennaku eno bijje ku nze. Sisobola kubiwona, naye nteekwa okuddukira gy’oli onnyambe era obikyuse bibe bya kirungi gye ndi. Kaakano omutima gwange gweraliikiridde, Mukama, era tegulina kuwummula, kubanga mbonaabona nnyo olw’okulumwa kuno okwa kaakano.

Ayi Kitange omwagalwa! Kale ŋŋambe ntya? Nzingiziddwa mu ngeri enkakali. Kitange mponya ekiseera kino, wadde nga kye nnajjira, olyoke ogulumizibwe nga ntoowaziddwa nnyo era nga nnunuddwa ggwe. Kale kikusanyuse, Mukama, okumponya, kubanga nze omunaku ono nnyinza kukola ki, oba nnyinza kugenda wa awatali ggwe? Mpa obugumiikiriza, Mukama, ne kaakano. Nnyamba, Katonda wange, era sijja kutya ne bwe nnaanakuwala ennyo.

Naye wano, wakati mu bizibu bino, nnaagamba ki? Mukama, ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa. Nsaanidde ddala okutabulwa n’okunakuwazibwa. Naye nteekwa okukigumira. Singa nnali nsobola okukigumira n’obugumiikiriza, okutuusa omuyaga lwe guliyita n’okuteeka ne kukomawo! Naye omukono gwo ogw’obuyinza bwonna gusobola okunzigyako okukemebwa kuno, oba okukendeeza ku maanyi gaakwo nneme okubbira ddala wansi waakwo, nga ggwe, Katonda wange, Kusaasira kwange, bw’onkoledde emirundi mingi edda. Era embeera yange gy’ekoma okuba enzibu, ne gy’ekoma okukwanguyira okukyuka kuno okw’omukono ogwa ddyo ogw’oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo.

fields.title: Okunoonya Obuyambi bwa Katonda n’Okwesiga nti Ekisa Kirikomawo
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, nze Mukama awa amaanyi ku lunaku olw’okulabiramu ennaku. Jjangu gye ndi ng’ebintu tebikugendera bulungi. Okulwawo kwo okudda mu kusaba kye kiziyiza ekisinga obunene okubudaabudibwa okuva mu ggulu, kubanga nga tonnansaba n’omutima gwo gwonna, osooka kunoonya ebikubudaabuda bingi n’osanyukira ebintu eby’ebweru. N’olwekyo ebintu byonna tebikugasa nnyo okutuusa lw’onootegeera nti nze ndokola abo abanneesiga, era nti ebweru wange tewali buyambi bwa mugaso, newaakubadde amagezi ag’omugaso, wadde eddagala ery’olubeerera.

Naye kaakano, omuyaga bwe guyise, ddamu amaanyi, weenyweze nate mu kitangaala ky’okusaasira kwange; kubanga ndi kumpi, bw’ayogera Mukama, okuzzaawo ebintu byonna, si ku kigero kyabyo kyokka, wabula mu bungi era okusukka ekigero. Eriyo ekinnema? Oba ndiba ng’omuntu asuubiza n’atatuukiriza? Okukkiriza kwo kuluwa? Yimirira nga onywevu era ogumiikirize. Ddamu amaanyi, ogume omwoyo, era okubudaabudibwa kulikutuukako mu kiseera kyakwo. Ndindirira; lindirira—era ndijja okukuwonya.

Kukemebwa bukemebwa okukutawaanya, kutya okutaliimu okukutiisa.

Okweraliikirira eby’omu maaso kugasa ki? Kukuleetera kirala kyonna okuggyako emitawaana ku mitawaana? Buli lunaku lulina emitawaana gyalwo egimala. Busirusiru era tekigasa kunakuwala oba kusanyuka olw’ebintu eby’omu maaso, ebiyinza obutabaawo n’akatono. Naye kya buntu okulimbibwalimbibwa ebirowoozo ebiri ng’ebyo, era kabonero ka mwoyo omunafu okusendebwasendebwa ebyo omulabe by’akuteekamu. Kubanga tafaayo obanga akuwangula ng’ayita mu kwagala eby’omu kiseera kino oba mu kutya eby’omu maaso.

Kale omutima gwo gulemenga okweraliikirira, era gulemenga okutya. Nzikiriza era weesige okusaasira kwange. Bw’olowooza nti oli wala nange, emirundi mingi lwe mbeera okumpi naawe ennyo. Bw’osalawo nti kumpi byonna bifudde, emirundi mingi ddala lw’oba mu kkubo ly’okufuna empeera ennene.

Byonna tebiba bifudde ng’ebintu bigenda okukontana n’ebyo by’oyagala. Tosaanidde kusala nsonga ng’ogoberera by’owulira mu kiseera kino, newaakubadde okugonda eri buli kizibu kyonna nga kizze, oba okukitwala ng’essuubi lyonna ery’okuwona bwe libuze. Era teweerowooza nti olekeddwawo bwe nkuweereza okubonaabona okw’akaseera, oba bwe nkuggyako okubudaabudibwa kw’oyagala. Kubanga eryo lye kkubo erigenda mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, era awatali kubuusabuusa kikusingira ggwe n’abaweereza bange abalala okugezesebwa mu bizibu okusinga okufuna ebintu byonna nga bwe mwagala. Mmanyi ebirowoozo byo eby’ekyama, era mmanyi nti kigasa obulokozi bwo okulekebwa oluusi mu kuggwaamu amaanyi, oleme okwegulumiza olw’okutambulirwa obulungi n’olowooza nti oli ky’otali.

Kye nnaawa, nsobola okukiggyawo ne nkizzaawo nga bwe kinsanyusa. Kye mpa kisigala kyange, era n’olwekyo bwe nkiggyawo, siggyawo kintu kyo. Buli kirabo ekirungi ekituukiridde kyange.

Bwe nkuweereza emitawaana n’ebizibu, teweemulugunya era omutima gwo gulemenga kwennyika. Nsobola okukuyimusa amangu nate ne nfuula ennaku yo yonna essanyu. Sikendeera mu butuukirivu, era nsaanira ettendo lingi nga bwe nkukola bwe ntyo.

Bw’onoolowooza obulungi n’olaba ebintu mu kitangaala kyabyo eky’amazima, tosaanidde kuggwaamu maanyi n’okunakuwala bwe bityo olw’ebizibu, wabula okusanyuka n’okwebaza, ng’okitwala ng’ensonga ey’essanyu ery’enjawulo nti nkubonyaabonya ennaku era sikusonyiwa. “Mbaagadde nga Kitange bw’anjagala.” Bwe ntyo bwe nnagamba abayigirizwa bange, era ddala saabatuma mu ssanyu ly’akaseera, wabula mu ntalo ennene; si mu kitiibwa, wabula mu kunyoomebwa; si mu bugayaavu, wabula mu kukola; si mu kuwummula, wabula okubala ebibala n’obugumiikiriza. Ggwe, mwana wange, jjukiranga ebigambo bino.

fields.title: Okusobola Okusanga Omutonzi, Leka Ebitonde Byonna
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI MUKAMA, nkyetaaga nnyo ekisa ekisingawo bwe mba nga ndituuka ku kifo omuntu yenna oba ekitonde kyonna we kitalisobola kunziyiza. Kubanga ekintu kyonna bwe kiba nga kikyankwata, siyinza kubuuka n’eddembe okujja gy’oli. Oyo eyagamba nti, “Singa nnina ebiwaawaatiro ng’ejjiba, nandibuuse ne ŋŋenda mpummulako,” yeegomba okubuuka n’eddembe okujja gy’oli. Ani awummudde okusinga oyo atalina ky’ayagala okuggyako Katonda? Era ani alina eddembe okusinga omuntu ateegomba kintu kyonna ku nsi?

Kale kirungi okuyita ku bitonde byonna, okwerekerera ddala, n’okulaba mu kuwambibwa kw’omwoyo nti ggwe, Omutonzi wa byonna, tolina akufaanana mu bitonde byo byonna, era nti omuntu bw’atasumululwa ku bitonde byonna, tasobola kwemalira n’eddembe ku bya Katonda. Ensonga lwaki abantu abeemalira ku kufumiitiriza ku Katonda balabika batono bwe batyo, eri nti batono nnyo abamanyi okweyawula ddala ku ebyo ebiggwaawo era ebyatondebwa.

Ku lw’ekyo, ddala kwetaagisa ekisa ekinene, ekisa ekiyimusa omwoyo ne kiguggulumiza okusukka ku gwo gwennyini. Omuntu bw’atayimusibwa mu mwoyo, n’asumululwa ku bitonde byonna, n’agattibwa ddala ku Katonda, okumanya kwe kwonna n’ebintu by’alina tebiba na kitundu kinene. Oyo atwala ekintu kyonna okuba ekinene okuggyako ekirungi kimu, ekitaliiko kigero, eky’olubeerera, alimala ebbanga ddene nga mutono era ng’ayavuunda ku ttaka. Kyonna ekitali Katonda si kintu, era kisaanidde okutwalibwa nga si kintu.

Waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’amagezi g’omuntu eyaakizibwa omutima era eyeemalidde ku Katonda, n’okuyiga kw’omuyivu asomye ennyo era omugezi ennyo; kubanga okumanya okukulukuta okuva eri Katonda kwa kitiibwa nnyo okusinga okwo okufunibwa n’okutegana olw’amaanyi g’omuntu.

Bangi beegomba okufumiitiriza ku Katonda, naye nga tebafaayo kukola ebyo okufumiitiriza kwe kwetaaga. Era kiziyiza kinene okumatira n’ebintu eby’ebweru n’ebyo ebiwulikika mu mubiri, n’okuba n’okwefiiriza okutuukiridde okutono bwe kutyo. Simanyi kye kiri, oba mwoyo ki gwe tukulemberwa, oba kiki kye twefuula—ffe abaagala okuyitibwa ab’omwoyo—nti tuteeka okutegana kungi bwe kutyo, n’okweraliikirira okusingawo, ku bintu ebiggwaawo era ebitali bya muwendo, so nga kitono nnyo oba tetufaayo n’akamu, n’okutegeera okujjuvu, ku nsonga ez’omunda mu ffe.

Woowe, nga tumaze okwekuŋŋaanya akatono ennyo mu mwoyo, tuddirira, nga tetupima bikolwa byaffe na kwekebera kukakali. Tetufaayo kumanya kwagala kwaffe gye kuli, era tetukungubagira kuba nti ebikolwa byaffe tebirongoofu.

Jjukira nti olw’okuba buli mubiri gwali gwonoonye ekkubo lyagwo, amataba amangi gaddirira. Kale nga bwe kiri nti okwagala kwaffe okw’omunda kwonoonese, kiteekwa okuba nti n’ekikolwa ekikuvaamu, ekiri ng’akabonero k’obutaba na maanyi ga munda, nakyo kyonoonese. Mu mutima omulongoofu mwe muva ebibala by’obulamu obulungi.

Abantu batera okubuuza omuntu by’akoze bwe biri ebingi, naye tebafaayo nnyo ku mpisa ennungi gy’akoze nayo. Babuuza nti: Wa maanyi? Mugagga? Mulungi mu ndabika? Muwandiisi mulungi? Muyimbi mulungi? Oba mukozi mulungi? Naye tebaayogera nnyo ku ngeri gy’ali omwavu mu mwoyo, ng’omugumiikiriza era omuwombeefu, ng’eyeemalidde ku Katonda era ow’omwoyo. Obuntu butunuulira endabika ye ey’ebweru; ekisa kikyukira obulamu bwe obw’omunda. Obuntu butera okusobya, naye ekisa kyesiga Katonda era tekirimbibwa.

fields.title: Okwefiiriza n’Okwegaana Okwegomba Okubi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, toyinza kuba wa ddembe ddala okuggyako ng’oleseewo ddala okwerowooza wekka; kubanga bonna abanoonya ebyabwe ku bwabwe era abeeyagala bokka basibiddwa mu njegere. Bakyankalanyizibwa omululu n’okwagala okumanya buli kimu, nga bulijjo banoonya okwewummulira so si ebya Kristo, era emirundi mingi bateekateeka ne bazimba ebyo ebitaliba bya lubeerera, kubanga buli ekitava eri Katonda kirisaanawo ddala.

Kale kwata amagezi gano amampi era amatuukirivu: leka by’oyagala, ojja kufuna ekiwummulo. Galowoozeeko mu mutima gwo, era bw’onoomala okugakolerako, ojja kutegeera byonna.

Omuyigirizwa

Naye kino, Ayi Mukama, si mulimu gwa lunaku lumu, era si muzannyo gwa baana bato; ddala mu kigambo kino ekimpi mwe muli okutuukirira kwonna okw’abantu abatukuvu.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Mwana wange, tosaanidde kukyuka kudda nnyuma oba kuggwaamu maanyi bw’owulira ekkubo ly’abatuukirivu. Wabula osaanidde okukubirizibwa n’okusingawo okulinnya ku ntikko zaabwe empanvu, oba waakiri okukwatibwako okunoonya okutuukirira.

Nandyagadde kibe bwe kityo gy’oli—nti otuuse ku kifo w’otakyeyagala ggwe wekka, wabula n’olindirira bulindirizi bye nkulagira n’eby’oyo gwe nnateeka okuba kitaawo ow’omwoyo okukulabirira. Awo wandinsanyusizza nnyo, era obulamu bwo bwonna bwandiyise mu mirembe ne mu ssanyu. Naye okyalina ebintu bingi by’oteekwa okuleka, era bw’otobiwaayo ddala gye ndi, tojja kufuna ky’osaba.

“Nkuwa amagezi onguleko ebya zaabu, eyalongoosebwa mu muliro, olyoke ogaggawale”—ogaggawale mu magezi ag’omu ggulu agalinnyirira byonna ebya wansi. Teeka ebbali amagezi ag’ensi, n’okwesiima kwonna okw’obuntu.

Ŋŋambye nti: waanyisa ekyo eky’omuwendo era ekissibwamu ekitiibwa mu bantu, ofune ekyo ekitwalibwa ng’ekinyoomebwa. Kubanga amagezi ag’amazima ag’omu ggulu—obuteerowooza nti oli wa waggulu n’obutanoonya kitiibwa ku nsi—ddala galabika ng’ag’ekibalangulo era amatono, era kumpi geerabirwa, kubanga abantu bangi bagatendereza n’emimwa gyabwe naye ne bagadduka wala mu bulamu bwabwe. Naye amagezi gano ag’omu ggulu ge jjinja ery’omuwendo omungi, erikwekeddwa eri bangi.

fields.title: Obutatebenkera bw’Omwoyo—Okwolekeza Ekigendererwa Kyaffe Ekisembayo eri Katonda
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, teweesiganga ky’owulira kaakano, kubanga mangu kijja kuwa ekirala ekifo. Ebbanga lyonna ly’onoomala ng’oli mulamu, ojja kuba ng’okyukakyuka newaakubadde nga tokyagala. Oluusi ojja kusanyuka, oluusi onakuwale; kaakano obe mu mirembe, naye nate otabukatabuke; akaseera akamu obe ng’omaliridde ku Katonda, akaddako ng’omwoyo gwo gunyogodde; oluusi obe munyiikivu ate oluusi obe mugayaavu; kaakano obe mukkakkamu ate nate obe wa lusaago.

Naye omuntu ow’amagezi, era ng’omwoyo gwe guyigiriziddwa bulungi, asigala waggulu w’enkyukakyuka zino. Tafaayo ku by’awulira munda mu ye, newaakubadde empewo ey’obutatebenkera gy’efuuwa gy’eva, kasita ekigendererwa kyonna eky’omutima gwe kimutwala eri ekigendererwa kye ekituufu ky’ayagala okutuukako. Kubanga bw’atyo asobola okuyimirira nga tayawuddwamu, nga takyuse, era nga tanyeenyezebwa, ng’ekigendererwa kye ekimu kyolekedde gye ndi awatali kutengatenga, ne wakati mu bintu bingi bwe bityo ebikyukakyuka. Era ekigendererwa kino ekimu gye kikoma okuba ekirongoofu, n’obunywevu gye bukoma okuba obungi bw’ayitamu mu kibuyaga bingi.

Naye eriiso ery’ekigendererwa ekirongoofu lifuuka kizikiza mu ngeri nnyingi, kubanga lisikirizibwa buli kintu ekisanyusa kye lisanga. Ddala, kizibu okusanga omuntu atalina kamogo n’akatono ak’okunoonya ebibye ku bubwe. Okugeza, Abayudaaya ab’edda bajja e Besaniya eri Maliza ne Maliyamu, si lwa Yesu yekka, naye n’okulaba Laazaalo.

Kale eriiso ery’ekigendererwa kyo liteekwa okulongoosebwa liryoke libe limu era ttuufu. Liteekwa okwolekezebwa gye ndi, newaakubadde nga waliwo ebintu bingi ebiyinza okuliziyiza.

fields.title: Katonda Awooma Okusinga Byonna era mu Byonna eri Abo Abamwagala
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

LABA, Katonda wange era byonna byange! Kiki ekirala kye njagala; ssanyu ki ekisingawo lye nnyinza okwegomba? Ayi ekigambo ekiwooma era ekinyuma! Naye kiwooma eri oyo yekka akyagala, so si eri ensi newaakubadde ebintu ebiri mu nsi.

Katonda wange era byonna byange! Ebigambo bino bimala eri oyo abitegeera, era eri oyo ayagala, kya ssanyu okubiddiŋŋana emirundi mingi. Kubanga bw’obaawo, ebintu byonna bisanyusa; bw’otabaawo, ebintu byonna bifuuka bya kwenyinyalwa. Ggwe ggwe owa omutima obukkakkamu, emirembe emingi n’essanyu ery’embaga. Ggwe ggwe atuleetera okulowooza obulungi ku bintu byonna, n’okukutendereza mu byonna. Awatali ggwe, tewali kiyinza kusanyusa okumala ebbanga eddene, kubanga bwe kiba ng’ekiteekwa okusanyusa n’okuwooma, ekisa kyo n’ekirungo ky’amagezi go biteekwa okubaamu. Kiki ekiyinza okunyiiza oyo essanyu lye eriri mu ggwe? Era, ku ludda olulala, kiki ekiyinza okumatiza oyo essanyu lye eritali mu ggwe?

Abagezi ab’ensi, abantu abegomba eby’omubiri, babulwa amagezi go, kubanga mu nsi mwe musangibwa obutaliimu obusingirayo ddala, era mu mubiri mwe muli okufa. Naye abo abakugoberera nga banyooma eby’ensi era nga bafiiriza omubiri bamanyibwa okuba ab’amagezi ag’amazima, kubanga bavudde mu butaliimu ne batuuka mu mazima, bavudde mu mubiri ne batuuka mu mwoyo. Abo nga bano be bawoomerwa Katonda, era buli kirungi kyonna kye basanga mu bitonde bakifuula ettendo eri Omutonzi. Naye nnene—weewaawo, nnene nnyo ddala—enjawulo wakati w’okusanyukira Omutonzi n’okusanyukira ekitonde, wakati w’ebiseera ebitaggwaawo n’ebiseera ebiggwaawo, wakati w’Ekitangaala ekitaatondebwa n’ekitangaala ekyakaayakana okuva ku kirala.

Ayi Ekitangaala eky’olubeerera, ekisinga okumasamasa kwonna okwatondebwa, myansa okuva waggulu, oyakire ebisenge eby’omunda ennyo mu mutima gwange. Longoosa, sanyusa, yakira, era ozzeemu obulamu omwoyo gwange n’obuyinza bwagwo bwonna, gulyoke gwekwate ku ggwe mu kuwambibwa okw’essanyu. Woowe, ssaawa eyo ey’omukisa era gye neegomba erijja ddi, lw’olinzijuza okubeerawo kwo n’ofuuka byonna mu byonna gye ndi? Kasita kino kiba nga tekinnampebwa, essanyu lyange teririba lijjuvu.

Woowe, omuntu ow’edda akyali mulamu munda mu nze. Tannakomererwa ddala; tannafa ddala. Akyegomba n’amaanyi ebikontana n’omwoyo, era tajja kuleka bwakabaka bw’omwoyo gwange mu mirembe. Naye ggwe ofuga amalala g’ennyanja, amayengo gaayo bwe geekuluumulula n’ogakkakkanya, golokoka onnyambe. Osaasaanye amawanga agasanyukira entalo; gabetente mu maaso go. Nkwegayiridde, laga ebikolwa byo eby’ekitalo, omukono gwo ogwa ddyo gugulumizibwe, kubanga gye ndi tewali ssuubi ddala wadde ekiddukiro okuggyako mu ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange.

fields.title: Mu Bulamu Buno Tewali Bukuumi okuva mu Kukemebwa
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, mu bulamu buno tobeera mu bukuumi n’akamu, era ebbanga lyonna ly’onoomala ng’oli mulamu, ebyokulwanyisa eby’omwoyo bijja kukwetaagisanga bulijjo. Obeera wakati mu balabe. Oyinza okulumbibwa ku mukono ogwa ddyo ne ku gwa kkono. Kale bw’otoneekuuma ku buli ludda n’engabo ey’obugumiikiriza, tojja kumala bbanga ddene nga tolumiddwa.

Ate era, bw’ototeeka mutima gwo ku nze buli kiseera, n’okwagala okunywevu okubonaabona mu buli kimu ku lwange, tojja kusobola kugumira bbugumu lya lutalo luno, newaakubadde okufuna engule y’abo abalina omukisa. Kale osaanidde okuyita mu bintu bino byonna n’obuzira, n’okulwanyisa n’omukono ogw’amaanyi buli ekikuziyiza. Kubanga oyo awangula aweebwa emmere ey’omu ggulu, naye oyo omugayaavu ennyo okulwana asigalirwa ennaku nnyingi.

Bw’onoonya ekiwummulo mu bulamu buno, olituuka otya ku kiwummulo eky’olubeerera? Kale weetegekere, si kiwummulo kingi, wabula obugumiikiriza obungi. Noonya emirembe egy’amazima, si ku nsi wabula mu ggulu; si mu bantu oba mu bitonde ebirala, wabula mu Katonda yekka. Olw’okwagala Katonda, osaanidde okugumira byonna n’essanyu: okutegana kwonna n’ennaku, okukemebwa n’ebigezo, okweraliikirira, obunafu, ebyetaago, okulumizibwa, okuwaayirizibwa, okunenyezebwa, okutoowazibwa, okuswazibwa, okubuulirirwa n’okunyoomebwa. Kubanga bino biyamba okufuna empisa ennungi. Bino bye bigezo by’omuserikale wa Kristo omuggya. Bino bye bikola engule ey’omu ggulu. Olw’okutegana okutono okw’akaseera ndiwa engule ey’olubeerera, era olw’okuswala okuyitawo, ekitiibwa eky’emirembe n’emirembe.

Olowooza nti onoobanga n’okubudaabudibwa okw’omwoyo bulijjo nga bw’oyagala? Abatukuvu bange tebaakubanga nakwo bulijjo. Wabula baalina okubonaabona kungi, okukemebwa okw’engeri nnyingi, n’okulekebwa obwomu okunene. Naye byonna baabigumiikiriza. Beesiga Katonda okusinga bwe beesiga bokka, nga bamanyi nti okubonaabona okw’obulamu buno kutono nnyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa. Naawe—oyagala okufunirawo ekyo abalala kye baafuna mu buzibu oluvannyuma lw’amaziga mangi n’okutegana okunene?

Lindirira Mukama. Ddamu amaanyi, ogume omwoyo. Toggwaamu bwesige. Tokyuka kudda nnyuma, wabula wangayo omubiri gwo n’emmeeme yo buli kiseera olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Ndikusasula mu bungi ddala. Nnaabeeranga naawe mu buli kubonaabona.

fields.title: Okusala kw’Abantu Okutaliimu
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, wesige Mukama n’obunywevu, era totyanga kusala kw’abantu omuntu wo ow’omunda bw’akugamba nti oli mutuukirivu era toliiko musango. Kubanga kirungi era kya mukisa okubonaabona ebintu ebiri ng’ebyo, era tebijja kuzitoowerera mutima mwetoowaze ogwesiga Katonda okusinga bwe gwesiga gwokka. Abantu bangi boogera bingi, n’olwekyo tekisaana kubakkiriza nnyo.

Bwe kityo, tekisoboka kusanyusa bantu bonna. Newaakubadde nga Pawulo yagezaako okusanyusa bonna mu Mukama, era n’afuuka byonna eri abantu bonna, naye endowooza zaabwe yazitwala nga ntono. Yakola nnyo n’obunyiikivu olw’okuzimba n’olw’obulokozi bw’abalala, nga bwe kyali mu buyinza bwe era nga bwe yasobola, naye teyasobola kwewala kusalirwa musango n’okunyoomebwa abalala oluusi. Kyeyava akwasa byonna Katonda amanyi byonna, ne yeetaasa n’obugumiikiriza bwe n’obwetoowaze bwe eri ennimi z’abo aboogera ebitali bya bwenkanya, oba abaalowooza eby’obusirusiru n’eby’obulimba, oba abaamuvunaana. Oluusi, ddala, yabaddangamu, naye ng’ekigendererwa kye kyokka kwe kuziyiza okusirika kwe okwesittaza abanafu.

Kale ggwe ani atya omuntu alifa? Leero ali wano, enkya talabika. Tya Katonda, olwo tojja kutya bitiisa by’abantu. Omuntu yenna ayinza kukukola ki mu kigambo oba mu kukulumya? Yeerumya yekka okusinga bw’akulumya ggwe, era k’abe ani, tayinza kwewala musango gwa Katonda. Kale Katonda mubeeranga mu maaso go, era towakananga n’ebigambo eby’obusungu.

Kale bwe kirabika ng’owanguddwa era ng’oswazibwa awatali nsonga, teweemulugunya olw’ekyo, era tokendeeza ku ngule yo olw’obutagumiikiriza. Wabula tunuulira eggulu, otunuulire nze, alina obuyinza okukuwonya mu buswavu bwonna ne mu kulumizibwa kwonna, n’okuwa buli omu empeera esaanira ebikolwa bye.

fields.title: Okwewaayo Okulongoofu era Okujjuvu Okufuna Eddembe ly’Omutima
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, weegaane wekka, ojja kunsanga. Leka okwagala kwo ku bubwo n’ebintu by’olina, era bulijjo ojja kufunamu. Kubanga bw’onoomala okwewaayo awatali kudda nnyuma, ojja kuweebwa ekisa ekisingawo.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, nneewaayo emirundi emeka? Era mu ki mwe nneerekerera?

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Bulijjo, buli ssaawa, mu bintu ebitono n’ebinene—siriiko kye nnyawulamu. Mu bintu byonna njagala oggibwemu okwagala kwo ku bubwo. Oyinza otya okuba owange, nange okuba owuwo, okuggyako ng’oggiddwako okwagala kwo ku bubwo, munda ne kungulu? Gy’onookoma okukikola amangu, gye kinaakoma okukuganya; era gy’onookoma okukikola mu bujjuvu n’omutima omulongoofu, gy’onookoma okunsanyusa, n’empeera gy’onoosaanira gy’enookoma okuba ennene.

Waliwo abamu abeewaayo, naye nga balina kye beesigaliza; tebeesiga Katonda mu bujjuvu, n’olwekyo bagezaako okwerabirira bokka. Abalala, nabo, mu kusooka bawaayo byonna, naye oluvannyuma okukemebwa ne kubalumba, ne baddayo ku ebyo bye baali beegaanye, bwe batyo ne batakulaakulana mu mpisa ennungi. Abo tebalituuka ku ddembe ery’amazima ery’omutima omulongoofu, newaakubadde ku kisa ky’omukwano ogw’essanyu nange, okuggyako nga basoose okwewaayo ddala n’okwewaayo nga ssaddaaka buli lunaku. Awatali kino, tewali kwegatta kwa bibala okubeerawo, era tekulibeerawo.

Nkugambye emirundi mingi nnyo, era kaakano nkuddamu nate nti: weerekerere, weegaane wekka, era ojja kunyumirwa emirembe emingi egy’omunda. Waayo byonna ofune byonna. Tobaako ky’osaba, tobaako ky’obanja kukuddizibwa. Weesige nze mu bulongoofu era awatali kubuusabuusa, era ojja kuba nange. Ojja kuba wa ddembe mu mutima, era ekizikiza tekijja kukuzikiriza.

Fuba olw’ekyo, saba olw’ekyo, kyegombe—okuggibwako okwerowooza ggwe wekka kwonna, n’ogoberera Yesu eyali obwereere ng’oli bwereere, okufa eri ggwe wekka n’obeera mulamu emirembe gyonna ku lwange. Olwo ebirowoozo byonna ebitaliimu, n’okutabulwa kwonna okubi, n’okweraliikirira okutali kwa mugaso, bijja kuggwaawo. Olwo era okutya okusukkiridde kujja kukuvaako, n’okwagala okutali mu kifo kyakwo kujja kufa.

fields.title: Okutegeka Obulungi Ensonga ez’Ebweru; Okuddukira eri Katonda mu Kabi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, oteekwa okufuba n’obunyiikivu okuba ow’eddembe munda, okwefuga wonna w’oba, mu buli kikolwa n’omulimu ogw’ebweru, ebintu byonna bikufugibwe so si ggwe okufugibwa byo; obe mukama era omulungamya w’ebikolwa byo, so si muddu oba omupakasi obupakasi. Osaanidde okuba omuntu ow’eddembe era Omwebbulaniya ow’amazima, ng’olinnya okutuuka ku kifo n’eddembe ly’abaana ba Katonda, abayimirira waggulu w’ebintu ebya kaakano ne beetegereza ebyo eby’olubeerera; abatunuulira ebiyitawo n’eriiso ery’ekkono, n’eby’omu ggulu n’eriiso ery’eddyo; abo ebintu eby’akaseera be bitasikiriza okutuuka ku kubyekwatako, wabula abakozesa ebintu bino mu ngeri entuufu nga Katonda bwe yalagira era n’ateekawo, Omukozi omukulu, atalekaayo kintu kyonna kitategekeddwa mu bitonde bye.

Bwe kityo, bw’otoomatire n’endabika ey’ebweru yokka mu buli kibaawo, bw’otootunuulire n’amaaso ag’omubiri ebintu by’olaba n’ebyo by’owulira, wabula buli nsonga k’ebe nsonga ki, n’oyingira wamu ne Musa mu Weema okwebuuza ku Mukama, oluusi ojja kuwulira okuddamu kwa Katonda, era okomewo ng’oyigiriziddwa ebintu bingi eby’omu kiseera kino n’ebigenda okujja. Kubanga Musa bulijjo yaddukiranga mu Weema okugonjoola okubuusabuusa n’ebibuuzo, era n’addukira mu kusaba okufuna obuyambi mu kabi ne mu bikolwa ebibi eby’abantu. Bw’otyo naawe osaanidde okuddukira mu kisenge eky’ekyama eky’omutima gwo, ng’osaba n’obunyiikivu obuyambi bwa Katonda.

Ku nsonga eno, nga bwe tusoma, Yoswa n’abaana ba Isirayiri baalimbibwa Abagibyoni kubanga tebaasooka kwebuuza ku Mukama, wabula beesiga nnyo ebigambo ebirungi, bwe batyo ne balimbibwa okutya Katonda okw’obulimba.

fields.title: Omuntu Tasaanidde Kweraliikirira Nnyo Bintu Bye
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, buli kiseera nkwasanga ensonga yo. Nze ndigikolako bulungi mu kiseera ekituufu. Linda nze ngiteeketeeke, era kirikugasa.

Omuyigirizwa

Mukama, nkukwasa byonna n’essanyu, kubanga okweraliikirira kwange tekuyinza kungasa kintu kinene. Naye nandyagadde obutafaayo nnyo bwe ntyo ku bigenda okujja, wabula okwewaayo gy’oli awatali kwekkiriranya, nga bw’osiima.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Mwana wange, emirundi mingi kibaawo omuntu okunoonya n’obunyiikivu ekintu ky’ayagala, naye bw’amala okukifuna n’atandika okulowooza nti tekyali kya kwegombebwa n’akatono; kubanga okwegomba kw’omutima tekunywera ku kintu kimu, wabula kubuuka okuva ku kimu okudda ku kirala. Noolwekyo si kintu kitono omuntu okwefiiriza ne mu bintu ebitono ennyo.

Okukulaakulana okwa nnamaddala okw’omuntu kuli mu kwefiiriza, era omuntu eyeefiirizza ddala ali wa ddembe mu mazima era ali mirembe. Naye omulabe ow’edda, awakanya buli kirungi, tayosa kubakema, wabula emisana n’ekiro ateega emitego egy’akabi okusuula abatali beegendereza mu kitimba ky’obulimba. Mukama agamba nti, “Mutunule musabe, muleme kukemebwa.”

fields.title: Omuntu Talina Kirungi mu Ye Yennyini era Tayinza Kwenyumiriza mu Kintu Kyonna
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

MUKAMA, omuntu kye ki ggwe okumujjukira, omuntu obuntu ggwe okumussaako omwoyo? Omuntu yasaanira ki ggwe okumuwa ekisa kyo? Nnina nsonga ki, Mukama, okwemulugunya bw’onvaako, oba nnyinza kuwakanya ki bw’otokola kye nkusaba? Kino nnyinza okukirowooza n’okukyogera mu mazima gonna: “Mukama, siri kintu, ku bwange sirina kirungi kyonna; mbulwa byonna, era bulijjo nzirayo mu butaba kintu. Era bwe siba na buyambi bwo era nga tonnyweza munda, nfuuka munnyogovu era omugayaavu ddala.”

Naye ggwe, Mukama, tokyuka oli wa lubeerera, bulijjo omulungi, omutuukirivu era omutukuvu; ng’okola byonna bulungi, mu bwenkanya ne mu butukuvu, era ng’obiteekateeka mu magezi. Naye nze, asinga okwanguwa okudda emabega okusinga okweyongerayo mu maaso, sibeera bulijjo mu mbeera emu, kubanga nkyukakyuka ng’ebiseera. Kyokka embeera yange etereera mangu bw’osiima era bw’ogolola omukono gwo okunnyamba. Kubanga ggwe wekka, awatali buyambi bwa bantu, oyinza okunnyamba n’okunnyweza ennyo ne kiba nti omutima gwange tegukyakyuka nate, wabula gukyuke gudde gy’oli era guwummulire mu ggwe wekka. Noolwekyo, singa mbadde mmanyi bulungi okusuula eri okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’ensi, oba olw’okufuna okwemalira ku Katonda, oba olw’obwetaavu obunkaka okunoonya ggwe wekka nga sirina kubudaabudibwa kwa bantu, kale nnandisuubidde ekisa kyo nga nkisaanidde, era ne nsanyukira ekirabo ky’okubudaabudibwa okuggya.

Weebazibwe ggwe, byonna gye biva, buli lwe mbeera obulungi. Mu maaso go ndi butaliimu na kintu ekitaliimu, omuntu omunafu atanywera. Kale nnyinza kwenyumiriza mu ki, era nnyinza ntya okwagala okussibwamu ekitiibwa? Olw’okuba siri kintu? Na kino butaliimu bwereere. Mazima ddala, obutaliimu obusinga bwonna ye kawumpuli omubi ow’okwenyumiriza okutaliimu, kubanga kuggya omuntu ku kitiibwa ekya nnamaddala ne kumunyaga ekisa eky’omu ggulu. Kubanga omuntu bwe yeesiima yennyini, akunyiiza; bw’alulunkanira okutenderezebwa abantu, abulwa empisa ennungi eya nnamaddala. Naye ekitiibwa ekya nnamaddala n’essanyu ettukuvu kwe kwenyumiriza mu ggwe so si mu ggwe kennyini, okusanyukira erinnya lyo okusinga empisa ennungi z’omuntu ze yennyini, n’obutasanyukira kitonde kyonna okuggyako ku lulwo.

Erinnya lyo litenderezebwe, so si lyange. Omulimu gwo gugulumizibwe, so si gwange. Erinnya lyo ettukuvu lyebazibwe, naye nze nneme kuweebwa kutenderezebwa kwonna kwa bantu. Ggwe kitiibwa kyange. Ggwe ssanyu ly’omutima gwange. Mu ggwe mwe nnaayenyumirizanga era mwe nnaasanyukiranga okuzibya obudde, naye ku bwange siryenyumiriza, okuggyako mu bunafu bwange.

Abayudaaya banoonye ekitiibwa ekiva mu bannaabwe. Nze nnaanoonyanga ekyo ekiva eri Katonda yekka. Ekitiibwa kyonna eky’abantu, ettendo lyonna ery’akaseera, n’ebifo byonna eby’ensi, mazima butaliimu na busirusiru bw’obigeraageranya n’ekitiibwa kyo ekitaggwaawo. Ayi Mazima gange, Kusaasira kwange, Katonda wange, Ayi Tiriniti Entukuvu, ggwe wekka oweebwenga ettendo n’ekitiibwa, obuyinza n’ekitiibwa, emirembe n’emirembe egitaggwaawo.

fields.title: Okunyooma Ekitiibwa Kyonna eky’Ensi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tokiteekanga ku mutima bw’olaba abalala nga bassibwamu ekitiibwa era nga bakuzibwa, so nga ggwe onyoomebwa era oswazibwa. Yimusa omutima gwo gye ndi mu ggulu, era okunyoomebwa abantu ku nsi tekulikunakuwaza.

Omuyigirizwa

Mukama, tuzibiddwa amaaso era tubuzibwabuzibwa mangu obutaliimu. Bwe neekebera obulungi, tewali kitonde kyali kinkoze kibi kyonna; noolwekyo sirina kye nnyinza kwemulugunya gy’oli mu bwenkanya. Naye nkwonoonye emirundi mingi era nnyo; kyova olaba buli kitonde kinnwanyisa. Obuswavu n’okunyoomebwa bye binsaanidde mu bwenkanya, naye ggwe ettendo, ekitiibwa n’okugulumizibwa ebikugwanidde. Era bwe sireetegeka kukkiriza n’essanyu okunyoomebwa n’okulekebwa buli kitonde, n’okutwalibwa ng’atali kintu n’akatono, siyinza kufuna mirembe na maanyi ga munda, wadde okwakirwa mu mwoyo oba okwegatta naawe ddala.

fields.title: Emirembe Tegisaanye Kuteekebwa mu Bantu
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, bw’oteeka emirembe gyo mu kitonde kyonna olw’enneewulira yo oba olw’okwagala okubeera naye, olibeera atatebenkedde era ozingiziddwa. Naye bw’oddukira eri Amazima agabeerawo emirembe gyonna era agataggwaawo, tolinakuwala mukwano gwo bw’alifa oba bw’alikuleka. Okwagala kw’olina eri mukwano gwo kusaanidde kusimbibwe mu nze, era ku lwange osaanidde okwagala buli alabika ng’omulungi era nga wa muwendo nnyo gy’oli mu bulamu buno. Awatali nze omukwano tegulina maanyi era teguyinza kubeerera. Okwagala kwe sisiba si kwa mazima wadde okulongoofu.

Noolwekyo osaanidde okufiira ddala okwagala okw’engeri eyo okw’abantu, okutuuka n’okwagala, nga bw’osobola, obutaba na kwegatta na bantu. Omuntu asemberera Katonda nga bw’ayongera okwesuula ewala okuva ku kubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’ensi. Era alinnya waggulu eri Katonda nga bw’akka wansi mu ye yennyini, era nga bw’ayongera okwenyooma mu maaso ge. Oyo eyeetwalira ekirungi kyonna yennyini aziyiza ekisa kya Katonda okuyingira mu mutima gwe, kubanga ekisa ky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu bulijjo kinoonya omutima omwetoowaze.

Singa wali omanyi okwefiiriza ddala n’okwemalamu okwagala kwonna okw’ebitonde, kale nandikujjuzizza ekisa kingi. Bw’otunuulira ebitonde, oggibwako okulaba Omutonzi. Noolwekyo yiga okwewangula mu byonna ku lw’Omukozi wo. Olwo olisobola okutuuka ku kumanya okw’obwakatonda. Naye ekintu kyonna, ne bwe kiba kitono kitya, ekyagalibwa era ekitwalibwa ekisukkiridde, kikulemesa okutuuka ku kirungi ekisingayo era kyonoona emmeeme.

fields.title: Weekuume Okumanya Okutaliimu n’Okw’Ensi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, toganya bigambo bya bantu ebinyuma n’eby’amagezi amangi kukulimba. Kubanga obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu tebuli mu kwogera bwogezi, wabula mu maanyi. Wabula ssaayo omwoyo ku bigambo byange, ebikoleeza omutima era ebyakira amagezi, ebireeta okunakuwala olw’ebibi era ebijjudde okubudaabudibwa okw’engeri nnyingi. Tobisomanga n’ekigendererwa eky’okulabika ng’omuyivu oba ow’amagezi okusinga abalala. Nyiikira okutta obubi bwo, kubanga kino kijja kukugasa okusinga okutegeera ebibuuzo ebizibu ebingi.

Ne bw’oliba ng’osomye era ng’oyize ebintu bingi, kinaakwetaagisanga bulijjo okudda ku musingi guno ogumu: Nze nzuuyo ayigiriza omuntu okumanya, era abato mbawa okutegeera okusinga omuntu kw’ayinza okuyigiriza. Oyo gwe njogera naye aliba wa magezi mangu, era emmeeme ye eriganyulwa. Naye zibasanze abo ababuuza abantu ku bintu bingi eby’okwegomba okumanya, so nga tebafaayo nnyo ku ngeri gye bampeerezaamu.

Ekiseera kijja Kristo, Omuyigiriza w’abayigiriza, Mukama wa bamalayika, lw’alirabika okuwulira ebyo buli muntu by’ayize—kwe kugamba, okwekebejja omuntu ow’omunda owa buli omu. Olwo alinoonya mu Yerusaalemi n’ettabaaza, ebyakwekebwa eby’ekizikiza birireetebwa mu musana, n’empaka z’ennimi z’abantu ne zisirisibwa.

Nze nzuuyo amulisa omutima omwetoowaze mu kaseera akatono ne gutegeera ebisingawo ku mazima ag’olubeerera okusinga ku ebyo bye gwandiyize mu myaka kkumi mu masomero. Njigiriza awatali luyoogaano lwa bigambo oba kulwanagana kwa ndowooza, awatali kwegomba kitiibwa oba kutabuka kwa mpaka.

Nze nzuuyo ayigiriza omuntu okunyooma eby’obugagga eby’ensi n’okukyawa ebintu ebiriwo kaakano, okunoonya eby’olubeerera, okulumwa enjala olw’eggulu, okudduka ekitiibwa n’okugumira ebyesittaza, okuteeka essuubi lyonna mu nze, obutayagala kintu kyonna awatali nze, n’okunjagala n’omutima gwonna okusinga byonna. Kubanga waaliwo omuntu eyanjagala ennyo okuva ku mutima, n’ayiga amazima ag’obwakatonda era n’ayogera eby’ekitalo. Yaganyulwa nnyo olw’okuleka byonna okusinga olw’okusoma ebibuuzo ebizibu.

Abamu mbabuulira ku bintu ebya bulijjo, abalala ku nsonga ez’enjawulo. Abamu mbeeyoleka n’obuwoomi mu bubonero ne mu bifaananyi, ate abalala mbeeyoleka mu kitangaala kingi ne mbabikkulira ebyama. Eddoboozi ly’ebitabo lye limu, naye teriyigiriza bantu bonna kye kimu, kubanga nze ndi munda mu bo Omuyigiriza era Amazima, Akebera emitima, Ategeera ebirowoozo, Asikiriza ebikolwa, nga ngabira buli muntu nga bwe ndaba nga kisaanidde.

fields.title: Teweeraliikiriranga Bintu eby’Ebweru
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, waliwo ensonga nnyingi kirungi ggwe obutazimanya, n’okwetwala ng’omuntu eyafa ku nsi, era ensi yonna ekomereddwa eri ye. Waliwo n’ebintu bingi kirungi okubiyitako ng’oli ng’atawulira, ng’olowooza wabula ku ebyo ebisinga okukuleetera emirembe. Kigasa nnyo okukyuka okuva ku bintu ebitakusanyusa n’okulekera buli muntu endowooza ye, okusinga okwenyigira mu kwogera okw’empaka. Bw’oba ng’oli bulungi ne Katonda era ng’otunuulira omusango gwe, kinaakwanguyira okugumira okuwangulwa.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama, tutuuse wa? Laba, tukaabira okufiirwa okw’akaseera. Tutegana era tweraliikirira olw’amagoba amatono, so ng’okufiirwa emmeeme kwerabirwa era kumala gaddamu ne kujjukirwa omulundi gumu ku gumu. Ekintu ekitali kya muwendo oba eky’omuwendo omutono kye kitwala omwoyo gwaffe, so ng’ekyo ekisinga okwetaagisa kiragajjalirwa—byonna kubanga omuntu yeewaayo yenna eri ebintu eby’ebweru. Era bw’atejjuukiriza mangu, asigala n’essanyu ng’abbidde mu bintu eby’ebweru.

fields.title: Abantu Bonna Tebasaanye Kukkirizibwa, kubanga Kyangu Okusobya mu Kwogera
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

NNYAMBA mu bwetaavu bwange, Ayi Mukama, kubanga obuyambi bw’abantu temuli nsa. Emirundi emeka gye nnalemwa okufuna obwesigwa mu bifo gye nnalowooza nti mbulina! Era emirundi emeka gye nnabusanga gye nnali sisuubira n’akatono! Noolwekyo okusuubira abantu butaliimu, naye obulokozi bw’abatuukirivu buva gy’oli, Ayi Katonda. Erinnya lyo lyebazibwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, mu buli ekitutuukako.

Tuli banafu era tetunywera, tulimbibwa mangu era tukyuka mangu. Muntu ki ayinza okwekuuma n’obwegendereza n’obwerinde bwe butyo obutagwa oluusi mu bulimba oba mu kutabulwa? Oyo akwesiga, Ayi Mukama, era akunoonya n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, tagwa mangu bw’atyo. Era ekizibu bwe kimutuukako, ne bw’aba nga kimuzingizza kitya, ajja kununulwa mangu era abudaabudibwe ggwe. Kubanga tolireka oyo akwesiga okutuuka ku nkomerero ddala.

Mukwano omwesigwa okutuusa ku nkomerero mu nnaku zonna eza mukwano gwe tamala gasangibwa. Naye ggwe, Mukama, era ggwe wekka, oli mwesigwa ddala mu byonna; tewali mulala mwesigwa nga ggwe.

Ayi, nga yali wa magezi emmeeme eyo entukuvu eyagamba nti: “Ebirowoozo byange binywezeddwa era bisimbiddwa mu Kristo.” Singa ekyo kyali kituufu gye ndi, okutya abantu tekwandinteganyizza mangu bwe kutyo, wadde obusaale bw’ebigambo okunteganya. Naye ani ayinza okulaba byonna nga tebinnabaawo n’okwetegekera ebibi byonna? Era oba nga ebintu ebyalabibwa nga tebinnajja emirundi mingi bituluma, ebyo ebitasuubirwa biyinza bitya obutatufumita nnyo? Mazima, lwaki seetegekera bulungi nze omwavu? Lwaki era nneesiga mangu bwe ntyo abalala? Naye tuli bantu buntu, abantu abanafu bokka, wadde ng’abangi batulowooza era batuyita bamalayika.

Ani gwe nnaateeka mu bwesige bwange, Mukama? Ani atali ggwe? Ggwe mazima agatalimba era agatayinza kulimbibwa. Ate buli muntu yenna mulimba, munafu, atanywera era ayinza okusobya, naddala mu bigambo, n’olwekyo omuntu tasaanidde kwanguyiriza kukkiriza ne kiri ekiwulikika ng’ekituufu mu ndabika yaakyo. Nga kyali kya magezi okulabula kwo nti: Mwekuume abantu! Abalabe b’omuntu banaabanga ba mu nju ye. Bwe wabangawo omuntu agamba nti, “Laba ali wano, oba laba ali wali,” temukkirizanga.

Kino nkiyize nga kimbalidde, era nsuubira nti kinyongedde obwegendereza so si busirusiru. Bagamba nti, “Weegendereze, weegendereze, kye nkubuulira kikuumire wekka!” Awo bwe nsirika nga ndowooza nti ensonga ya kyama, oyo ansaba okusirika tayinza kusirika ye yennyini, wabula amangu ago alyamu nze naye yennyini olukwe, n’agenda bw’atyo. Ku ngero ez’engeri eyo ne ku bantu abatafaayo ng’abo onkuume, Ayi Mukama, nneme kugwa mu mikono gyabwe ne mu mpisa zaabwe. Teeka mu kamwa kange ebigambo eby’amazima era ebinywevu, era ggya ewala nange olulimi olw’obukuusa, kubanga kye saagala kugumiikiriza nsaanidde okukyewala mu ngeri yonna.

Ayi, nga kirungi era nga kya mirembe okusirika ku balala, obutakkiriza buli kyogerwa awatali kwawula, obutakyanguyiriza kukibunyisa, okweyabiza abantu batono, okukunoonya bulijjo ggwe akebera emitima, n’obutatwalibwa buli muyaga gw’ebigambo, wabula okwagala nti ebintu byonna, eby’omunda n’eby’ebweru waffe, bikolebwe nga bw’osiima mu kwagala kwo.

Nga kiyamba nnyo mu kukuuma ekisa eky’omu ggulu okudduka amaaso g’abantu, obutanoonya bweru bintu ebirabika ng’ebireeta okwewuunyisa, wabula okugoberera n’obunyiikivu bwonna ebyo ebireeta obunyiikivu bw’omwoyo n’okutereeza obulamu! Bangi nga bafiiriddwa olw’empisa zaabwe ennungi okumanyibwa n’okutenderezebwa mu bwangu! Era nga kigasizza nnyo ddala ekisa bwe kyasigala nga kikwekeddwa mu bulamu buno obunafu, obuli okukemebwa n’olutalo byereere!

fields.title: Okwesiga Katonda nga Bakuwaayiriza
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, nywera era nneesige. Kubanga ebigambo bye ki okuggyako ebigambo obugambo? Bibuuka mu bbanga naye tebiruma na jjinja. Bw’oba omusango gukusinze, lowooza engeri gy’oyinza okwetereeza n’essanyu. Bw’oba nga tolina kibi ky’omanyi, lowooza nti oyagala okukigumira ku lwa Katonda. Si kintu kinene ggwe okugumiikiriza ebigambo oluusi, kubanga tonnaba kufuna maanyi kugumira bikonde bikakali.

Era lwaki ensonga ezo entono zikufumita omutima, okuggyako nti okyali wa mubiri era ofaayo ku bantu okusinga bw’osaanidde? Toyagala kunenyezebwa olw’ensobi zo, era weekweka mu kwewolereza kubanga otya okunyoomebwa. Naye weekebere munda ddala, ojja kulaba nti ensi ekyali nnamu mu ggwe, mu kwegomba okutaliimu okusanyusa abantu. Kubanga bw’oddukako okutoowazibwa n’okuswazibwa olw’ensobi zo, kirabikira ddala nti toli mwetoowaze mu mazima era tofiiridde ddala nsi, era nti ensi tekomereddwa mu ggwe.

Wuliriza ekigambo kyange, era tolitwala bigambo bya bantu omutwalo nga bya muwendo. Laba, singa buli kintu eky’ettima ekiyinza okuyiiyizibwa kyogerwa ku ggwe, kyandikukoze kabi ki singa okibuusa amaaso byonna n’otabifaako okusinga bw’ofaayo ku kakonda k’omuddo? Kyandiyinzizza wadde okukunoggolako oluviiri lumu ku mutwe gwo?

Oyo atakuuma mutima gwe munda mu ye, era atalina Katonda mu maaso ge, akyuusibwa mangu ekigambo eky’okunyooma. Naye oyo anneesiga, era atayagala kunywerera ku ndowooza ye, aliba wa ddembe eri okutya abantu. Kubanga nze ndi mulamuzi era ategeera ebyama byonna. Mmanyi engeri byonna gye bibaawo. Mmanyi oyo akola akabi n’oyo akabonaabona nako. Ekigambo ekyo kyava gye ndi, era kyabaawo nga nzikirizza, ebirowoozo by’omu mitima gy’abantu bangi biryoke bimanyibwe. Ndisalira omusango abazzi b’emisango n’abatalina musango; naye nnayagala okusooka okubagezesa bombi mu kusala omusango okw’ekyama.

Obujulizi bw’abantu butera okulimba, naye omusango gwange gwa mazima—gulinywera era teguliwambulwa. Gukwekeddwa eri bangi era gumanyiddwa batono bokka. Kyokka tegusobya n’akatono era teguyinza kusobya, wadde nga mu maaso g’abatalina magezi tegulabika nga mutuufu.

Noolwekyo osaanidde okujja gye ndi mu buli kusalawo, nga teweesigama ku ndowooza yo. Kubanga omutuukirivu tateganyizibwa, ne bwe kiba kiki ekimutuukako okuva eri Katonda. Ne bwe bamuwaayiriza mu butali bwenkanya, tateganyizibwa nnyo. Era teyeenyumiriza bwereere bw’ayimbulwa abalala mu bwenkanya. Alowooza nti nze nkebera omutima, ngezesa emmeeme y’abantu, era nti sisala musango okusinziira ku ndabika ya bintu oba ku ebyo abantu bye balaba. Kubanga ekyo okulamula kw’abantu kye kutwala ng’ekisaanira okutenderezebwa, emirundi mingi kisaanira okunenyezebwa mu maaso gange.

Omuyigirizwa

Ayi Mukama Katonda, Omulamuzi omutuukirivu, ow’amaanyi era omugumiikiriza, ggwe amanyi obunafu n’obubi bw’abantu, beera amaanyi gange n’obwesige bwange bwonna, kubanga omuntu wange ow’omunda tammala. Ggwe omanyi kye simanyi, noolwekyo nsaanidde okwetoowaza buli lwe banvunaana, n’okukigumira n’obuwombeefu. Kale, onsonyiwe mu kusaasira kwo olwa buli kye nnasobya mu nsonga eno, era ompe nate ekisa eky’okugumiikiriza okusingawo. Okusaasira kwo okungi kunsinga okugasa mu kufuna okusonyiyibwa okusinga obutuukirivu bwe nneerowooleza mu kwewolereza ebyama by’omuntu wange ow’omunda. Era newaakubadde nze seemanyiiko nsonga yonna, wabula ekyo tekimpeesa butuukirivu, kubanga awatali kusaasira kwo, mu maaso go tewali n’omu atuukiridde.

fields.title: Buli Kugezesebwa Kusaanye Kugumiikirizibwa olw’Obulamu Obutaggwaawo
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, toganya mirimu gy’otandise ku lwange kukumenya, era toganya bizibu, ne bwe biva wa, kukugwisa; wabula mu byonna ekisuubizo kyange kikunyweze era kikubudaabude. Nze nsobola okukusasula okusukka ku buli kipimo na buli kigero.

Tolitegana wano okumala ebbanga ddene, era tolinyigirizibwanga nnaku bulijjo. Lindako akaseera katono, ojja kulaba ebibi nga bikoma mangu. Essaawa erijja okutegana kwonna n’emitawaana byonna lwe birikoma. Byonna ebiyita n’ebiseera bya katono.

Ky’okola, kikole bulungi. Kola n’obwesigwa mu nnimiro yange ey’emizabbibu. Nze ndiba mpeera yo. Wandiika, soma, yimba, kaaba, sirika, saba, era gumira ebizibu ng’omusajja. Obulamu obutaggwaawo busaanira ebyo byonna n’entalo ezisinga ezo. Waliwo olunaku olumanyiddwa Mukama emirembe lwe girijja, era olwo tewaliba misana wadde kiro nga bwe kiri kaakano, wabula ekitangaala ekitaggwaawo, okumasamasa okutaliiko kkomo, emirembe egy’olubeerera n’okuwummula okutaliiko kabi. Olwo tolyogera nti: “Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa?” wadde okukaaba nti: “Zinsanze, kubanga obugenyi bwange mu nsi buno bwongezeddwayo.” Kubanga olwo okufa kuligobebwa, era waliba obulamu obulungi obutaggwaawo. Tewaliba kweraliikirira olwo, wabula essanyu eririmu omukisa, n’okubeera awamu okuwoomu era okw’ekitiibwa.

Singa wali olaba engule ez’olubeerera ez’abatukuvu mu ggulu, n’ekitiibwa ekinene kye basanyukiramu kaakano—abo abaali batwalibwa ng’abanyoomebwa mu nsi muno, era ng’abatasaanira na bulamu bwennyini—mazima wandyetoowazizza amangu ago okutuuka ku ttaka ddala, era n’onoonya okugondera bonna okusinga okulagira wadde omu. Era tewandyegombye nnaku ennungi ez’obulamu buno, wabula wandisanyuse okubonaabona ku lwa Katonda, ng’otwala ng’amagoba go agasinga okutwalibwa ng’atali kintu mu bantu.

Ayi, singa ebintu bino byakusikiriza ne biyingira wala mu mutima gwo, wandiyinzizza otya okwemulugunya wadde omulundi gumu? Okugezesebwa kwonna tekusaanidde kugumiikirizibwa olw’obulamu obutaggwaawo? Mazima, okufiirwa oba okufuna obwakabaka bwa Katonda si kintu kitono.

Kale yimusa amaaso go eri eggulu. Laba nze, era wamu nange abatukuvu bange bonna. Baalina okugezesebwa okunene mu bulamu buno, naye kaakano basanyuka. Babudaabudiddwa. Kaakano bali mirembe era bawummudde. Era balibeera nange emirembe gyonna mu bwakabaka bwa Kitange.

fields.title: Olunaku olw’Olubeerera n’Ennaku z’Obulamu Buno
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI ekisulo ekisinga okuba eky’essanyu eky’ekibuga ekya waggulu! Ayi olunaku olusinga okumasamasa olw’olubeerera, ekiro lwe kitazikiza, naye amazima agasinga bwonna ge galwakira bulijjo! Ayi olunaku olusanyusa bulijjo era olutaliiko kabi bulijjo, olutakyuka kudda mu mbeera ey’ekifuulannenge! Ayi, olunaku olwo lwakeyo, ebintu bino byonna eby’akaseera bikome! Lubikka abatukuvu nga bonna bamasamasa n’okumasamasa okw’omu ggulu, naye ffe abatambuze ku nsi lulabika wala ng’abali mu ndabirwamu eteraba bulungi. Abatuuze b’omu ggulu bamanyi olunaku olwo bwe lusanyusa, naye abaana ba Kaawa abali mu buwaŋŋanguse bakaaba nti kuno kwa bukaawu era kwa kukooya.

Ennaku z’obulamu buno mpi era mbi, zijjudde ennaku n’okulumwa. Wano omuntu ayonoonebwa ebibi bingi, akwatibwa mu mitego gy’okwegomba kungi, afuulibwa omuddu w’okutya kungi, era azitoowererwa okweraliikirira kungi. Atabulwatabulwa okwegomba okumanya bingi, azingizibwa mu butaliimu bungi, yeetooloddwa ensobi nnyingi era akooyezebwa emirimu mingi, anyigirizibwa okukemebwa, anafuyizibwa essanyu ly’ensi, era abonyaabonyezebwa obwetaavu.

Ayi, ebibi bino birikoma ddi? Ndisumululwa ddi mu buddu obw’ennaku obw’obubi? Mukama, ndikulowoozaako ggwe wekka ddi? Ndisanyukira ddi mu ggwe mu bujjuvu? Ndibeera ddi awatali kiziyiza, mu ddembe ery’amazima, nga siriiko kinnuma mu birowoozo wadde mu mubiri? Emirembe eminywevu girijja ddi, egitatabulwa era egitaliiko kabi, emirembe egy’omunda n’egy’ebweru, emirembe egikuumiddwa ku njuyi zonna? Ayi Yesu omulungi, ndiyimirira ddi okukwekaliriza? Ndirowooza ddi ku kitiibwa ky’obwakabaka bwo? Olibeera ddi byonna mu byonna gye ndi? Ayi, ndibeera ddi naawe mu bwakabaka bwo obwo, bwe wateekerateekera abaagalwa bo okuva emirembe n’emirembe?

Nsigadde ndi mwavu era mu buwaŋŋanguse mu nsi ey’abalabe, buli lunaku mwe mulabika entalo n’ebisobyo ebinene ennyo. Budaabuda obuwaŋŋanguse bwange, kkakkanya ennaku yange. Okwegomba kwange kwonna kuli gy’oli. Buli kubudaabudibwa ensi eno kw’ewa kumbeerera mugugu. Njagala okukunyumirwa okumpi ennyo, naye siyinza kukutuukako. Njagala okwekwata ennyo ku bintu eby’omu ggulu, naye ensonga ez’akaseera n’okwegomba okutattiddwa binzitoowerera. Mu birowoozo njagala okubeera waggulu w’ebintu byonna, naye omubiri gunkaka okubigondera nga sikyagala. Bwe ntyo nnwana nange nzekka, nze omunaku, ne neefuukira omugugu, ng’omwoyo gwange gunoonya okulinnya waggulu, ate omubiri gwange nga gunoonya okukka wansi. Ayi, nga mbonaabona nnyo munda bwe ndowooza ku bintu eby’omu ggulu; bwe nsaba, ebirowoozo bingi eby’omubiri binjuumuukirira!

Ayi Katonda wange, tombera wala, so tonyiigira muweereza wo. Myansa, ebirowoozo ebyo bisaasaane; lasa obusaale bwo, ebisiikirize by’omulabe bidduke. Sikiriza ebiwulizo byange gy’oli era onneerabize ebintu byonna eby’ensi. Mpa ekisa okusuula amangu ebirowoozo byonna ebibi n’okubinyooma. Nnyamba, Ayi Mazima ag’omu ggulu, obutaliimu bwonna buleme kunkyusa. Jjangu, Obuwoomi obw’omu ggulu, obutali bulongoofu bwonna budduke mu maaso go.

Era onsonyiwe, onkwatire ekisa, buli lwe ndowooza ku kintu kyonna ekitali ggwe nga nsaba. Kubanga njatula mu mazima nti ntera nnyo okutabulwatabulwa. Emirundi mingi sibeera we nnyimiridde oba we ntudde mu mubiri; wabula mbeera ebirowoozo byange gye bintwala. Ebirowoozo byange we biri, nange we mbeera; era emirundi mingi ebirowoozo byange bibeera okwagala kwange gye kuli. Ekyo ekisanyusa mu buzaaliranwa, oba ekyagalibwa olw’empisa, kinjijira mangu. Kyova ggwe, Amazima gennyini, wagamba lwatu nti: “Kubanga obugagga bwo gye buli n’omutima gwo gye gunaabeeranga.” Bwe njagala eggulu, ndowooza n’essanyu ku bintu eby’omu ggulu. Bwe njagala ensi, nsanyukira essanyu ly’ensi era ennakuwala olw’ebizibu byayo. Bwe njagala omubiri, emirundi mingi ndowooza ku bintu eby’omubiri. Bwe njagala eby’omwoyo, nsanyuka okulowooza ku nsonga ez’omwoyo. Kubanga buli kye njagala, mba mwetegefu okukyogerako n’okukiwulirako.
