Alina omukisa omuntu oyo, ku lulwo, Ayi Mukama, aleka ebitonde byonna, alwanyisa obutonde bwe, akomerera okwegomba kw’omubiri mu bunyiikivu bw’omwoyo, alyoke akuwe okusaba okulongoofu n’omuntu ow’omunda omuteefu, era bw’amala okuggyamu ebintu byonna eby’ensi munda ne kungulu, n’asaanira okuyingira mu bibiina by’abayimbi eby’omu ggulu.

fields.title: Okwegomba Obulamu Obutaggwaawo; n’Empeera Ennene Ezisuubizibwa Abo Abalwana
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, bw’owulira okwegomba essanyu ery’olubeerera nga kufukiddwa ku ggwe okuva waggulu, era bw’oyaayaanira okuva mu weema y’omubiri olyoke olabe ekitiibwa kyange awatali kutya nti kiyinza okukyuka, yanjuluza omutima gwo era oyanirize okuluŋŋamizibwa kuno okutukuvu n’obunyiikivu bwonna. Webaze nnyo okuva ku ntobo y’omutima Obulungi obw’omu ggulu obukukwata n’okutegeera okwenkanidde awo, obukukyalira n’ekisa kingi bwe kityo, obukusiikuula n’ebbugumu bwe lityo, era obukuwanirira n’amaanyi bwe gatyo, oleme okukka wansi mu by’ensi olw’obuzito bwo. Kubanga kino tokifuna lwa kulowooza kwo oba lwa kufuba kwo, wabula olw’ekisa eky’omu ggulu ekikukkakkanidde n’olw’okukutunuulira kwa Katonda. Era ekigendererwa kyakyo kwe kukuyamba okukulaakulana mu mpisa ennungi ne mu bwetoowaze obusingawo, weetegekere okugezesebwa okujja, ofube okunneegattako n’okwagala kwonna okw’omutima gwo, era ompeereze n’okwagala okw’ebbugumu.

Mwana wange, emirundi mingi omuliro bwe guba gwaka, ennimi zaagwo tezirinnya waggulu awatali mukka. Bwe kityo, okwegomba kw’abamu kwaka nga kwolekera eby’omu ggulu, naye nga tebannawona kukemebwa okw’okwagala okw’omubiri. N’olwekyo si lwa kitiibwa kya Katonda kyokka ekirongoofu kye bakolera bwe bamwegayirira n’obunyiikivu obwenkanidde awo. Era n’okwegomba kwo kw’ogamba nti kwa maanyi nnyo emirundi mingi kuba bwe kutyo. Kubanga ekitabuddwamu okwenoonyeza ebibyo si kirongoofu era si kituukiridde.

Kale, tosabanga ekyo ekikusanyusa era ekikunyangukira, wabula ekyo kye nsiima era ekireeta ekitiibwa kyange, kubanga bw’onoosala amagezi mu butuufu, osaanidde okukulembeza n’okugoberera okwagala kwange, so si kwegomba kwo oba buli ky’oyagala.

Mmanyi bye weegomba era mpulidde ebikkowe byo eby’emirundi mingi. Oyagala dda okugabana wamu n’abaana ba Katonda ekitiibwa eky’okuba mu ddembe. Weegomba dda essanyu ly’amaka ag’olubeerera, ensi ey’omu ggulu ejjudde essanyu. Naye ekiseera ekyo tekinnatuuka. Wakyaliwo ekiseera ekirala, ekiseera eky’olutalo, eky’okutegana n’eky’okugezesebwa. Oyaayaanira okujjuzibwa ekirungi ekisingayo, naye kaakano tosobola kukifuna. Nze nzennyini kye Kirungi ekyo ekisinga byonna. Nnindiriranga, okutuusa ng’obwakabaka bwa Katonda buzze.

Okyalina okugezesebwa ku nsi, n’okutendekebwa mu bintu bingi. Oluusi onooweebwa okubudaabudibwa, naye obujjuvu bwakwo bwonna tebukuweebwa. Kale guma omwoyo, obe n’amaanyi okukola n’okugumiikiriza ebyo ebikontana n’obutonde.

Kikugwanidde okwambala omuntu omuggya. Kikugwanidde okukyusibwa n’ofuuka omuntu omulala. Emirundi mingi kikugwanidde okukola by’otoyagala kukola, n’okulekayo by’oyagala. Ebisanyusa abalala biribagendera bulungi; ebikusanyusa ggwe tebirikugendera bulungi. Ebigambo by’abalala biriwulirwa; by’oyogera biritwalibwa ng’ebitali kintu. Abalala balisaba ne baweebwa; ggwe olisaba n’otoweebwa. Abalala balifuna ettutumu ddene mu bantu; ggwe tewaliba akwogerako. Abalala baliweebwa okukola kino oba kiri; ggwe olitwalibwa ng’atalina mugaso. Olw’ebyo byonna obutonde oluusi bulinakuwala, era kiriba kintu kikulu nnyo bw’oligumiikiriza ennaku eyo mu kasirise. Kubanga mu ngeri ezo n’endala nnyingi ezifaanana bwe zityo, omuweereza wa Mukama omwesigwa atera okugezesebwa, okulaba bw’asobola okwefiiriza n’okwemenya mu byonna.

Kumpi tewali kintu kikwetaagisa nnyo kufiira ku ggwe wennyini ng’okulaba n’okugumiikiriza ebintu ebikontana n’okwagala kwo, naddala ng’ebyo by’olagiddwa bifaanana ng’ebitakunyangukira oba ebitaliimu mugaso. Olwo, kubanga oli wansi w’obuyinza, era nga toyaŋŋanga kuwakanya buyinza obukusinga, kirabika nga kizibu okugondera okwagala kw’omulala n’okuleka ddala endowooza yo.

Naye lowooza, mwana wange, ku kibala ky’okutegana kuno, bwe kujja okuggwaako amangu, n’empeera ennene gye kulisasulwa, olwo tekujja kukunakuwaza, wabula obugumiikiriza bwo bujja kufuna okubudaabudibwa okw’amaanyi ennyo. Kubanga mu kifo ky’okwagala okutono kw’oleka kaakano mu bwangu, mu ggulu by’oyagala biribanga bikolebwa bulijjo. Eyo ddala olisanga buli ky’oyinza okwegomba. Eyo olibeera na buli kirungi awatali kutya kukibulwa. Eyo okwagala kwo kuliba kumu n’okwange emirembe gyonna. Tekulyegomba kintu kyonna ebweru wange, wadde ekintu kyonna ku lwakwo. Eyo tewaliba akuwakanya, tewaliba akwemulugunyaako, tewaliba akulemesa, era tewaliba kikuziyiza. Byonna by’oyagala biriba eyo, nga bijjuza okwagala kwo era nga bikumatiza ddala. Eyo ndikuwa ekitiibwa mu kifo ky’okuvumibwa kwe wagumiikiriza wano; mu kifo ky’ennaku yo ndikuwa ekyambalo ky’okutendereza, ne mu kifo ky’ekifo ekisembayo wansi ndikuwa entebe ey’obuyinza emirembe gyonna. Eyo ekibala ky’ekitiibwa kirirabika, okutegana okw’okwenenya kulisanyuka, n’okugondera okw’obwetoowaze kulitikkirwa engule ey’ekitiibwa.

Kale, weetoowazenga wansi w’okwagala kwa bonna, era tofaayo ku ani yayogera kino oba ani yalagira kiri. Naye kibe ky’ofaako ennyo, bwe walagirwa ekintu, oba ne bwe bakuwa akabonero obubonero nti kyetaagibwa, ka kibe nga kiva eri akukulira oba ali wansi wo oba eyenkanankana naawe, okikkirize n’omutima omulungi era ofube n’obwesimbu okukituukiriza. Omu k’anoonye kino, omulala kiri. Omu k’enyumirize mu kino, omulala mu kiri, era bombi batenderezebwe emirundi lukumi. Naye ggwe, tosanyukanga mu kimu wadde mu kirala, wabula mu kwenyooma kwokka n’okusiima kwange n’ekitiibwa kyange. Kino kibe kye weegomba: Katonda agulumizibwe mu ggwe, oba okuyita mu bulamu oba okuyita mu kufa.

fields.title: Omuntu Ali mu Kiwuubaalo bw’Asaanidde Okwewaayo mu Mikono gya Katonda
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

MUKAMA Katonda, Kitaffe Omutukuvu, otenderezebwe kaakano n’emirembe gyonna. Kubanga nga bw’oyagala, bwe kityo bwe kikolebwa; era ky’okola kirungi. Omuddu wo asanyukire mu ggwe—so si mu ye yennyini wadde mu mulala yenna, kubanga ggwe wekka ggwe ssanyu ery’amazima. Ggwe ssuubi lyange era ggwe ngule yange. Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, ggwe ssanyu lyange n’ekitiibwa kyange.

Omuddu wo alina ki ky’ataaweebwa ggwe, era awatali kusaanira kwe n’akamu? Ebintu byonna by’owaddeyo bibyo, n’ebintu byonna by’otonze bibyo.

Ndi mwavu era ntegana okuva mu buvubuka bwange, era emmeeme yange erina ennaku oluusi okutuusa n’okukaaba amaziga. Era oluusi omwoyo gwange gweraliikirira olw’okubonaabona okunjolekedde. Nneegomba essanyu ly’emirembe. Nkwegayirira n’obunyiikivu ompe emirembe gy’abaana bo b’oliisa mu kitangaala ky’okubudaabudibwa. Bw’onoowa emirembe, bw’onooteeka munda essanyu ettukuvu, emmeeme y’omuddu wo ejja kujjula ennyimba entukuvu era yeemalire ku kukutendereza. Naye bw’oneeggyako, nga bw’otera okukola emirundi mingi ddala, tajja kusobola kutambulira mu kkubo ly’ebiragiro byo, wabula ajja kuwalirizibwa okwekuba mu kifuba n’okufukamira, kubanga leero gy’ali tefaanana jjo ne luli, ekitangaala kyo bwe kyayakanga ku mutwe gwe, n’akuumibwa mu kisiikirize ky’ebiwaawaatiro byo okuva ku kukemebwa okwamulumbanga.

Ayi Kitaffe omutuukirivu, atenderezebwa bulijjo, ekiseera kituuse omuddu wo okugezesebwa. Ayi Kitaffe omwagalwa, kisaana mu kiseera kino omuddu wo abonaabone ekintu ku lulwo. Ayi Kitaffe, assibwamu ekitiibwa emirembe gyonna, ekiseera kye wamanya okuva emirembe n’emirembe kisembedde, omuddu wo mw’anaanyigirizibwa ebweru okumala akaseera katono, naye nga munda abeera nawe bulijjo.

Anyoomebwemu katono, atoowazibwe, alemererwe mu maaso g’abantu, abonyebonyezebwe okubonaabona n’obulumi, alyoke azuukire nate wamu naawe mu matulutulu g’ekitangaala ekiggya, era agulumizibwe mu ggulu.

Kitaffe Omutukuvu, ggwe wakiteekateeka era ggwe wakyagala bwe kityo. Ekibaddewo kye kyo kye walagira. Kubanga kino kisa eri mukwano gwo, okubonaabona n’okweraliikirira mu nsi olw’okwagala kwo, k’obe ng’okikkiriza okumutuukako emirundi emeka oba okuyita mu ani.

Tewali kibaawo mu nsi awatali kuteekateeka kwo n’okulabirira kwo, era awatali nsonga. Kirungi gye ndi, Ayi Mukama, okuba nti wantoowaza, ndyoke njige obwenkanya bw’emisango gyo, era nsuule eri okwetwala n’amalala gonna ag’omutima. Kingasa nti amaaso gange ne gajjula ensonyi, ndyoke nkutunuulire ggwe okusinga abantu okufuna okubudaabudibwa. Mu kino era njize okutya omusango gwo ogutategeerekeka, ogugwa ku batuukirivu n’abatali batuukirivu kyenkanyi, naye nga si awatali bwenkanya na butuukirivu.

Weebale kuba tewanzigyako bibi, wabula wankuba n’emiggo egikaawa, ng’onteekako ennaku, ng’ompereza okunyigirizibwa ebweru ne munda. Wansi w’eggulu tewali ayinza kumbudaabuda okuggyako ggwe, Mukama wange Katonda, Omusawo ow’omu ggulu ow’emmeeme, ggwe afumita era ggwe awonya, ggwe atwala emagombe ate n’azuukiza. Okukangavvula kwo kuli ku nze, era omuggo gwo gwennyini gujja kunjigiriza.

Laba, Kitaffe omwagalwa, ndi mu mikono gyo. Nfukamira wansi w’okukangavvula kwo okuntereeza. Kuba omugongo gwange n’ensingo yange, ndyoke nkyusize obukyamu bwange eri okwagala kwo. Onfuule omugoberezi akutya era omwetoowaze, nga bw’otera okukola mu bulungi bwo, ndyoke ntambulenga nga bw’ondaga na buli kabonero. Neewaayo gy’oli, nze n’ebyange byonna, ontereeze, kubanga kirungi okubonerezebwa wano okusinga oluvannyuma.

Ggwe omanyi ebintu byonna awatali kyawulamu, era tewali kikukwekeddwa mu muntu ow’omunda ow’omuntu. Ebigenda okubaawo obimanyi nga tebinnabaawo, era tewali kyetaagisa muntu yenna kukuyigiriza oba kukujjukiza ebikolebwa ku nsi. Omanyi ekinaaleeta okukulaakulana kwange, n’obungi bw’okubonaabona okunaayamba okwoza obusagwa bw’empisa embi. Onkole nga bw’osiima era tonyoomanga bulamu bwange obw’ebibi, obutamanyiddwa muntu yenna bulungi bwe butyo oba mu bulambulukufu bwe butyo okuggyako ggwe wekka.

Mpa, Ayi Mukama, ekisa okumanya ebisaanidde okumanyibwa, okutendereza ekisinga okukusanyusa, okutwala ng’eky’omuwendo ekyo ekirabika nga kye kisinga okuba eky’omuwendo gy’oli, n’okukyawa ekitali kirongoofu mu maaso go.

Tondekanga kusala misango nga nsinziira ku kitangaala ky’amaaso gange ag’omubiri, wadde okusalawo nga nsinziira ku bye mpulira n’amatu g’abantu abatamanyi. Wabula nsobole okwawula mu kusala okw’amazima wakati w’ebirabika n’eby’omwoyo, era bulijjo nnoonye okusinga byonna ekyo ky’osiima. Okutegeera kw’abantu kutera okukyama mu kusala kwakwo, n’abo abaagala ensi eno nabo bakyama nga baagala ebirabika byokka. Omuntu agasibwa ki olw’okutwalibwa abantu nti mukulu? Omulimba alimba omulimba, ow’obutaliimu alimba ow’obutaliimu, omuzibe w’amaaso alimba omuzibe w’amaaso, omunafu alimba omunafu buli lw’abagulumiza, era mu mazima okutendereza kwe okw’obusirusiru kubaswaza nnyo okusingawo. Kubanga, ng’Omutukuvu Francis omwetoowaze bw’agamba, omuntu kyali mu maaso go, ky’ekyo ky’ali, tasukkawo.

fields.title: Bwe Tutasobola Kutuuka ku Kisingayo, Tusaanidde Okukola Emirimu Egy’Obwetoowaze
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tosobola kubeera bulijjo mu kwegomba okw’ebbugumu ennyo okw’empisa ennungi, oba okusigala ku ddaala erya waggulu ery’okufumiitiriza, naye olw’ekibi ky’omuntu oluusi kikugwanidde okukka eri ebintu ebya wansi n’okwetikka omugugu gw’obulamu buno obuvunda, wadde nga tokyagala era ng’okooye. Kasita oba ng’oyambadde omubiri ogufa, ojja kubonaabona n’obukoowu n’obuzito bw’omutima. N’olwekyo osaanidde okukungubagira mu mubiri omugugu gw’omubiri ogukulemesa okwewaayo obutakoma eri okwegezaamu eby’omwoyo n’okufumiitiriza ku bya Katonda.

Mu mbeera ng’eyo, kirungi weemalire ku mirimu egy’obwetoowaze egy’okungulu, weezze buggya mu bikolwa ebirungi, olindirire n’obwesige obutanyeenyezeka okukyala kwange okw’omu ggulu, ogumiikirize okuwaŋŋangusibwa kwo n’obukalu bw’ebirowoozo okutuusa lwe nnaakukyalira nate ne nkuggyako okweraliikirira kwonna. Kubanga ndikwerabiza okutegana kwo era ndikuwa okunyumirwa emirembe egy’omunda. Ndyanjuluza mu maaso go ennimiro engazi ez’Ebyawandiikibwa, olyoke n’omutima ogugaziye otandike okukulaakulana mu kkubo ly’ebiragiro byange. Era olyogera nti: okubonaabona kw’omu biseera bino tekusaanira kugeraageranyizibwa n’ekitiibwa ekiritubikulirwa.

fields.title: Omuntu Tasaanidde Kwetwala nti Agwanidde Okubudaabudibwa, Wabula nti Agwanidde Okubonerezebwa
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

MUKAMA, sisaanira kubudaabudibwa kwo wadde okukyalirwa kwonna okw’omwoyo. N’olwekyo, onkola mu bwenkanya bw’ondeka nga ndi mwavu era nga ndi bw’omu. Kubanga ne bwe nnandiyiye amaziga ag’enkana ennyanja, era sandisaanidde kubudaabudibwa kwo. Kale ngwanidde kukubibwa mbooko n’okubonerezebwa kyokka, kubanga nkunyiizizza emirundi mingi era mu ngeri ey’amaanyi, era nnyonoonye nnyo mu bintu bingi. N’olwekyo, mu bwenkanya bwonna, sisaanira kubudaabudibwa kwonna.

Naye ggwe, Ayi Katonda ow’ekisa era ow’okusaasira, atayagala mirimu gyo kuzikirira, osiima okubudaabuda omuddu wo okusinga bw’asaanira era okusukka ekigero ky’abantu, olyoke olage obugagga bw’obulungi bwo eri ebibya eby’okusaasirwa. Kubanga okubudaabuda kwo tekufaanana bigambo bya bantu.

Nkoze ki, Mukama, ggwe okumpa okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’omu ggulu? Nzijukira nti sikolanga kirungi kyonna, wabula bulijjo mbadde mwangu okwonoona era mugayaavu okwekyusa. Ago ge mazima. Siyinza kugeegaana. Singa ŋŋamba ekirala, wandiyimiridde okunnwanyisa, era tewandibaddewo yenna kunnwanirira. Ngwanidde ki olw’ebibi byange okuggyako ggeyeena n’omuliro ogutaggwaawo?

Mu mazima, njatula nti ngwanidde okunyoomebwa n’okugayibwa kwonna. So tekisaana nze okujjukirwa mu baweereza bo abeemalidde ku ggwe. Era wadde nga kinzibuwalira okuwulira kino, naye olw’amazima nja kwerumiriza ebibi byange, ndyoke nsobole mu ngeri ennyangu okusaanira okwegayirira okusaasira kwo. Kiki kye nnaayogera, nze alina omusango era ajjudde ensonyi zonna? Olulimi lwange teruyinza kwogera kirala okuggyako kino kyokka: “Nnyonoonye, Ayi Mukama, nnyonoonye; nsaasira era onsonyiwe. Ndeka akaseera katono nfuke ennaku yange, nga sinnaba kugenda mu nsi eri ey’ekizikiza ebikkiddwako ekisiikirize ky’okufa.”

Kiki ky’osinga okwetaaga okuva ku mwonoonyi alina omusango era omunaku, okuggyako okunakuwala olw’ebibi bye n’okwetoowaza ku lw’ebibi bye? Mu nnaku ey’amazima n’obwetoowaze bw’omutima essuubi ly’okusonyiyibwa mwe lizaalibwa, omuntu ow’omunda eyeeraliikiridde atabaganyizibwa, ekisa kizuulibwa, omuntu akuumibwa obusungu obugenda okujja, era Katonda n’oyo eyeenenya basisinkana n’okunywegera okutukuvu.

Gy’oli, Ayi Mukama, okunakuwala olw’ebibi okw’obwetoowaze ssaddaaka esiimibwa, ssaddaaka ewooma okusinga evvumbe ly’obubaane. Era kino ge mafuta ag’akaloosa g’oyagala gafukibwe ku bigere byo ebitukuvu, kubanga omutima ogumenyese era oguboneredde tewagugayangako. Wano we wali ekiddukiro okuva ku maanyi g’obusungu bw’omulabe. Wano we watereezebwa era we wanaazibwa buli bujama obukwatiddwa awalala.

fields.title: Ekisa kya Katonda Tekiweebwa Abo Abalowooza eby’Ensi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, ekisa kyange kya muwendo. Tekikkiriza kutabulwamu bintu bya kungulu wadde okubudaabudibwa okw’ensi. N’olwekyo suula eri buli kiziyiza ekisa, bw’oba oyagala kifukibwe mu ggwe.

Noonya okuddayo munda mu ggwe. Yagalanga okubeera wekka ggwe wennyini. Tonoonyanga kunyumya na muntu yenna, wabula fukanga okusaba okw’okwemalira ku Katonda eri Katonda, olyoke okuume ebirowoozo byo nga binakuwalidde ebibi n’omutima gwo nga mulongoofu.

Ensi yonna gitwale ng’etali kintu. Kulembeza okubeera ne Katonda okusinga emirimu gyonna egy’okungulu, kubanga tosobola kumpeereza nze ate mu kiseera kye kimu n’onyumirwa ebintu eby’okungulu. Kikugwanidde okwewala abantu b’omanyi n’emikwano emyagalwa, era okuume ebirowoozo byo nga tebiriimu kubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’ekiseera. Bw’atyo omutume Peetero Omutukuvu alina omukisa bw’asaba abakkiriza ba Kristo beetwalenga ng’abagenyi era abatambuze mu nsi.

Obwesige bunene nnyo bw’aliba nabwo mu ssaawa y’okufa oyo atasibiddwa ku nsi eno na kwagala kwonna. Naye emmeeme endwadde temanyi kye kitegeeza okuba n’omutima ogwawuddwa bwe gutyo ku bintu byonna, so n’omuntu ow’obutonde tamanyi ddembe lya muntu wa mwoyo. Kyokka bw’aba ayagala ddala okuba ow’omwoyo, kimugwanidde okwefiiriza abagwira n’emikwano, era tasaanidde kwegendereza muntu yenna okusinga bwe yeegendereza yennyini.

Bw’oneewangula ddala, ojja kusinga mangu okufuga ebintu ebirala byonna. Obuwanguzi obutuukiridde kwe kwewangula. Kubanga oyo eyeefuga bw’atyo, ng’okwegomba kw’omubiri kuwulira amagezi, n’amagezi ne gampulira mu byonna, ddala oyo yeewangudde era ye mufuzi w’ensi.

Kale, bw’oba oyagala okulinnya ku ddaala lino erya waggulu, kikugwanidde okutandika ng’omusajja, n’oteeka embazzi ku kikolo, okusiguukulula n’okuzikiriza okwagala kwonna okukwekeddwa okutali kwa nteeko okw’omuntu yennyini oba okw’ebintu by’ensi. Okuva mu kibi kino eky’okweyagala ennyo mwe muva kumpi buli kibi ekirala kyonna ekisaanidde okusimbulwa. Era ekibi kino bwe kiwangulwa, ne kifugibwa, emirembe emingi n’obukkakkamu bijja kugoberera amangu ddala.

Naye kubanga batono abafuba okufiira ddala ku bo bennyini, oba okwevaamu ddala, kyebava basigala nga beezingiddwa mu bo bennyini, era tebasobola kusitulibwa mu mwoyo okusukka bo bennyini. Naye oyo ayagala okutambula nange mu ddembe kimugwanidde okufiiza okwegomba kwe kwonna okwa wansi era okutali kwa nteeko, era tasaanidde kwesiba ku kitonde kyonna olw’okweyagala oba olw’okwegomba.

fields.title: Entambula Ez’enjawulo ez’Obutonde n’ez’Ekisa
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, tunuulira n’obwegendereza entambula z’obutonde n’ez’ekisa, kubanga zitambula mu ngeri ezikontana ennyo era enzibu okulaba, era kumpi tewali ayinza kuzaawula okuggyako omuntu ow’omwoyo eyamulisibwa munda. Mazima abantu bonna beegomba ekirungi, era bafuba okunoonya ekirungi mu bigambo byabwe ne mu bikolwa byabwe. Olw’ensonga eyo ekifaananyi ky’obulungi kirimba bangi.

Obutonde bwa nkwe era busikiriza bangi, nga bubategera era nga bubalimba, so nga bwenoonyeza bwokka bulijjo. Naye ekisa kitambulira mu bwesimbu, kyewala buli ngeri ya kibi, tekiriimu bulimba, era kikola byonna mu bulongoofu ku lwa Katonda, mwe kiwummulira ng’ekigendererwa kyakyo ekisembayo.

Obutonde tebwagala kufa, wadde okunyigirizibwa, wadde okuwangulwa. So tebwagala kwefuga wadde okufugibwa. Ekisa, ku ludda olulala, kifuba okwefiiriza. Kiziyiza okwegomba kw’omubiri, kinoonya okufugibwa, kyegomba okuwangulwa, tekyagala kukozesa ddembe lyakyo, kyagala okukuumirwa mu kukangavvulwa, era tekyegomba kufuga muntu yenna, wabula kyagala okubeera omulamu, okuyimirira, era okubeera bulijjo wansi wa Katonda, era ku lulwe kiri mwetegefu okwetoowaza wansi wa buli kitonde eky’omuntu.

Obutonde bukolera ebyabwo era butunuulira amagoba bye busobola okukungula ku mulala. Ekisa tekitunuulira ekigasa n’ekiyamba kyo kyokka, wabula ekigasa abangi. Obutonde bwagala okuweebwa ekitiibwa n’okussibwamu ekitiibwa, naye ekisa kiwa Katonda ekitiibwa kyonna n’okugulumizibwa mu bwesigwa. Obutonde butya okuswazibwa n’okunyoomebwa, naye ekisa kisanyuka okugumiikiriza okuvumibwa olw’erinnya lya Yesu. Obutonde bwagala obwangu n’okuwummuza omubiri. Ekisa, kyokka, tekiyinza kugumiikiriza kutuula awo nga tekirina kye kikola, era kyaniriza okutegana n’essanyu. Obutonde bunoonya okubeera n’ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo era ebirungi okulaba, nga bukyawa ebintu ebya layisi era ebikalubirivu. Ekisa, ku ludda olulala, kisanyukira ebintu ebyangu era ebya wansi, nga tekinyooma ebikalubirivu, era nga tekigaana kwambala ngoye nkadde.

Obutonde bufaayo ku bugagga obw’ekiseera era busanyukira amagoba ag’ensi. Bunakuwala olw’okufiirwa era bunyiigira ekigambo ekitono ekirumya. Naye ekisa kitunuulira eby’olubeerera era tekyesiba ku by’ekiseera, nga tekitabuka olw’okufiirwa wadde okusunguwala olw’ebigambo ebikakali, kubanga kiteeka eby’obugagga byakyo n’essanyu lyakyo mu ggulu, awatali kibula.

Obutonde bwa mululu, era bwagala okuweebwa okusinga okugaba. Bwagala okuba n’ebintu byabwo eby’obwannannyini. Ekisa, kyokka, kirina obulungi era kigaba n’omutima omugazi. Ekisa kyewala okwenoonyeza ebyakyo, kimatira na kitono, era kitwala nti okugaba kwa mukisa okusinga okuweebwa.

Obutonde busikirizibwa eri ebitonde, eri omubiri gwabwo, eri obutaliimu, n’eri okutayaaya. Naye ekisa kisemberera Katonda n’empisa ennungi, kyefiiriza ebitonde, kikyawa okwegomba kw’omubiri, kiziyiza okuwaba kwakyo era kikwatibwa ensonyi okulabibwa mu lujjudde.

Obutonde bwagala okuba n’okubudaabudibwa okw’okungulu mwe busobola okufunira okunyumirwa okw’omubiri, naye ekisa kinoonya okubudaabudibwa mu Katonda yekka, kisanyukire mu Kirungi ekisingayo, okusinga ebintu byonna ebirabika.

Obutonde bukola buli kintu olw’amagoba gaabwo n’ebyabwo. Tebuyinza kukola kintu kyonna awatali mpeera, era busuubira ebikolwa byabwo ebirungi okusasulwa ekyenkana oba ekisingawo, oba okutenderezebwa n’okuganzibwa. Bwegomba nnyo ebikolwa byabwo n’ebirabo byabwo okutwalibwa nga bya muwendo nnyo. Ekisa, kyokka, tekinoonya kintu kya kiseera, era tekisaba mpeera yonna okuggyako Katonda yekka. Ku bintu ebyetaagisa eby’ekiseera tekisaba kisukka ku ekyo ekinaakiyamba okufuna eby’olubeerera.

Obutonde busanyukira emikwano emingi n’ab’oluganda, bwenyumiririza mu kifo eky’ekitiibwa ne mu kuzaalibwa okw’ekitiibwa, bwefuula omuddu w’ab’amaanyi, buwaanawaana abagagga, era bukubira mu ngalo abo abafaanana nabwo. Naye ekisa kyagala n’abalabe bakyo, era tekyegulumiza olw’okuba n’emikwano emingi. Tekitwala kifo wadde okuzaalibwa nga bya muwendo okuggyako nga wabaddewo n’empisa ennungi. Kisinga kuwagira baavu okusinga abagagga. Kisaasira abatalina musango okusinga ab’amaanyi. Kisanyuka wamu n’omuntu ow’amazima okusinga omulimba, era bulijjo kikubiriza abalungi okufuba okufuna ebirabo ebisingawo obulungi, okufaanana Omwana wa Katonda nga beegezaamu empisa ennungi.

Obutonde bwanguwa okwemulugunya olw’obwetaavu n’ebizibu; ekisa kigumira obwavu n’obunywevu.

Obutonde buzza ebintu byonna eri bwo bwokka. Bulwana era buwakana ku lwabwo. Ekisa kizza ebintu byonna eri Katonda, mwe biva. Kyo kyennyini tekyetwalira kirungi kyonna, era si kya malala wadde okwekulumbaza. Tekiyagala kuwakana. Tekikulembeza ndowooza yakyo okusinga endowooza z’abalala, wabula mu buli nsonga ey’okuwulira n’ey’okulowooza kyegondera amagezi ag’olubeerera n’okusala kwa Katonda.

Obutonde bwegomba okumanya ebyama n’okuwulira amawulire. Bwagala okulabika ebweru n’okufuna ebinyumira omubiri bingi. Bwagala okumanyibwa n’okukola ebintu bye bunaatenderezebwa n’okwewuunyizibwa. Naye ekisa tekifaayo kuwulira mawulire wadde ebintu eby’okwekaliriza, kubanga byonna ebyo biva mu kuvunda okw’edda okw’omuntu, okuva tewali kintu kiggya, tewali kiwangaala ku nsi. N’olwekyo ekisa kiyigiriza okuziyiza ebiwulizi by’omubiri, okwewala okwesiima okw’obutaliimu n’okwerata, okukweka mu bwetoowaze ebikolwa ebisaanira okutenderezebwa n’okwewuunyizibwa, n’okunoonya mu buli kintu ne mu buli kumanya ekibala ky’okugasa, okutendereza n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Tekyagala kyo kyennyini wadde ebyakyo kugulumizibwa, wabula kyegomba Katonda agaba byonna olw’okwagala kwokka, atenderezebwe mu birabo bye.

Ekisa kino kye kitangaala ekisukka obutonde, ekirabo kya Katonda eky’enjawulo, akabonero ak’enjawulo ak’abalonde, era omusingo gw’obulokozi obutaggwaawo. Kiyimusa omuntu okuva ku by’ensi n’ayagala eby’omu ggulu. Kifuula omuntu ow’omubiri okuba ow’omwoyo.

Kale, obutonde gye bukoma okuziyizibwa n’okuwangulwa, ekisa gye kikoma okuweebwa ekisingawo. Buli lunaku omuntu ow’omunda azzibwa buggya olw’okukyalirwa okuggya, ng’afaanana ekifaananyi kya Katonda.

fields.title: Okwonooneka kw’Obutonde n’Amaanyi g’Ekisa kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI MUKAMA, Katonda wange, eyantonda mu kifaananyi kyo ne mu ngeri yo, mpa ekisa kino ky’olaze nti kikulu nnyo era kyetaagisa olw’obulokozi, ndyoke mpangule obutonde bwange obubi ennyo obunsika okunzisa mu kibi ne mu kuzikirira. Kubanga mpulira mu mubiri gwange etteeka ly’ekibi nga liwakana n’etteeka ly’amagezi gange, era nga lintwala nga omusibe okuweereza okwegomba kw’omubiri mu bintu bingi. Siyinza kuziyiza kwegomba kwakwo okuggyako ng’ekisa kyo ekitukuvu ennyo, ekifukiddwa n’ebbugumu mu mutima gwange, kinnyamba.

Ekisa kyo kyetaagisa, era ekisa kingi, okusobola okuwangula obutonde obukyamira mu bubi okuva mu buto. Kubanga olw’omuntu eyasooka, Adamu, obutonde bwagwa ne bunafuyizibwa ekibi, era ekibonerezo ky’ebbala eryo kyagwa ku bantu bonna. Bwe kityo obutonde bwennyini, bwe watonda nga bulungi era butereevu, kati butwalibwa ng’akabonero k’obubi n’obunafu bw’obutonde obwonoonese, kubanga bwe bulekebwa bwokka bukyamira mu bubi ne mu bintu ebya wansi. Amaanyi amatono agasigadde mu bwo gali ng’ensasi y’omuliro ekwese mu vvu. Amaanyi ago ge magezi ag’obutonde, agazingiziddwa ekizikiza ekikutte, naye nga gakyalina obuyinza okwawula ekirungi n’ekibi, n’okulaba enjawulo wakati w’amazima n’obulimba, newaakubadde nga tegasobola kutuukiriza byonna bye gasiima, era tegafuna kitangaala kijjuvu eky’amazima wadde okwagala okulamu.

Kyova kibeera, Katonda wange, nti mu muntu ow’omunda nsanyukira etteeka lyo, nga mmanyi nti ekiragiro kyo kirungi, kya bwenkanya era kitukuvu, era nti kiraga nti kyetaagisa okwewala obubi bwonna n’ekibi. Naye mu mubiri ngondera etteeka ly’ekibi, ne ngondera okwegomba kw’omubiri okusinga amagezi. Era kyova kibeera nti okwagala okukola ekirungi kuli mu nze, naye engeri y’okukituukiriza sigimanyi. Era kyenva emirundi mingi nteekateeka okukola ebirungi bingi, naye olw’okuba ekisa ekiyamba obunafu bwange kibulawo, nzirayo emabega ne ndekera awo nga nsanze okuziyizibwa okutono ennyo. Bwe kityo nti mmanyi ekkubo ery’okutuukirira era ndaba bulungi ekimala engeri gye nnandyeyisizzaamu, naye olw’okuba nnyigirizibwa obuzito bw’okwonooneka kwange, sisituka kugenda mu bintu ebisingako okutuukirira.

Ayi Mukama, ekisa kyo nga kyetaagisa nnyo nnyini gye ndi okutandika ekikolwa kyonna ekirungi, okukigenda mu maaso n’okukimaliriza! Kubanga awatali kisa siyinza kukola kintu kyonna, naye olw’amaanyi gaakyo nnyinza okukola byonna mu ggwe. Ayi Ekisa eky’omu ggulu ddala, awatali ggwe ebirungi byaffe bye tusaanidde si kintu, era tewali birabo bya butonde bisaanidde kutwalibwa nga bya muwendo!

Mu maaso go, Ayi Mukama, tewali bukugu wadde obugagga, tewali bulungi wadde amaanyi, tewali magezi wadde okutegeera, ebigasa awatali kisa. Kubanga ebirabo by’obutonde biweebwa abalungi n’ababi kyenkanyi, naye ekirabo eky’enjawulo eky’abalonde bo kye kisa oba okwagala, era abo abassiddwako akabonero kaakyo babalibwa nga basaanira obulamu obutaggwaawo. Ekisa kino kisukkulumye nnyo ne kiba nti awatali kyo tewali kirabo kya bunnabbi wadde eky’ebyamagero, tewali kufumiitiriza ne bwe kuba kugulumivu kutya, ekiyinza okutwalibwa nga kintu. Ne okukkiriza, n’essuubi oba empisa endala ennungi tebikusanyusa awatali kwagala n’ekisa.

Ayi ekisa eky’omukisa ennyo, ekifuula abaavu mu mwoyo okuba abagagga mu mpisa ennungi, era ekifuula oyo omugagga mu birungi bingi okuba omuwombeefu mu mutima, jjangu, kka ku nze, onjijuze mangu okubudaabuda kwo, emmeeme yange ereme okuzirika olw’obukoowu n’obukalu bw’ebirowoozo.

Nkwegayiridde, Mukama, ka nsange ekisa mu maaso go, kubanga ekisa kyo kimmala, ne bwe sifuna na kimu ku ebyo obutonde bye bwegomba. Bwe nkemebwa ne mbonyaabonyezebwa okubonaabona kungi, siritya kabi konna nga ekisa kyo kiri nange. Kino ge maanyi gange. Kino kijja kumpa amagezi n’obuyambi. Kino kisinga amaanyi abalabe bange bonna, era kisinga amagezi abagezi bonna. Kino ye nnyini mazima, omusomesa w’empisa ennungi, ekitangaala ky’omutima, omubudaabuzi mu bulumi, omugobi w’ennaku, omugobi w’okutya, omuliisi w’okwemalira ku Katonda, era omuleesi w’amaziga. Nze ndi ki awatali kisa, okuggyako omuti omukalu, ettabi eritaliiko mugaso, erisaanira okusuulibwa ebweru kyokka?

Kale, Ayi Mukama, ekisa kyo kinkulemberenga era kingobererenga, era kinfuule bulijjo anyiikira ebikolwa ebirungi, ku bwa Yesu Kristo, Omwana wo.

fields.title: Tusaanidde Okwefiiriza n’Okukoppa Kristo nga Twetikka Omusaalaba
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, gy’okoma okuva mu ggwe wennyini, gy’okoma okusobola okuyingira mu Nze. Nga okulekayo ebintu eby’ebweru bwe kuleeta emirembe egy’omunda, bwe kityo okweleka ggwe wennyini kukugatta ne Katonda. Njagala oyige okwewaayo okutuukiridde eri okwagala kwange, awatali kuwakana wadde kwemulugunya.

Ngoberera. Nze kkubo, n’amazima n’obulamu. Awatali Kkubo, tewali kugenda. Awatali Mazima, tewali kumanya. Awatali Bulamu, tewali kubeera mulamu. Nze Kkubo ly’olina okugoberera, Amazima g’olina okukkiriza, Obulamu bw’olina okusuubira. Nze Kkubo eritayinza kwonoonebwa, Amazima agatayinza kukyama, Obulamu obutaggwaawo. Nze Kkubo eggolokofu, Amazima agasinga byonna, Obulamu obw’amazima, obw’omukisa, Obulamu obutaatondebwa. Bw’onoobeeranga mu Kkubo lyange, olitegeera amazima, n’amazima galikufuula wa ddembe, era olifuna obulamu obutaggwaawo.

Obanga oyagala okuyingira mu bulamu, gondera ebiragiro byange. Bw’oba oyagala okumanya amazima, nzikiriza. Obanga oyagala okuba omutuukirivu, tunda byonna. Bw’oba oyagala okuba omuyigirizwa wange, weefiirize. Bw’oba oyagala okufuna obulamu obw’omukisa, nyooma obulamu buno obw’akaseera kano. Bw’oba oyagala okugulumizibwa mu ggulu, weetoowaze ku nsi. Bw’oba oyagala okufuga awamu nange, situla Omusaalaba wamu nange. Kubanga abaweereza b’Omusaalaba bokka be bafuna obulamu obw’omukisa n’obw’ekitangaala eky’amazima.

Omuyigirizwa

Mukama Yesu, olw’okuba ekkubo lyo ffunda era linyoomebwa ensi, mpa nnyoome ensi era nkukoppe. Kubanga omuddu tasinga mukama we, n’omuyigirizwa tasinga amusomesa. Omuddu wo atendekebwe mu bulamu bwo, kubanga omwo mwe muli obulokozi bwange n’obutukuvu obw’amazima. Buli kirala kye nsoma oba kye mpulira tekinzizaamu maanyi mu bujjuvu wadde okunsanyusa.

Eddoboozi lya Kristo

Mwana wange, kaakano bw’omanyi ebintu bino era ng’obisomye byonna, oliba n’omukisa bw’onoobikolanga. Oyo alina ebiragiro byange n’abikwata, oyo y’anjagala. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga, era ndimutuuza wamu nange mu Bwakabaka bwa Kitange.

Omuyigirizwa

Mukama Yesu, nga bw’oyogedde, kibeere bwe kityo, era ky’osuubizza, kibe omugabo gwange okukifuna. Nfunye omusaalaba, nguweereddwa mu mukono gwo. Nja kugusitula, nja kugusitula okutuusa ku kufa nga bw’ogunteekeddeko. Mazima ddala, obulamu bw’omumonaki omulungi musaalaba, naye butuusa mu Lusuku lwa Katonda. Tutandise—tetuyinza kudda mabega, era tetuyinza kulekera awo.

Mugume omwoyo, ab’oluganda, tugende mu maaso ffenna wamu, ne Yesu anaabeeranga naffe. Ku lwa Yesu twetisse omusaalaba guno. Ku lwa Yesu tugunyiikirire. Ye anaabeeranga omuyambi waffe, nga bw’ali n’omukulembeze waffe era omulungamya waffe. Laba, Kabaka waffe atukulembera era anaatulwanirira. Tumugoberere ng’abasajja abazira. Omuntu yenna aleme kutya bikanga byonna. Tubeere beetegefu okusisinkana okufa n’obuzira mu lutalo. Tuleme kukkiriza kitiibwa kyaffe kwonoonebwa olw’okudduka Omusaalaba.

fields.title: Omuntu Tasaanidde Kuggwaamu Nnyo Mwoyo bw’Agwa mu Bunafu
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, obugumiikiriza n’obwetoowaze mu bizibu binsanyusa nnyo okusinga okubudaabudibwa okungi n’okwemalira ku Katonda ng’ebintu bitambula bulungi.

Lwaki onakuwala olw’akagambo akatono akakwogeddwako? Ne bwe kandibadde kangi okusingawo, tewandikkirizza kukukwatako. Naye kaakano kaleke kiyite. Si kye kisooka, era si kipya, era bw’onoowangaala tekijja kuba kya nkomerero.

Oli muzira ekimala kasita tewali kikuziyiza. Abalala obawa amagezi amalungi, era omanyi okubazzaamu amaanyi n’ebigambo, naye okubonaabona okutasuubirwa bwe kukonkona ku luggi lwo, obulwa amagezi n’amaanyi. Kale lowooza ku bunafu bwo obungi, bw’olaba emirundi mingi nnyo mu nsonga entono. Naye ebigezo bino n’ebiringa bino bwe bikutuukako, bikutuukako olw’obulungi bwo.

Kiggye mu mutima gwo nga bw’osobola, era bwe kiba kikukutteko, tokikkiriza kukumalamu maanyi wadde okukutabula okumala ebbanga eddene. Waakiri kigumiikirize, bw’oba tosobola kukigumira n’essanyu. Ne bw’okigumira nga tokyagala, era ng’onyiize olw’ekyo, weefuge, oleme kuleka bigambo bitali bya nteeko kuva ku mimwa gyo, ebiyinza okwesittaza abanafu. Omuyaga ogusituse kaakano gujja kukkakkana mangu, n’ennaku yo ey’omunda ejja kuwoomezebwa ekisa ekikomawo. “Nkyali mulamu,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “nga ndi mwetegefu okukuyamba n’okukubudaabuda okweyongera, bw’onoonneesiganga n’onkoowoola ng’omwemalidde.”

Beera mukkakkamu era weeteekereteekere okugumira ebigezo ebisinga n’obunene. Byonna tebifuuse bya bwereere, ne bw’obonyaabonyezebwa emirundi mingi oba ne bw’okemebwa mu ngeri ezisingako obuzito. Oli muntu, so si Katonda. Oli mubiri, so si malayika. Oyinza otya okusuubira okusigala bulijjo mu mbeera y’empisa ennungi y’emu, so nga bamalayika mu ggulu n’omuntu eyasooka mu Lusuku lwa Katonda baalemererwa okukikola? Nze Oyo awonya ababonaabona, era aleeta mu bwakatonda bwange abo abamanyi obunafu bwabwe.

Omuyigirizwa

Ebigambo byo bitenderezebwe, Ayi Mukama, ebiwoomera akamwa kange okusinga omubisi gw’enjuki, okusukkirira omubisi gw’enjuki ogutonnya nga guva mu bisenge byagwo. Nnandikoze ki mu bigezo ebinene bwe bityo ne mu bweraliikirivu, singa tonnyweza n’ebigambo byo ebitukuvu? Kasita ntuuka ku mwalo gw’obulokozi, kigasa ki kye mbonaabona oba bwe mbonaabona obungi? Mpa enkomerero ennungi. Mpa okuva mu nsi muno nga mpita mu ddembe n’essanyu. Onzijukiranga, Katonda wange, era ontwale mu kkubo eggolokofu mu bwakabaka bwo.

fields.title: Ensonga Empanvu n’Emisango gya Katonda Egikwekeddwa Tezisaanidde Kwekenneenyezebwa
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

MWANA WANGE, weekuume okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga empanvu ne ku misango gya Katonda egikwekeddwa—lwaki omuntu ono alekeddwa bw’atyo, ate lwaki oli aweereddwa ekisa ekinene bwe kityo, oba lwaki omu abonyaabonyezebwa nnyo bw’atyo ate omulala n’agulumizibwa nnyo. Ebintu ng’ebyo bisukkiridde okutegeera kw’abantu kwonna, era tewali magezi wadde empaka eziyinza okutuuka ku buziba bw’emisango gya Katonda.

Kale omulabe bw’akuteekamu ebirowoozo ng’ebyo, oba abantu abamu abayaayaanira okumanya bwe babibuuza, ddamu nga nnabbi: “Oli mutuukirivu, Ayi Mukama, era emisango gyo gya butuukirivu”; era n’ekino: “Emisango gya Mukama gya mazima, era gya butuukirivu ddala.” Emisango gyange gya kutiibwa, so si kukubaganyizibwako birowoozo, kubanga okutegeera kw’abantu tekuyinza kugituukako.

Mu ngeri y’emu, tobuuzanga wadde okuwakana ku birungi abatukuvu bye baakola, nti ani asinga obutukuvu, oba ani aliba omukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Ebintu ng’ebyo bitera okuleeta enkaayana n’empaka ezitaliiko mugaso. Biriisa amalala n’okwenyumiriza okutaliimu, okuvaamu obuggya n’okuyomba, omu bw’agezaako mu malala okugulumiza omutukuvu omu, n’omulala omulala. Okwegomba okumanya n’okusoya mu nsonga ng’ezo tekubala kibala kyonna. Wabula kunyiiza abatukuvu, kubanga Nze Katonda, si wa luyoogaano, wabula wa mirembe—emirembe egiri mu bwetoowaze obw’amazima, so si mu kwegulumiza.

Abamu basikirizibwa ebbugumu ly’okwagala kwabwe okwagala ennyo abatukuvu bano oba bali, naye okwagala okwo kwa buntu so si kwa Katonda. Nze Oyo eyakola abatukuvu bonna. Nze nabawa ekisa: Nze nabatuusa mu kitiibwa. Mmanyi ebirungi bya buli omu ku bo. Nze nabakulembera n’emikisa egy’obuwoomi bwange. Nnamanya abaagalwa bange nga emirembe teginnabaawo. Nze nabalonda okuva mu nsi—si bo bannonda. Nnabayita olw’ekisa, nnabasika olw’okusaasira. Nnabakulembera mu mirembe mu kukemebwa okw’engeri nnyingi. Nnabafukamu okubudaabudibwa okw’ekitiibwa. Nnabawa okunyiikira era ne ntikkira obugumiikiriza bwabwe engule. Mmanyi asooka n’asembayo. Bonna mbagwa mu kifuba n’okwagala okutapimika. Ntenderezebwa mu batukuvu bange bonna. Nsaanidde okwebazibwa okusinga byonna, n’okuweebwa ekitiibwa mu buli omu ku abo be nagulumiza ne be nnaateekateeka mu kitiibwa bwe kityo, awatali birungi byabwe bye baasooka okukola.

Kale oyo anyooma omu ku bange abasembayo obutono, tawa kitiibwa oyo asinga obukulu, kubanga omutono n’omukulu nze nnabakola bombi. Era oyo anyooma omu ku batukuvu, anyooma nange n’abalala bonna abali mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Bonna bali bumu olw’ekisiba ky’okwagala. Balina ekirowoozo kimu n’okwagala kumu, era bonna baagalana; naye, ekisinga obukulu ennyo, banjagala nze okusinga bo bennyini oba ebirungi byabwe. Nga basitulibwa waggulu w’obwabwe, era nga basikiddwa okusukka okwagala kwe beeyagala, bamaliddwa ddala mu kwagala nze, mwe bawummulira. Tewali kiyinza kubaggyako wadde okubaggwaamu omwoyo, kubanga abo abajjudde amazima ag’emirembe gyonna baaka n’omuliro gw’okwagala okutazikira.

N’olwekyo, abantu ab’omubiri abagoberera okwegomba kwabwe, abamanyi okwagala essanyu lyabwe bokka, baleme okuwakana ku mbeera y’abatukuvu ba Katonda. Abantu ng’abo baggyako era bongerako nga bwe beegomba bo, so si nga bwe kisanyusa Amazima ag’Olubeerera. Mu bangi kino butamanya bwereere, naddala mu abo abamuliikiriddwako katono era abatatera kwagala muntu yenna n’okwagala okw’omwoyo okulongoofu. Bakyasikirizibwa nnyo okwagala okw’obutonde n’omukwano ogw’obuntu eri omuntu omu oba omulala, era ku ngeri gye beeyisaamu mu bintu ebyo wano wansi kwe basinziira okulowooza ku bintu eby’omu ggulu. Naye waliwo ebanga eritageraageranyizika wakati w’ebyo abatannatuukirira bye balowooza, n’ebyo abantu abamulisiddwa bye balaba mu kubikkulirwa okuva waggulu.

Kale weegendereze, Mwana wange, okukwata ku nsonga ezisukka okumanya kwo olw’okwagala okumanya obumanya. Wabula omulimu gwo n’ekigendererwa kyo bibe okusangibwa mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda, ne bw’oba ng’oli wa wansi ddala. Kubanga omuntu ne bw’amanya ani asinga munne obutukuvu, oba ani asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, okumanya okwo kwandimugasizza ki okuggyako ng’akuyiseemu okwetoowaza mu maaso gange n’okusituka okutendereza erinnya lyange okusingawo?

Omuntu alowooza ku bunene bw’ebibi bye n’obutono bw’empisa ze ennungi, ne ku bbanga eriri wakati we n’okutuukirira kw’abatukuvu, akola ekisanyusa Katonda okusinga ennyo oyo awakana ku ani asinga obukulu oba ani asinga obutono. Kirungi okukoowoola abatukuvu mu kusaba okw’okwemalira ku Katonda n’amaziga, n’okusaba obuyambi bwabwe obw’ekitiibwa n’omwoyo ogwetoowaze, okusinga okunoonyereza mu byama byabwe olw’okwagala okumanya okutaliimu.

Abatukuvu bamativu bulungi era mu bujjuvu singa abantu bamanya okumatira ne balekera awo empaka zaabwe ezitaliiko mugaso. Tebeenyumiriza mu birungi byabwe, kubanga tebeetwalira kirungi kyonna, wabula byonna babinzirizaako nze, kubanga olw’okwagala kwange okutaliiko kkomo nnabawa byonna. Bajjudde okwagala kwa Katonda n’essanyu eryeyiwa ennyo, ne kiba nti tebabulwa kitiibwa kyonna era tebayinza kubulwa ssanyu lyonna. Abatukuvu bonna gye bakoma okuba abeetoowaze mu bo bennyini, gye bakoma okuba waggulu mu kitiibwa; nga bali kumpi nange, era nga mbaagala nnyo. Kyova osanga nga kyawandiikibwa nti bateeka engule zaabwe mu maaso ga Katonda, ne bagwa mu maaso g’Omwana gw’Endiga ne bavuunama, ne basinza Oyo omulamu emirembe n’emirembe.

Bangi babuuza ani asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, so nga tebamanyi oba bo bennyini balisaanira okubalirwa mu abasembayo obutono mu bwo. Kintu kikulu okuba ne ow’omu bawansi ddala mu ggulu, gye bali bonna abakulu, kubanga bonna baliyitibwa, era baliba, abaana ba Katonda. Asembayo okuba owa wansi alyala n’aba lukumi, n’omwonoonyi ow’emyaka ekikumi alifa. Kubanga abayigirizwa bwe baabuuza ani aliba asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, baawulira okuddamu kuno: “Bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Noolwekyo buli eyeetoowaza ng’omwana ono omuto y’aliba asinga obukulu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.”

Kale zibasanze abo abagaana okwetoowaza nga bayagadde wamu n’abaana abato, kubanga omulyango omutono ogw’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu tegulibaganya kuyingira. Era zibasanze abagagga abafunye okubudaabudibwa kwabwe wano, kubanga abaavu bwe baliyingira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda, bo baliyimirira ebweru nga bakuba ebiwoobe. Musanyuke mmwe abeetoowaze, mujaguze mmwe abaavu, kubanga obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwammwe, kasita mutambulira mu mazima.

fields.title: Essuubi Lyonna n’Obwesige Byonna Bisaanidde Okuteekebwa mu Katonda Yekka
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

KIKI, Mukama, kye nneesiga mu bulamu buno, oba kiki ekisinga okumbudaabuda mu bintu byonna ebirabika wansi w’eggulu? Si ggwe, Ayi Mukama, Katonda wange, ow’okusaasira okutabalika? Wa we nnali nga ndi bulungi awatali ggwe? Oba ebintu byandyonoonese bitya nga ggwe oli wo? Njagala okuba omwavu ku lulwo okusinga okuba omugagga awatali ggwe. Njagala okutambulatambula ku nsi nga ndi naawe okusinga okufuna eggulu awatali ggwe. Gy’oli eyo ye ggulu, era gy’otali eyo eriyo okufa ne ggeyeena. Ggwe gwe neegomba, n’olwekyo nnina okukukaabirira, okusinda n’okusaba. Sirina gwe nnyinza kwesiga mu bujjuvu okunnyamba mu bwetaavu bwange, okuggyako ggwe wekka, Katonda wange. Ggwe ssuubi lyange. Ggwe bwesige bwange. Ggwe mubudaabuzi wange, omwesigwa ennyo mu buli bwetaavu.

Bonna beenoonyeza byabwe ku bwabwe. Naye ggwe olembeza obulokozi bwange n’okugasibwa kwange, era byonna obikyusa ne bimbeerera birungi. Ne bw’onteeka mu kukemebwa n’ebizibu eby’engeri nnyingi, ggwe amanyidde okugezesa abaagalwa bo mu ngeri lukumi, byonna obiteekateeka olw’obulungi bwange. Tosaanidde kwagalibwa wadde okutenderezebwa ekitono mu kigezo kino okusinga singa wanjijuza okubudaabudibwa okw’omu ggulu.

Kale mu ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda, mwe nteeka essuubi lyange lyonna n’obuddukiro bwange. Ku ggwe kwe nteeka ebinteganya byonna n’obulumi bwange, kubanga buli kye nnina ebweru wo nkisanga nga kinafu era nga tekinywevu. Tekirimpa mugaso okuba n’emikwano mingi, wadde abayambi ab’amaanyi okunnyamba, wadde abawi b’amagezi abegendereza okumpa okuddamu okugasa, wadde ebitabo by’abayivu okumbudaabuda, wadde eky’obugagga kyonna eky’omuwendo okunnununula, wadde ekifo kyonna, ne bwe kiba eky’ekyama era ekirungi kitya, okunkweka, singa ggwe wennyini tonnyamba, tonzizaamu maanyi, tombudaabuda, tonjigiriza era tonkuuma. Kubanga ebintu byonna ebirabika ng’ebituleetera emirembe n’essanyu si kintu nga toliiwo, era ddala tebireeta ssanyu lyonna.

Mazima ddala ggwe nsulo ya birungi byonna, obugulumivu bw’obulamu, obuziba bwa byonna ebiyinza okwogerwa. Okukwesiga okusinga byonna kye kibudaabuda abaddu bo ekisinga amaanyi.

Katonda wange, Kitaffe ow’okusaasira, ggwe gwe ntunuulira, ggwe gwe neesiga. Wa emmeeme yange omukisa era ogitukuze n’omukisa ogw’omu ggulu, ekyoke efuuke ekifo kyo ekitukuvu w’obeera era entebe y’ekitiibwa kyo eky’olubeerera. Era mu yeekaalu eno ey’ekitiibwa kyo temusangibwanga kintu kyonna ekiyinza okunyiiza obukulu bwo. Olw’obulungi bwo obungi, onkyukire olw’okusaasira kwo okungi, era owulire okusaba kw’omuddu wo omwavu eyawaŋŋangusibwa okuva gy’oli, ali mu kitundu eky’ekisiikirize eky’okufa. Kuuma era owonye emmeeme y’omuddu wo omwavu mu bulabe obungi obw’obulamu buno obuvunda, era omuluŋŋamye n’ekisa kyo ekimuwerekerako, ng’ayita mu kkubo ery’emirembe, okutuuka mu nsi ey’ekitangaala eky’olubeerera.

fields.title: Ekitiibwa Ekinene Kye Tusaanidde Okusembereza Kristo
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

BINO byonna bigambo byo, Ayi Kristo, Amazima ag’olubeerera, newaakubadde nga tebyayogerebwa byonna mu kiseera kimu wadde okuwandiikibwa awamu mu kifo kimu. Era olw’okuba nga bibyo era nga bya mazima, nnina okubikkiriza byonna n’okukkiriza n’okwebaza. Bibyo era ggwe wabyogera; era bibyange, kubanga wabyogera olw’obulokozi bwange. Mbikkiriza n’essanyu okuva ku mimwa gyo, bisobole okwekuba ennyo mu mutima gwange.

Ebigambo eby’ekisa bwe bityo, ebijjudde obuwoomi n’okwagala, binzizaamu amaanyi; naye ebibi byange bintiisa, era omuntu wange ow’omunda atali mulongoofu ankubira ng’eggulu nga nsemberera ebyama ebinene bwe bityo. Obuwoomi bw’ebigambo byo bumpita, naye obungi bw’ebibi byange bunnyigiriza.

Ondagira okukusemberera n’obuvumu bwe mba njagala okuba n’omugabo naawe, n’okulya emmere ey’obutafa bwe mba neegomba okufuna obulamu n’ekitiibwa eby’olubeerera.

“Mujje gye ndi,” bw’ogamba, “mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza.”

Ayi, ekigambo kino nga kiwoomu era nga kirungi mu matu g’omwonoonyi, ky’oyitisa, Mukama wange Katonda, abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu okujja okulya Omubiri gwo omutukuvu ennyo! Nze ani, Mukama, okwetantala okukusemberera? Laba, eggulu n’eggulu ly’eggulu terikumala, naye era ogamba nti: “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna.”

Kitegeeza ki ekitiibwa kino eky’ekisa ekingi bwe kityo, n’okuyita kuno okw’omukwano? Nnaayinza ntya okwetantala okujja, nze atamanyi kirungi kyonna kye nnyinza kwesigamako? Nnaakuyingiza ntya mu nnyumba yange, nze akunyiizizza emirundi mingi nnyo mu maaso go ag’ekisa? Bamalayika ne bamalayika abakulu bakussaamu ekitiibwa, abatukuvu n’abatuukirivu bakutya, naye ggwe ogamba nti: “Mujje gye ndi: mmwe mwenna!” Singa ggwe, Mukama, tewakyogera, ani yandikikkirizza nti kya mazima? Era singa tewalagira, ani yandyetantadde okusembera?

Laba, Nuuwa, omusajja omutuukirivu, yakola okumala emyaka kikumi ng’azimba eryato, ye n’abalala abatono balyoke balokolebwe; kale nze nnaayinza ntya okweteekateeka mu ssaawa emu okusembeza n’okussaamu ekitiibwa Omutonzi w’ensi?

Musa, omuddu wo omukulu era mukwano gwo ow’enjawulo, yakola essanduuko mu muti ogutavunda, n’agibikkako zaabu ennongoofu ddala, okuteekamu ebipande by’amateeka go; nze ekitonde ekivunda, nnaayinza okwetantala okukusembeza mu bwangu bwe butyo, ggwe Eyateeka amateeka era Omugabi w’obulamu?

Sulemaani, eyasinga amagezi mu bakabaka ba Isirayiri, yamala emyaka musanvu ng’azimba yeekaalu ey’ekitalo okutendereza erinnya lyo, n’akuza okugitukuza n’embaga ey’ennaku munaana. Yawaayo ssaddaaka lukumi okukuwa ekitiibwa, era n’asitula Essanduuko y’Endagaano mu kitiibwa n’amakondeere n’okujaganya okugituusa mu kifo ekyagitegekerwa; ate nze, ow’ennaku era asinga obwavu mu bantu, nnaakuyingiza ntya mu nnyumba yange, nze atasobola na kumala kitundu kya ssaawa nga nneemalidde ku ggwe—singa nnali nsobola okumala n’ekyo nga bwe kinsaanira!

Ayi Katonda wange, abantu abo nga baafuba nnyo okukusanyusa! Zinsanze, byonna bye nkola nga bitono! Ekiseera kye mmala nga neeteekateeka okusembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu nga kimpi! Siteera kukuŋŋaanya birowoozo byange ddala, era sitera n’akatono kuba nga sirina kintaataaganya. Naye mazima ddala, mu maaso g’Obwakatonda bwo obuwa obulamu, tewasaanidde kubaawo kirowoozo kitasaana, era tewali kitonde kisaanidde kwefuga mutima gwange, kubanga ŋŋenda kusembeza ng’omugenyi wange, si malayika, wabula Mukama wa bamalayika yennyini.

Era enjawulo nnene nnyo wakati w’Essanduuko y’Endagaano n’eby’obugagga byayo, n’Omubiri gwo omulongoofu ennyo n’amaanyi gaagwo agatayogerekeka; wakati wa ssaddaaka ez’amateeka ezaali ebisiikirize by’ebintu ebyali bigenda okujja, n’ekiweebwayo eky’amazima eky’Omubiri gwo ekyatuukiriza ssaddaaka zonna ez’edda.

Kale lwaki seegomba na bbugumu lingi okubeerawo kwo okusaanira okusinzibwa? Lwaki seeteekateeka n’obwegendereza obusingawo okufuna ebirabo byo ebitukuvu, so nga bajjajja abatukuvu ne bannabbi ab’edda, awamu ne bakabaka n’abalangira n’abantu baabwe bonna, baalaga okwemalira ku Katonda okw’okwagala bwe kutyo mu kusinza Katonda?

Kabaka Dawudi eyali eyeemalidde ennyo ku Katonda yazinira mu maaso g’essanduuko ya Katonda n’amaanyi ge gonna, ng’ajjukira ebirungi ebyaweebwa bajjajjaabe edda. Yakola ebivuga eby’engeri nnyingi. Yayiiya zabbuli n’alagira ziyimbibwe n’essanyu. Ye yennyini yateranga okukuba ennanga ng’akwatiddwako ekisa ky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Yayigiriza abantu ba Isirayiri okutendereza Katonda n’emitima gyabwe gyonna, n’okuyimusa amaloboozi gaabwe buli lunaku okumwebaza n’okumugulumiza. Obanga okwemalira ku Katonda okw’amaanyi bwe kutyo kwakulaakulana mu biro ebyo, n’emikolo egy’ekitiibwa bwe gityo mu kutendereza Katonda mu maaso g’Essanduuko y’Endagaano, nze n’Abakristaayo bonna kaakano tusaanidde okulaga okwemalira ku Katonda okunene kwenkana wa mu maaso ga Ssakramentu eno; ekitiibwa kyenkana wa nga tusembeza Omubiri gwa Kristo ogusinga obulungi!

Abantu bangi batambula olugendo oluwanvu okussaamu ekitiibwa ebisigalira by’abatukuvu, nga beewuunya ebikolwa byabwe eby’ekitalo n’okuzimba amasinzizo ag’ekitalo. Batunuulira era ne banywegera ebisigalira ebitukuvu ebizingiddwa mu liiri ne zaabu; ate laba, ggwe oli wano mu maaso gange ku kyoto, Katonda wange, Omutukuvu w’abatukuvu, Omutonzi w’abantu, era Mukama wa bamalayika!

Emirundi mingi nga batunuulira ebintu ng’ebyo, abantu bakwatibwako okwagala okumanya obumanya, n’obupya bw’ebyo bye batalabangako, era ne bakomawo n’ekibala kitono eky’okwekyusa mu bulamu bwabwe, naddala bwe bava mu kifo ekimu ne bagenda mu kirala mu bwangu era awatali kunakuwala olw’ebibi okw’amazima. Naye wano mu Ssakramentu ey’ekyoto oliwo mu bujjuvu, Katonda wange, omuntu Kristo Yesu, mw’oyita okufuna mu bujjuvu obulokozi obutaggwaawo, buli lw’osembezebwa mu ngeri esaanidde era ey’okwemalira ku Katonda. Ku kino tetusikirizibwa bunyoomi, oba kwagala kumanya, oba kwegomba kwa mubiri, wabula okukkiriza okunywevu, essuubi ery’okwemalira ku Katonda, n’okwagala okw’amazima.

Ayi Katonda, Omutonzi w’ensi akwekeddwa, ng’otukolera eby’ekitalo! Ng’otegeka ebintu mu buwoomi ne mu kisa n’abalonde bo, b’owaayo ggwe wennyini okukusembeza mu Ssakramentu eno! Kino ddala kisukkiridde okutegeera kwonna. Kino mu ngeri ey’enjawulo kisikiriza emitima gy’abo abeemalidde ku Katonda era ne kikoleeza okwagala kwabwe. Abaddu bo abeesigwa ddala, abawaayo obulamu bwabwe bwonna okwekyusa, emirundi mingi bafuna mu Kijjulo Ekitukuvu ekisa ekinene eky’okwemalira ku Katonda n’okwagala empisa ennungi.

Ayi, ekisa eky’ekitalo era ekikwekeddwa ekya Ssakramentu eno, abeesigwa ba Kristo bokka kye bategeera, abatakkiriza n’abaddu b’ekibi kye batayinza kuwulira! Mu yo mwe muweerwa ekisa eky’omwoyo, empisa ennungi eyabula n’ekomezebwawo, n’obulungi obwonoonebwa ekibi ne buddabirizibwa. Oluusi ekisa kyayo kiba kinene nnyo, olw’obujjuvu bw’okwemalira ku Katonda, ne kiba nti si magezi gokka, wabula n’omubiri omunafu gwennyini guwulira nga gujjuziddwa amaanyi agasingawo.

Naye obulagajjavu bwaffe n’obunnyogovu bwaffe bisaanidde nnyo okukaabirwa n’okusaasirwa, bwe tutakwatibwako kusembeza n’ebbugumu erisingawo Kristo, mwe muli essuubi n’obusaanyizo bw’abo bonna abalirokolebwa. Ye kutukuzibwa kwaffe n’okununulibwa kwaffe. Ye kubudaabudibwa kwaffe mu bulamu buno era essanyu ery’olubeerera ery’abo abalina omukisa mu ggulu. Kino bwe kiri bwe kityo, kya nnaku nti bangi bassaayo omwoyo kitono nnyo ku Kyama kino ekireeta obulokozi, ekijjuza eggulu essanyu era ekikuuma ensi yonna nga weeri.

Ayi, obuzibe n’obukakanyavu bw’omutima gw’omuntu obutassaayo mwoyo nnyo ku kirabo eky’ekitalo bwe kityo, wabula ne bugwa mu bulagajjavu olw’okukikozesa buli lunaku! Singa Ssakramentu eno entukuvu ennyo yali esomerwa mu kifo kimu kyokka, era ng’etukuzibwa kabona omu yekka mu nsi yonna, olowooza abantu bandisikiriziddwa n’okwegomba okunene kwenkana wa okugenda mu kifo ekyo, eri kabona oyo owa Katonda, okulaba okukuza kw’Ebyama ebitukuvu! Naye kaakano waliwo bakabona bangi era Missa esomebwa mu bifo bingi, ekisa kya Katonda n’okwagala kwe eri abantu birabikire ddala, ng’Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu kibunye nnyo mu nsi.

Weebale, Yesu, Omusumba Omulungi ow’olubeerera, eyasiima okuliisa ffe abaavu abali mu buwaŋŋanguse n’Omubiri gwo n’Omusaayi gwo eby’omuwendo, n’okutuyita n’ebigambo ebiva ku mimwa gyo ggwe kennyini okugabana ku Byama bino ebitukuvu: “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza.”

fields.title: Obulungi bwa Katonda Obungi n’Okwagala kwe Biragibwa Omuntu mu Ssakramentu Eno
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

NGA NNEESIGA obulungi bwo n’okusaasira kwo okungi, Ayi Mukama, nzija gy’oli ng’omulwadde eri Omuwonya, ng’alumwa enjala n’ennyonta eri Ensulo y’obulamu, ng’eyeetaaga eri Kabaka w’eggulu, ng’omuddu eri mukama we, ng’ekitonde eri Omutonzi waakyo, ng’emmeeme eri mu nnaku eri Omubudaabuzi wange omukkakkamu.

Naye kino kinvudde wa, ggwe okujja gye ndi? Nze ani ggwe okwewa gye ndi? Omwonoonyi ayinza atya okwetantala okulabika mu maaso go, era ggwe, oyinza otya okwetoowaza n’ojja eri omwonoonyi? Omuddu wo omumanyi, era omanyi nti talina kirungi kyonna mu ye ekyandikuleetedde okumuwa kino.

Kale nzikiriza obutasaana bwange. Obulungi bwo mbwatula. Okusaasira kwo nkutendereza, era nkwebaza olw’okwagala kwo okutaliiko kigero. Kubanga okikola ku lwa ggwe kennyini, so si lwa kirungi kyonna kye nnakola; obulungi bwo bulyoke bummanyikire obulungi okusingawo, okwagala okusingako kuzuukuke mu nze, n’obwetoowaze obutuukiridde okusingawo buzaalibwe mu nze. Kale nga bwe kikusanyusa era nga bw’otyo bw’oyagadde, n’ekisa kyo kinsanyusa nange. Ayi, ebibi byange bireme okukiziyiza!

Ayi Yesu asinga obuwoomi n’okusaasira, ekitiibwa kinene, okwebazibwa n’okutenderezebwa okutaggwaawo bikugwanidde olw’okutuwa okulya ku mubiri gwo omutukuvu, ogw’ekitiibwa ekitayinza kunnyonnyolwa muntu yenna!

Naye kiki kye nnaalowoozaako mu Kijjulo Ekitukuvu kino, mu kusemberera Mukama wange kuno, gwe sisobola kussaamu kitiibwa nga bwe kimugwanidde, naye gwe neegomba okusembeza n’omutima ogumwemaliddeko? Kirowoozo ki ekisinga obulungi, ekisinga okungasa, okusinga okwetoowaliza ddala mu maaso go n’okugulumiza obulungi bwo obutaliiko kkomo okusinga nze kennyini?

Nkutendereza, Katonda wange, era nkugulumiza emirembe gyonna! Neenyooma, era neesuula mu maaso go mu buziba bw’obutasaana bwange. Laba, ggwe oli Mutukuvu w’abatukuvu, nange ndi kasasiro mu boonoonyi! Laba, okka gye ndi, nze atasaanira na kuyimusa maaso kukutunuulira! Laba, ojja gye ndi! Oyagala okubeera nange! Ompita ku mbaga yo! Oyagala okumpa emmere ey’omu ggulu, emmere ya bamalayika okulya, nga si ndala wabula ggwe wennyini, Emmere ennamu eyava mu ggulu era ewa ensi obulamu.

Laba, okwagala gye kuva! Okwetoowaza nga kwakaayakana! Okwebazibwa n’okutenderezebwa nga binene bwe bikugwanidde olw’ebirabo bino! Ayi, ekigendererwa kyo nga kyali kya bulokozi era kya mugaso bwe wateekawo kino! Embaga nga ya buwoomi era nga nnungi, bwe weewaayo okuba emmere!

Omulimu gwo nga gwa kitalo, Ayi Mukama! Amaanyi go nga manene! Amazima go nga tegasobya! Kubanga wayogera, byonna ne bitondebwa, era kino kye walagira ne kikolebwa. Kintu kya kitalo, ekisaanira okukkirizibwa, era ekisukkulumye ku kutegeera kw’omuntu, ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, Katonda ow’amazima era omuntu, okubeera mu bujjuvu bwo bwonna mu kifaananyi ky’omugaati omutono n’envinnyo, era nga tomalibwawo, n’olibwa oyo akusembeza!

Ggwe, Mukama w’ebintu byonna, atalina ky’obulwa, wayagala okubeera mu ffe ng’oyita mu Ssakramentu yo. Kuuma omutima gwange n’omubiri gwange nga biyonjo, ndyoke nsobole, n’omuntu ow’omunda omusanyufu era atalina bbala, okukuzanga emirundi mingi Ebyama byo, n’okufuna olw’obulokozi bwange obutaggwaawo ekyo kye walagira era kye wateekawo olw’ekitiibwa kyo eky’enjawulo era ng’ekijjukizo eky’olubeerera.

Sanyuka, emmeeme yange, era weebaze Katonda olw’okukulekera ekirabo eky’ekitiibwa bwe kityo n’okubudaabudibwa okw’enjawulo bwe kutyo mu kiwonvu kino eky’amaziga. Buli lw’ozza obuggya Ekyama kino n’osembeza Omubiri gwa Kristo, buli lw’okola omulimu gw’okununulibwa era n’ofuuka omugabanyi ku birungi byonna Kristo bye yatuukiriza, kubanga okwagala kwa Kristo tekukendeera n’akatono, n’obugagga bw’okusaasira kwe tebuggwaawo.

Noolwekyo, kikugwanidde okwetegekera kino ng’ozza buggya omutima gwo buli kiseera, era ng’olowooza nnyo ku kyama ekinene eky’obulokozi. Buli lw’osoma Missa oba lw’ogiwuliriza, kisaanidde okukulabikira nga kinene, nga kiggya, nga kiwoomu, nga lwakuba nti ku lunaku olwo lwennyini Kristo lwe yafuuka omuntu mu lubuto lw’Embeerera, oba, ng’awanikiddwa ku Musaalaba, lwe yabonaabona n’afa olw’obulokozi bw’abantu.

fields.title: Kigasa Okusemberanga ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu Emirundi Mingi
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

LABA, nzija gy’oli, Mukama, ndyoke ngaggawale olw’ekirabo kyo era nsanyukire ku mbaga yo entukuvu, gye wateekerateekera abaavu bo, Ayi Katonda, mu buwoomi bwo. Laba, byonna bye nsobola oba bye nsaanidde okwegomba biri mu ggwe. Ggwe bulokozi bwange era ggwe kununulibwa kwange, essuubi lyange n’amaanyi gange, ekitiibwa kyange n’ettendo lyange.

Kale leero osanyuse emmeeme y’omuweereza wo, kubanga omwoyo gwange nguyimusa eyo gy’oli, Ayi Mukama Yesu. Neegomba okukusembeza kaakano, n’omutima ogukwemaliddeko era n’okukussaamu ekitiibwa. Njagala okukuyingiza mu nnyumba yange, ndyoke, nga Zaakayo, nsaanire omukisa gwo era mbalibwe mu baana ba Ibulayimu.

Emmeeme yange eyaayaanira Omubiri gwo; omutima gwange gwegomba okwegatta naawe. Mpa ggwe wennyini—kimala; kubanga awatali ggwe tewali kubudaabudibwa. Awatali ggwe siyinza kubaawo, awatali kukyala kwo siyinza kuba mulamu. Noolwekyo nteekwa okujjanga gy’oli emirundi mingi, n’okufuna amaanyi ag’obulokozi bwange, si kulwa nga, bwe nzigibwako emmere eno ey’omu ggulu, nzirika mu kkubo. Lumu, Ayi Yesu asinga okusaasira, bwe wali obuulira abantu era ng’owonya endwadde zaabwe ennyingi, wagamba nti: “Ssaagala kubasiibula ne bagenda enjala, si kulwa nga bagwa ku kkubo.” Nange onkolere bw’otyo, ggwe eyeerekera mu Ssakramentu eno olw’okubudaabuda abakkiriza. Ggwe oli kiwummuzo ekiwoomu eri emmeeme, era oyo akulya nga bw’asaanidde aliba mugabanyi era omusika w’ekitiibwa eky’olubeerera.

Mazima kinneetaagisa nze, agwa n’ayonoona emirundi mingi bwe zityo, aggwaamu amaanyi n’anafuwa mangu bwe ntyo, okwezza obuggya, okwetukuza n’okukoleeza omuliro mu nze nga nsaba emirundi mingi, nga njatula ebibi byange, era nga nsembeza Omubiri gwo mu butukuvu, si kulwa nga, bwe ndwawo nnyo nga sisembera, nseeseetuka okuva ku kigendererwa kyange ekitukuvu. Kubanga okuva mu buto bwe, okuwulira kw’omuntu kutwalirizibwa obubi, era bw’atanywezebwa buyambi bwa Katonda, agwa mangu okweyongera wansi. Naye Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu kimuggya mu bubi era kimunyweza mu birungi.

Bwe mba nga ndi mugayaavu era munafu emirundi mingi bwe zityo nga nsoma Missa oba nga nsembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu, kiki ekyandibaddewo singa saafuna ddagala lino era ne sinoonya buyambi bunene bwe butyo? Newaakubadde nga sisaanira era siteeseteese bulungi kusoma Missa buli lunaku, kyokka ndifuba nga bwe nsobola mu biseera ebisaanidde okufuna Ebyama bya Katonda n’okugabana ku kisa kino ekinene. Kino, mazima, kye kibudaabuda ekikulu eky’emmeeme ekkiriza ng’eyawukanye naawe olw’obulamu buno obufa: nti, ng’ejjukira Katonda waayo emirundi mingi, esembeza Omwagalwa waayo n’omutima ogukuŋŋaanye era ogumwemaliddeko.

Ayi, okwetoowaza okw’ekitalo okw’okwagala kwo gye tuli, ggwe, Mukama Katonda, Omutonzi era Omugabi w’obulamu eri bonna, okusiima okujja eri emmeeme enaku n’okumalawo enjala yaayo n’obwakatonda bwo bwonna n’obuntu bwo! Ayi, amagezi agalina essanyu n’emmeeme erina omukisa, esaanira okukusembeza ggwe, Mukama Katonda waayo, era bw’ekusembeza n’ejjula essanyu ery’omwoyo! Nga Mukama mukulu gw’ekyaza, nga mugenyi mwagalwa gw’esembeza, nga munno muwoomu gw’eyaniriza, nga mukwano wa mazima gw’efuna, nga mugole mulungi era wa kitiibwa gw’egwa mu kifuba, ayagalibwa era ayaayaanirwa okusinga ebintu byonna ebiyinza okwagalibwa n’okwegombebwa! Eggulu n’ensi n’eby’obugagga byabyo byonna bisirike mu maaso go, ggwe Omwagalwa asinga obuwoomi, kubanga ekitiibwa kyonna n’obulungi bwonna bye birina biva mu bugabi bwo obw’ekisa, era tebiyinza kutuuka ku bulungi bw’erinnya lyo, ggwe ow’amagezi agatayogerekeka.

fields.title: Emikisa Mingi Giweebwa Abo Abasembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu nga Bwe Kisaanidde
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI MUKAMA Katonda wange, wa omuweereza wo emikisa egy’obuwoomi bwo, ndyoke nsaanire okusemberera Ssakramentu yo ey’ekitalo nga bwe kisaanidde era n’omutima ogukwemaliddeko. Yimusa omutima gwange gy’oli era onzigyeko obugayaavu buno obuzito. Onkyalire n’ekisa kyo ekirokola, ndyoke mu mwoyo nkombe ku buwoomi bwo obukwekeddwa mu Ssakramentu eno ng’amazzi mu buziba bw’ensulo. Mulisa amaaso gange ndabe Ekyama kino ekinene, era ompe amaanyi okukikkiriza n’okukkiriza okunywevu.

Kubanga gwe mulimu gwo, so si maanyi ga muntu; kye wateekawo ekitukuvu, so si kye yeeyiiyiza. Tewali muntu ayinza ku bubwe kutegeera n’okumanya ebintu bino ebisukkulumye ne ku kulaba okw’amaanyi okwa bamalayika. Kale nze, omwonoonyi atasaanira, nze enfuufu n’evvu, nnaasobola ntya okunoonyereza n’okutegeera ekyama ekinene bwe kityo?

Ayi Mukama, nzija gy’oli nga bw’olagidde, n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, n’okukkiriza okulungi era okunywevu, n’essuubi n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, era nzikiriza ddala nti oli wano mu Ssakramentu eno, Katonda era omuntu. Oyagala nkusembeze era neegatte naawe mu kwagala. Noolwekyo nkwegayirira onsaasire era nkusaba ompe ekisa eky’enjawulo, nsaanuukire ddala mu ggwe era njijule okwagala kwo, nneme kuddamu kufaayo ku kubudaabudibwa okw’ebweru. Kubanga Ssakramentu eno, esinga obukulu n’okusaana, bwe bulamu bw’emmeeme n’omubiri, era lye ddagala lya buli bunafu bwa mwoyo. Mu yo obulema bwange buwonyezebwa, okwegomba kwange kuziyizibwa, n’okukemebwa kuwangulwa oba kukkakkanyizibwa. Mu yo ekisa ekisingawo kifukibwa, empisa ennungi ezikula ziriisibwa, okukkiriza kunywezebwa, essuubi liweebwa amaanyi, n’okwagala kukoleezebwa ne kubumbujja.

Ggwe, Katonda wange, omukuumi w’emmeeme yange, amaanyi g’obunafu bw’omuntu, era omugabi wa buli kubudaabudibwa okw’omunda, wawa era okyawa emirundi mingi mu Ssakramentu eno ebirabo ebinene eri abaagalwa bo abasembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu n’omutima ogukwemaliddeko. Era obawa okubudaabudibwa kungi wakati mu bizibu byabwe ebingi, n’obasitula okuva mu buziba bw’okuggwaamu amaanyi n’obatuusa ku ssuubi ery’obukuumi bwo. N’ebisa ebiggya obasanyusa era n’obamulisa munda, abo abaali bajjudde okweraliikirira era nga tebalina kwagala nga tebannasembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu balyoke beesange nga bakyuse ne baba balungi okusingawo nga bamaze okulya ku mmere eno ey’omu ggulu n’okunywa ku kyokunywa kino.

Bw’otyo bw’okola n’abalonde bo, balyoke bategeere mu mazima era balabe lwatu nga bwe bali abanafu ku bwabwe, n’obulungi n’ekisa bye bafuna okuva gy’oli. Kubanga newaakubadde ku bwabwe nga banyogoga, nga bakakanyavu, era nga tebeemalidde ku Katonda, ku lulwo bafuuka ababuguumirira, abasanyufu, era abeemalidde ku Katonda.

Ani, mazima, ayinza okusemberera n’obwetoowaze ensulo y’obuwoomi n’atatwalako ku bwo katono? Oba ani, ayimiridde mu maaso g’omuliro ogwaka ennyo, atawulira ku bugumu bwagwo? Ggwe oli nsulo ejjudde bulijjo okuyitiridde! Ggwe oli muliro ogwaka bulijjo era ogutazikira!

Noolwekyo, newaakubadde nga siyinza kumalawo bujjuvu bw’ensulo wadde okunywa ne nkkuta, naye nditeeka emimwa gyange ku mumwa gw’omugga guno ogw’omu ggulu, ndyoke nfuneko ku gwo waakiri ettondo ettono okumalako ennyonta yange, nneme okukala. Era oba nga siyinza kati okuba ow’omu ggulu ddala oba okujjula omuliro nga bakerubi ne basseraafi, naye ndigezaako okweyongera okwemalira ku Katonda n’okuteekateeka omutima gwange, ndyoke nkuŋŋaanye akasasi akatono ak’omuliro ogwa Katonda okuva mu kusembeza n’obwetoowaze Ssakramentu eno ewa obulamu.

Buli kye mbulwa, Ayi Yesu omulungi, Omulokozi asinga obutukuvu, kinjulirize ggwe olw’obulungi bwo n’ekisa kyo, ggwe eyasiima okuyita bonna gy’oli, ng’ogamba nti: “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza.”

Nze, mazima, nkola nga ntuuyana mu ntuuyo z’ekyenyi kyange. Nnumwa nnyo ennaku y’omutima. Nzitoowereddwa ebibi, nteganyizibwa okukemebwa, nzingiziddwa era nnyigirizibwa okwegomba okubi kungi, era tewali annyamba, tewali annunula era andokola okuggyako ggwe, Mukama Katonda wange era Omulokozi wange, gwe nkwasa nze kennyini ne byonna bye nnina, ondabirire era onkulembere eri obulamu obutaggwaawo. Olw’ekitiibwa n’ettendo ly’erinnya lyo nnyaniriza, ggwe eyanteekerateekera Omubiri gwo n’Omusaayi gwo okuba emmere n’ekyokunywa. Kkiriza, Ayi Mukama, Katonda wange era Omulokozi wange, nti nga nsemberera Ebyama byo emirundi mingi, obunyiikivu bw’okukwemalirako kwange bweyongere.

fields.title: Ekitiibwa kya Ssakramentu n’eky’Obwakabona
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

WANDIBADDE n’obulongoofu bwa malayika n’obutukuvu bwa Yokaana Omubatiza, tewandisaanidde kusembeza wadde okugaba Ssakramentu eno. Omuntu okutukuza n’okugaba Ssakramentu ya Kristo, n’okulya emmere ya bamalayika okuba emmere ye, tekiva ku kirungi kyonna ky’asaanidde ng’omuntu. Ekyama kinene, n’ekitiibwa kya bakabona kinene, abaweebwa ekyo bamalayika kye bataaweebwa. Kubanga bakabona bokka, abaayawulibwa mu ngeri entuufu mu Kkanisa, be balina obuyinza okusoma Missa n’okutukuza Omubiri gwa Kristo.

Kabona, mazima, muweereza wa Katonda, akozesa ekigambo kya Katonda nga bw’alagidde era nga bw’ateekawo. Era Katonda ali awo—ye Nnannyini mulimu omukulu era Omukozi atalabika, byonna gwe bigondera nga bw’ayagala, bonna gwe bawulira nga bw’alagira.

Noolwekyo, mu Ssakramentu eno esinga obulungi, osaanidde okukkiriza Katonda okusinga okuwulira kwo wadde akabonero konna akalabika, era bw’otyo, n’okutya n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, osemberere omulimu ng’ogwo. Weetunuulire, olabe obuweereza bw’ani bwe waweebwa olw’okuteekebwako emikono gy’omulabirizi.

Laba, ofuuliddwa kabona, otukuziddwa okusoma Missa! Kaakano weekuume oweeyo ssaddaaka eri Katonda n’obwesigwa era n’omutima ogumwemaliddeko mu biseera ebisaanidde, era weeyise nga tolina kya kunenyezebwa. Omugugu gwo togukendeezezza. Wabula kaakano osibiddwa mu kwefuga okusingako obukakanyavu, era oteekwa okuba n’obutukuvu obutuukiridde okusingawo.

Kabona asaanidde okutimbibwa n’empisa ennungi zonna era okulaga abalala ekyokulabirako eky’obulamu obulungi. Ekkubo lye teriri mu mpisa za bantu eza wansi era ez’abulijjo, wabula liri wamu ne bamalayika mu ggulu n’abantu abatuukiridde ku nsi. Kabona ayambadde ebyambalo ebitukuvu akola mu kifo kya Kristo, alyoke asabe Katonda ku lulwe ne ku lw’abantu bonna, mu ngeri ey’okwegayirira n’obwetoowaze. Alina mu maaso ge ne mabega we akabonero k’omusaalaba gwa Mukama, alyoke ajjukirenga bulijjo okubonaabona kwa Kristo. Guli mu maaso ge, ku kyambalo kya Missa, alyoke atunuulire n’obwegendereza ebisinde bya Kristo era agezeeko okubigoberera n’obunyiikivu. Guli emabega we—ateekeddwako akabonero kaagwo—alyoke agumiikirize n’essanyu ku lwa Katonda ebizibu byonna abalala bye bamutuusaako.

Ayambala omusaalaba mu maaso ge alyoke akaabire ebibi bye ye; emabega we, alyoke, mu kusaasira, akaabire ebibi by’abalala, era amanye nti yateekebwawo okuyimirira wakati wa Katonda n’omwonoonyi, aleme okukoowa okusaba n’ekiweebwayo ekitukuvu okutuusa lw’aliweebwa okufuna ekisa n’okusaasira.

Kabona bw’asoma Missa, assaamu Katonda ekitiibwa, asanyusa bamalayika, anyweza Ekkanisa, ayamba abalamu, awa ekiwummulo abaafa, era yeefunira omugabo mu birungi byonna.

fields.title: Okubuuza ku Ekyo Ekisaanidde Okukolebwa nga Tonnasembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

BWE NDOWOOZA ku kitiibwa kyo, Ayi Mukama, ne ku bunaku bwange, ntya nnyo era ne nsoberwa. Kubanga bwe sisembera, nziruka okuva ku Bulamu; ate bwe neesogga nga sisaanidde, nkunyiiza. Kale kiki kye nnaakola, Katonda wange, Omuyambi wange era Omuwi w’amagezi mu kwetaaga? Njigiriza ekkubo ettuufu. Nteeka mu maaso gange enteekateeka ennyimpi esaanira Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu, kubanga kirungi okumanya engeri gye nsaanidde okuteekateekeramu omutima gwange gy’oli n’okukwemalirako era n’obunyiikivu, okusembeza Ssakramentu yo olw’obulungi bw’emmeeme yange, oba n’okuwaayo ssaddaaka ennene bw’etyo era ey’obwakatonda.

fields.title: Okwekebera Omuntu ow’Omunda n’Okumalirira Okwetereeza
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

OKUSINGA byonna, kabona wa Katonda asaanidde okusemberera okusoma Missa n’okusembeza Ssakramentu eno n’obwetoowaze bw’omutima obusingirayo ddala n’okussaamu ekitiibwa okw’okwegayirira, n’okukkiriza okujjuvu, era n’ekigendererwa ekirungi eky’okugulumiza Katonda.

Kale weekebere n’obwegendereza omuntu wo ow’omunda. Mutukuze era omulongoose nga bw’osobola okusinga, ng’onakuwala mu mazima olw’ebibi byo era ng’oyatula n’obwetoowaze, olyoke obe nga tolina mugugu, nga tolina kikulumiriza, era bw’otyo obe wa ddembe okusembera. Okujjukira ebibi byo byonna kukunakuwaze, era okusingira ddala kaabira era owuubaale olw’ebyonoono byo ebya buli lunaku. Awo, obudde bwe bunaaba bukkiriza, yatula eri Katonda mu buziba obw’ekyama obw’omutima gwo obunaku bwonna okwegomba kwo bwe kwakuleetera.

Kaaba era onakuwale kubanga okyali wa nsi nnyo bw’otyo, wa mubiri bw’otyo, ajjudde okwegomba era atannaba kwefiiriza, ajjudde okwegomba okubi okutawaanyaawanya, atafaayo kukuuma biwulizi eby’ebweru, emirundi mingi atwalibwa ebirowoozo ebingi ebitaliimu, atwalirizibwa nnyo ebintu eby’ebweru era atafaayo ku ebyo ebiri munda, ayanguwa okuseka n’okwetaaya era atayagala kunakuwala na kukaaba maziga, ayagala nnyo okuwummula n’okwesanyusa kw’omubiri era omunyogovu eri okwefuga n’obunyiikivu, ayagala ennyo okuwulira ebiggya n’okulaba ebirungi era omugayaavu okwaniriza okutoowazibwa n’okunyoomebwa, ow’omululu ogw’ebingi, ow’ekkodyo mu kugaba era akwatirira ennyo mu kukuuma, ayogera nga tafumiitirizza, atayagala kusirika, ow’empisa ezitafugibwa, akola ebintu awatali ntegeka, ow’omululu ku mmere, aziba amatu eri Ekigambo kya Katonda, ayanguwa okuwummula era alwawo okukola, atunula nnyo mu kunyumya okutaliimu, alumwa otulo mu kutunula okutukuvu era ayagala nnyo kukomekkerezebwe mangu, ebirowoozo bye bitambulatambula, atafaayo mu kusoma essaala ez’enkalakkalira, ow’ebbugumu ettono mu kusoma Missa, atalina mutima mu kusembeza, atwalibwa mangu, atatera kukuŋŋaanya birowoozo bye ddala, asunguwala mangu, ayanguwa okunyiigira abalala, ayanguwa okusalira abalala omusango, akakanyavu mu kusalira omusango, asanyuka nnyo ng’ebintu bimutambulira bulungi era omunafu mu bizibu, akola emirundi mingi ebigendererwa ebirungi naye n’atuukiriza bitono nnyo ku byo.

Bw’omala okwatula n’okukaabira ensobi zino n’endala, ng’onakuwadde era ng’onyiivu nnyo olw’obunafu bwo, malirira ddala okutereeza obulamu bwo buli lunaku n’okukulaakulana mu bulungi. Awo, mu kwewaayo okujjuvu era n’okwagala kwo kwonna, weeweeyo ku kyoto ky’omutima gwo nga ssaddaaka ey’olubeerera olw’ekitiibwa ky’erinnya lyange, ng’onkwasa n’okukkiriza omubiri n’emmeeme byombi okubirabirira, olyoke olabibwe ng’osaanidde okusembera n’okuwaayo ssaddaaka eri Katonda, n’okusembeza Ssakramentu y’Omubiri gwange mu ngeri ekugasa. Kubanga tewali kiweebwayo kisinga kusaana, tewali kulipirira kusinga bukulu olw’okunaaza ebibi, okusinga okwewaayo ggwe kennyini mu bulongoofu era ddala eri Katonda wamu n’ekiweebwayo ky’Omubiri gwa Kristo mu Missa ne mu Kijjulo Ekitukuvu.

Omuntu bw’akola ky’asobola era nga yeenenyezza ddala, buli lw’ajja gye ndi okufuna ekisa n’okusonyiyibwa, “Nga bwe ndi omulamu, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda, sisanyukira kufa kw’abakozi ba bibi, wabula bo okukyuka ne bava mu kkubo lyabwe ebbi ne baba balamu”; sirijjukira nate bibi bye, naye byonna birimusonyiyibwa.

fields.title: Kristo Okwewaayo ku Musaalaba; Okwewaayo Kwaffe
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

NGA BWE neewaayo ku bwange eri Katonda Kitange olw’ebibi byo, nga ngolodde emikono era nga ndi bwereere ku musaalaba, ne wataba kintu kyonna mu nze ekitafuuse ssaddaaka ejjuvu okukkakkanya obusungu bwa Katonda, bw’otyo naawe bw’osaanidde okwewaayo gye ndi buli lunaku mu Missa ng’ekiweebwayo ekirongoofu era ekitukuvu, wamu n’obusobozi bwo bwonna n’okwagala kwo kwonna, n’okwemalira ku Katonda okw’omunda kwonna kw’osobola.

Kiki kye nsaba okusinga ggwe okwewaayo ddala gye ndi? Sifaayo ku kintu kirala kyonna ky’oyinza okumpa, kubanga sinoonya kirabo kyo wabula ggwe. Nga bwe kitandikumaze okuba ne byonna nga tolina nze, bw’ityo buli ky’ompa tekiyinza kunsanyusa bw’oteewaayo ggwe kennyini.

Noolwekyo weewaayo gye ndi, era weewaayo ddala ku lwa Katonda—ekiweebwayo kyo kirikkirizibwa. Laba, neewaayo ddala eri Kitange ku lulwo, era nawaayo n’Omubiri gwange gwonna n’Omusaayi gwange okuba emmere, ndyoke mbe wuwo ddala, naawe obe wange emirembe gyonna.

Naye bwe weesigama ku bubwo, n’otowaayo kwagala kwo okw’eddembe eri okwagala kwange, ekiweebwayo kyo kiriba tekijjuvu, n’okwegatta wakati waffe kuliba tekutuukiridde. Noolwekyo, bw’oba weegomba okufuna ekisa n’eddembe ly’omutima, okwewaayo kwo okw’eddembe mu mikono gya Katonda kukulemberenga buli kikolwa kyo. Eno ye nsonga lwaki batono nnyo abali ab’eddembe era abaamulisibwa munda—tebamanyi kwefiiriza ddala.

Ekigambo kyange kiyimiridde: “Kale, buli muntu ku mmwe ateefiiriza byonna by’alina, tayinza kuba muyigirizwa wange.”

Noolwekyo, bw’oba oyagala okuba omuyigirizwa wange, weewaayo gye ndi n’omutima gwo gwonna.

fields.title: Tusaanidde Okwewaayo Ffe ne Byonna bye Tulina eri Katonda, nga Tusabira Bonna
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

BYONNA ebiri mu ggulu ne mu nsi bibyo, Ayi Mukama. Neegomba okwewaayo gy’oli ng’ekiweebwayo kya kyeyagalire, mbeere wuwo emirembe gyonna. N’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa neewaayo gy’oli leero, Ayi Mukama, okukuweerezanga emirembe gyonna, okukussaamu ekitiibwa, era nga ssaddaaka ey’okutendereza okutaggwaawo. Nnyaniriza wamu n’ekiweebwayo kino ekitukuvu eky’Omubiri gwo ogw’omuwendo, kye nkuwaayo nange leero, mu maaso ga bamalayika abaliwo nga tebalabika, olw’obulokozi bwange n’obw’abantu bo bonna.

Ayi Mukama, ku kyoto kyo eky’okutangirira, nkuwaayo ebibi byonna n’ebyonoono bye nnakola mu maaso go ne mu maaso ga bamalayika bo abatukuvu, okuva ku lunaku lwe nnasooka okuyinza okwonoona okutuusa essaawa eno, obyokye era obimalewo byonna mu muliro gw’okwagala kwo, osangule buli bbala lyabyo, olongoose omuntu wange ow’omunda okuva ku buli nsobi, era onzizeemu ekisa kyo kye nnafiirwa mu kwonoona, ng’onsonyiwa ddala byonna era ng’onnyaniriza n’okusaasira n’okunywegera okw’emirembe.

Kiki kye nnyinza okukola olw’ebibi byange byonna okuggyako okubyatula n’obwetoowaze n’okubikaabira, n’okwegayiriranga okusaasira kwo obutayosa? Mu kusaasira kwo, nkwegayiridde, mpulira bwe nnyimirira mu maaso go, Katonda wange. Ebibi byange byonna binnyiiza nnyo. Njagala obutaddamu kubikola n’akatono. Mbinakuwalira era nja kubinakuwaliranga ebbanga lyonna lye ndimala nga ndi mulamu. Neetegese okwenenya n’okulipirira nga bwe nsobola okusinga.

Nsonyiwa, Ayi Katonda, onsonyiwe ebibi byange olw’Erinnya lyo Ettukuvu. Lokola emmeeme yange gye wanunula n’Omusaayi gwo ogw’omuwendo ennyo. Laba, neeteeka mu kusaasira kwo. Neekwasa mu mikono gyo. Onkole ng’obulungi bwo bwe buli, so si ng’amakubo gange ag’ettima era amabi bwe gali.

Nkuwaayo n’ebirungi byonna bye nnina, newaakubadde nga bitono era nga tebituukiridde, obifuule ebirongoofu n’ebitukuvu okusingawo, obisiime, obifuule ebikusanyusa, obituukirize okweyongera, era ku nkomerero onkulembere, nze ekitonde ekigayaavu era ekitalina mugaso, okutuuka ku nkomerero ennungi era ey’essanyu.

Era nkuwaayo okwegomba kwonna okutukuvu okw’abaweereza bo abakwemaliddeko, n’ebyetaago by’abazadde bange, ab’emikwano, baganda bange ne bannyinaze, n’abo bonna be njagala; eby’abo bonna abankoledde ebirungi oba abakoledde abalala ebirungi ku lulwo; n’eby’abo bonna abaayagala era ne bansaba okubasabira n’okubasomera Missa bo n’ababwe, oba nga bakyali balamu mu mubiri oba nga bavudde dda mu nsi muno, balyoke bonna bawulire obuyambi bw’ekisa kyo, amaanyi g’okubudaabuda kwo, okukuumibwa mu kabi, okununulibwa mu kibonerezo ekigenda okujja, era, nga bawonyezeddwa mu bubi bwonna, bakwebaze nnyo n’essanyu.

Era nkuwaayo essaala zino ne Ssaddaaka ey’Okutangirira, okusingira ddala ku lw’abo abankoze obubi mu ngeri yonna, abannakuwaza oba abanjogeddeko eby’obulimba, abanfiiriza oba abandeetedde obulumi; era ne ku lw’abo bonna be nnali nnakuwazizza, be nneeraliikiriza, be nnyiizizza, era be nnavuma mu bigambo oba mu bikolwa, nga mmanyi oba nga simanyi. Kikusanyuse okutusonyiwa ffenna awamu ebibi byaffe n’ebyonoono bye tukoleragana.

Ggyawo mu mitima gyaffe, Ayi Mukama, okwekengera kwonna, obusungu, ekiruyi, okuyomba, na buli kiyinza okwonoona okwagala n’okukendeeza ku kwagalana kw’ab’oluganda. Saasira, Ayi Mukama, saasira abo abakwegayirira okusaasira kwo, wa ekisa abo abakyetaaga, era otufuule abasaanidde okunyumirwa ekisa kyo n’okutuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo.

fields.title: Toleka Kijjulo Ekitukuvu mu Bwangu
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

OTEEKWA okudda emirundi mingi ku nsulo y’ekisa n’okusaasira kwa Katonda, ku luzzi lw’obulungi n’obulongoofu obutuukiridde, bw’oba oyagala okusumululwa mu kwegomba okubi ne mu bibi, era bw’oba weegomba okufuulibwa ow’amaanyi era ateesimbye nnyo ku kukemebwa kwonna n’obulimba bwonna obwa Setaani.

Omulabe, kubanga amanyi obulungi obunene n’amaanyi agawonya ag’Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu, agezaako nga bw’asobola mu ngeri zonna n’amagezi gonna okuziyiza n’okugaana abeesigwa n’abeemalidde ku Katonda okusembera. Mazima waliwo abamu abasanga okulumbibwa kwa Setaani okusingirayo ddala obubi nga beeteekateeka okusembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu. Nga bwe kyawandiikibwa mu Yobu, omwoyo ono omubi ajja wakati mu baana ba Katonda okubateganya n’ettima lye erya bulijjo, okubatiisa ennyo n’okubasoberwa, alyoke akendeeze ku kwemalira kwabwe ku Katonda oba alumbe okukkiriza kwabwe, okutuusa lwe bayinza okuleka okusembera ku Kijjulo ddala, oba okusembera n’obunyiikivu butono.

Naye enkwe ze ez’obukujjukujju tezisaana kufiibwako n’akatono, ne bwe ziba za kivve n’entiisa ki — byonna by’akuteekamu bisaana kumuzzibwako ku mutwe gwe. Omunafu oyo asaana kunyoomebwa n’okusekererwa. Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu tekisaana kulekebwa olw’okulumbibwa kwe kwonna, wadde olw’akavuyo k’ayinza okuleeta.

Emirundi mingi n’okweraliikirira ennyo okusukkiridde ku kwemalira ku Katonda n’okutawaana ku kwatula ebibi biziyiza omuntu. Kola nga bwe bakola abantu ab’amagezi. Leka okweraliikirira n’okubuusabuusa okw’omuntu ow’omunda, kubanga biziyiza ekisa kya Katonda era bizikiriza okwemalira kw’omutima ku Katonda.

Tewesamba Kijjulo Ekitukuvu olw’akazibu akatono oba olw’okunyiigako, naye genda mangu wenenye ebibi byo, era osonyiwe abalala bonna n’omutima gumu bye bakusobya. Bw’obanga wanyiiza omuntu yenna, saba ekisonyiwo mu bwetoowaze, era Katonda anaakusonyiwa mangu.

Kigasa ki okulwisa ennyo okwatula ebibi oba okwongezaayo Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu? Weerongoose mangu, tulisa obutwa amangu. Yanguwa okussaako eddagala, era ojja kusanga nga kisinga bw’oba olinze ebbanga ddene. Bw’okyongezaayo leero olw’ekintu ekimu, oboolyawo enkya ekisinga obunene kirikujjira, bw’otyo ne weesamba Ekijjulo okumala ebbanga ddene, ne weeyongera n’okubulwa obusaanyizo.

Kunkumula obuzito buno n’obugayaavu mangu nga bw’osobola, kubanga tewali kigasa mu kweraliikirira kungi, mu kugumiikiriza essaawa nnyingi ez’okutawaana, ne mu kwemma Ebyama ebya Katonda olw’obutabanguko buno obwa buli lunaku. Weewaawo, kya kabi nnyo okwongezaayo Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu okumala ebbanga ddene, kubanga ebiseera ebisinga kireeta otulo tw’omwoyo otw’obugayaavu.

Nga kya nnaku abantu abamu abeeyisa obubi era abagayaavu okukkiriza okwongezaayo okwatula ebibi, era n’okwagala okwongezaayo Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu, baleme okuwalirizibwa okwekuuma ennyo! Woowe, nga balina okwagala kutono n’okwemalira ku Katonda kutono abo abaleka Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu mu bwangu bwe batyo!

Nga wa mukisa era asiimibwa Katonda oyo abeera mu bulamu obw’engeri eyo, n’akuuma omuntu we ow’omunda nga mulongoofu, n’abeera mwetegefu era nga yeeteeseteese bulungi okusembera, ne buli lunaku singa yali akkirizibwa, era singa yali asobola okukikola nga tategeerwa.

Omuntu bw’alekayo okusembera ebiseera ebimu olw’ekisa ky’obwetoowaze oba olw’ensonga entuufu, okussaamu kwe ekitiibwa kusaana kutenderezebwa; naye obugayaavu bwe bumukwata, ateekwa okwezuukusa n’akola byonna by’asobola, kubanga Mukama alisitula okwegomba kwe olw’ekigendererwa ekirungi ky’asinga okutunuulira. Bw’aba ddala nga tasobola kujja, aba alina bulijjo okwagala okulungi n’ekigendererwa eky’okutya Katonda eky’okusembera, era bw’atyo taafiirwe bibala bya Ssakramentu.

Omuntu yenna eyeemalidde ku Katonda ayinza mu ssaawa yonna, ku lunaku lwonna, okusembera ku Kristo mu mwoyo, n’amuganyulwa era awatali kimuziyiza.
