Naye ku nnaku ezimu n’ebiseera ebyateekebwawo asaanidde okutoola, n’okwagala era n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, Omubiri gw’Omununuzi we mu Ssakramentu eno, ng’anoonya okutenderezebwa n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda okusinga okubudaabudibwa kwe ye.

Kubanga buli lw’ajjukira n’omutima ogwemalidde ku Katonda ekyama n’okubonaabona kwa Kristo eyafuuka omuntu, n’ayakirira okwagala gy’ali, aba asembedde mu ngeri ey’ekyama era aba azzibwamu amaanyi mu ngeri etalabika.

Oyo eyeeteekateeka nga embaga zisembedde zokka oba empisa bwe zimulagira, emirundi mingi ajja kwesanga nga teyeeteeseteese. Alina omukisa oyo eyeewaayo eri Mukama nga ssaddaaka buli lw’asoma Missa oba lw’asembera.

Tobanga mugayaavu nnyo wadde ow’obwangu ennyo mu kusoma Missa, naye goberera empisa ennungi ey’abo b’obeera nabo. Tosaana kuleetera balala kutawaana oba kuteganyizibwa, naye kwata etteeka eryakkirizibwa nga bwe lyateekebwawo abakulu, era tunuulira omugaso gw’abalala okusinga okwemalira kwo ku Katonda oba bye weeyagaliza.

fields.title: Omubiri gwa Kristo n’Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu Bye Bisinga Okwetaagibwa Emmeeme Eyeesigwa
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI MUKAMA YESU omuwoomu ennyo, essanyu ly’emmeeme eyeemalidde ku Katonda nga ddene, emmeeme erya ku ggwe ku mbaga yo, gy’eteekerwawo okulya emmere etali ndala wabula ggwe wekka, Omwagalwa wayo omu yekka, asinga byonna omutima gwayo bye guyinza okwegomba!

Gyendi kyandibadde ssanyu ddala okukulukusa amaziga mu maaso go okuva mu buziba bw’okwagala obw’omunda ennyo, era nga Magudaleena eyali atya Katonda, okuganaaza ebigere byo. Naye kaakano okwemalira kuno ku Katonda kuli ludda wa, okukulukuta kuno okungi okw’amaziga amatukuvu? Mazima mu maaso go, mu maaso ga bamalayika bo abatukuvu, omutima gwange gwonna gwandyakidde ne gukaaba olw’essanyu. Kubanga wadde nga weekwese mu kifaananyi ekirala, nkulina ddala mu Ssakramentu ng’oli wano.

Amaaso gange tegandisobodde kukutunuulira mu kumasamasa kwo okw’obwakatonda, era n’ensi yonna teyandiyimiridde mu kumasamasa kw’ekitiibwa ky’obukulu bwo. N’olwekyo bwe weebikka mu Ssakramentu, ofaayo ku bunafu bwange.

Mazima ndi naye era nsinza oyo bamalayika gwe basinza mu ggulu — nze kaakano mu kukkiriza, bo maaso ku maaso nga tewali kibikka. Nteekwa okumatira ekitangaala ky’okukkiriza okw’amazima n’okutambulira mu kyo okutuusa olunaku olw’okumasamasa okutaggwaawo lwe lulikya, n’ekisiikirize ky’ebifaananyi ne kiggwaawo. Era, ebituukiridde bwe birijja, obwetaavu bwa ssakramentu bujja kuggwaawo, kubanga abali mu kitiibwa eky’omu ggulu tebeetaaga ssakramentu ya kuwonya. Nga basanyuka awatali kukoma mu maaso ga Katonda, nga balaba ekitiibwa kye maaso ku maaso, nga bakyusibwa okuva mu kumasamasa kwabwe okutuuka mu kumasamasa kw’Obwakatonda obutayogerekeka, bawooma Kigambo kya Katonda eyafuuka omubiri, nga bwe yali ku lubereberye era bw’alibeera emirembe n’emirembe.

Wadde nga ndowooza ku bintu bino ebyewuunyisa, buli kubudaabudibwa kwa mwoyo kunkooya, kubanga bwe mba nga sinnalaba Mukama mu lwatu mu kitiibwa kye, buli kye mpulira ne kye ndaba ku nsi nkitwala nga kya mugaso mutono.

Ggwe mujulirwa wange, Ayi Katonda, nti tewali kiyinza kumbudaabuda, tewali kitonde kiyinza kumpummuza wabula ggwe, Katonda wange, gwe njagala okutunuulira emirembe gyonna. Naye kino tekisoboka nga nkyali mu bulamu buno obufa, n’olwekyo nteekwa okuba omugumiikiriza ennyo n’okukwewaayo mu buli kye nneegomba.

Ne batukuvu bo, Ayi Mukama, kaakano abasanyuka naawe mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, baalindirira okujja kw’ekitiibwa kyo n’okukkiriza n’obugumiikiriza obungi nga bakyali balamu. Kye baakkiriza, nange nkikkiriza. Kye baasuubira, nange nkisuubira, era gye baatuuka, nneesiga nti nange ndituukayo olw’ekisa kyo. Mu kiseera kino nnaatambuliranga mu kukkiriza, nga nzizibwamu amaanyi olw’eky’okulabirako ky’abatukuvu. Ate era ndiba n’Ebitabo ebitukuvu okumbudaabuda n’okuluŋŋamya obulamu bwange, era okusinga ebyo byonna, Omubiri gwo omutukuvu ennyo ng’ekiddukiro kyange eky’enjawulo era obuddukiro bwange.

Mpulira nga mu bulamu buno nneetaaga nnyo ebintu bibiri, awatali byo obuyinike bwabwo bwandibadde tebugumiikirizika. Nga nsibiddwa wano mu kkomera lino ery’omubiri, njatula nti nneetaaga ebintu bino ebibiri, emmere n’ekitangaala. N’olwekyo mu bunafu bwange ompadde Omubiri gwo omutukuvu okuzza obuggya emmeeme yange n’omubiri gwange, era ossizzaawo ekigambo kyo okuba ttaala eri ebigere byange. Awatali byo sandisobodde kubeera mu bulamu obutuufu, kubanga ekigambo kya Katonda kye kitangaala ky’emmeeme yange, ate Ssakramentu yo ye mmere ey’obulamu.

Bino era biyinza okuyitibwa emmeeza ebbiri, emu eruuyi, endala eruuyi, mu ggwanika ly’Ekkanisa entukuvu. Emu ye mmeeza ey’ekyoto ekitukuvu, eriko Omugaati omutukuvu, gwe Mubiri gwa Kristo ogw’omuwendo. Endala ye mmeeza ey’etteeka lya Katonda, eriko okuyigiriza okutukuvu okuyigiriza bonna okukkiriza okw’amazima era okubatwala n’obunywevu munda w’eggigi, mu Kifo Ekisinga Obutukuvu.

Weebale, Mukama Yesu, Ekitangaala eky’ekitangaala ekitaggwaawo, olw’emmeeza ey’okuyigiriza kwo okutukuvu kw’otuteeseteerezza ng’oyita mu baweereza bo, bannabbi n’Abatume n’abantu abalala abayivu.

Weebale, Omutonzi era Omununuzi w’abantu, eyatuteekerateekera embaga ennene okulaga okwagala kwo eri ensi yonna, n’otuteekerawo okulya, si mwana gw’endiga, ekifaananyi kyo, wabula Omubiri gwo n’Omusaayi gwo eby’omuwendo ennyo, n’osanyusa abeesigwa bonna ku mbaga yo entukuvu, n’obanywesa okutamiira mu kikompe eky’obulokozi omuli ebisanyusa byonna eby’olusuku lwa Katonda; ne bamalayika abatukuvu baliira wamu naffe, naye n’essanyu n’obuwoomi ebisingawo.

Ayi, omulimu gwa kabona nga gwa kitiibwa era nga mukulu, oyo aweereddwa okutukuza Mukama ow’obukulu mu bigambo ebitukuvu, emimwa gye gimutendereza, emikono gye gimukwata, olulimi lwe lumutoola, era omulimu gwe kwe kumutwalira abalala!

Ayi, emikono egyo nga gisaanidde okuba emirongoofu, emimwa nga mirongoofu, omubiri nga mutukuvu, omutima gwa kabona nga tegulina bbala, kabona oyo Ensibuko y’obulongoofu bwonna gw’ajjira emirundi emingi bwe gityo. Tewali kigambo kirala wabula ekitukuvu, ekirungi era ekigasa, kisaana kuva ku mimwa gya kabona atoola emirundi emingi bwe gityo Ssakramentu ya Kristo. Amaaso agamanyidde okutunuulira Omubiri gwa Kristo gasaana kuba ga mutima gumu era ag’obwetoowaze. Emikono egimanyidde okukwata Omutonzi w’eggulu n’ensi gisaana kuba mirongoofu era nga giyimusiddwa eri eggulu. Bakabona okusinga abalala bonna baawandiikirwa mu mateeka nti, “Mubeerenga batukuvu, kubanga nze Mukama Katonda wammwe ndi mutukuvu.”

Ekisa kyo, Ayi Katonda Omuyinzawaabyonna, kituyambe, ffe abaatwala omulimu gw’obwakabona tusobole okukuweereza nga bwe tusaanidde era nga twemalidde ku ggwe mu bulongoofu bwonna ne mu muntu ow’omunda omulungi. Era bwe tuba nga tetusobola kubeera mu bulamu obutaliiko kamogo nga bwe tusaanidde, tuwe waakiri okukungubagira nga bwe kisaanidde ebisobyo bye twakola, era mu mwoyo gw’obwetoowaze n’ekigendererwa eky’okwagala okulungi, okukuweereza n’obunyiikivu obusingawo mu biseera ebijja.

fields.title: Asembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu Asaanidde Okweteekerateekera Kristo n’Obwegendereza Bungi
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

NZE Ayagala obulongoofu, Agaba obutukuvu bwonna. Nnoonya omutima omulongoofu, era eyo y’ekifo kyange eky’okuwummuliramu.

Ntegekera ekisenge ekinene ekya waggulu nga kitegekeddwa bulungi, nange n’abayigirizwa bange tujja kuliira naawe Embaga ey’Okuyitako.

Bw’oba oyagala nzije gy’oli mbeere naawe, ggyamu ekizimbulukusa eky’edda era olongoose ennyumba y’omutima gwo. Siba oluggi ensi yonna n’oluyoogaano lwonna olw’ebibi byayo. Tuula ng’ekinyonyi ekitudde kyokka ku kasolya k’ennyumba, olowooze ku byonoono byo mu bulumi bw’emmeeme yo.

Buli muntu ayagala ateekerateekera omwagalwa we ennyumba esinga obulungi n’okulabika obulungi, kubanga mu ekyo okwagala kw’oyo ayaniriza omwagalwa we mwe kutegeerebwa.

Naye tegeera nti toyinza ku lw’obulungi bwo bwonna kukola okwetegeka kuno ku kigero ekimala, ne bw’omala omwaka mulamba ng’okukola era nga tolowooza ku kintu kirala. Olw’obulungi bwange n’ekisa kyange kyokka kw’okkirizibwa okusemberera emmeeza yange, ng’omwavu bw’ayitibwa omugagga ku kijjulo, nga talina ky’ayinza kuwaayo kusasula kirabo ekyo wabula okwetoowaza n’okwebaza.

Kola ky’osobola, era kikole n’obwegendereza. Toola Omubiri gwa Mukama, Katonda wo omwagalwa asiima okujja gy’oli, si olw’empisa oba olw’obwetaavu, wabula n’okutya, n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, era n’okwagala.

Nze nzuuyo eyakuyita. Nze nnalagira kikolebwe. Nze ndikuwa by’obulwa. Jjangu ontoole.

Bwe nkuwa ekisa ky’okwemalira ku Katonda, weebaze Katonda, si lwa kuba nti osaanidde wabula kubanga nkusaasidde. Bw’oba tokirina era n’owulira nga wakalidde, weeyongere okusaba, sinda era weeyongere okukonkona, era tolekera awo okutuusa lw’onoofuna akakunkumuka akamu ak’ekisa ekirokola.

Ggwe weetaaga nze. Nze sikwetaaga. Tojja kuntukuza, wabula nze nzija okukutukuza n’okukufuula omulungi okusingawo. Ojja okutukuzibwa n’okugattibwa nange, okufuna ekisa ekiggya n’okuzuukusibwa obuggya okwerongoosa. Tolagajjalira kisa kino, naye tegeka omutima gwo n’obwegendereza bwonna, oyingizeemu Omwagalwa wo.

Tosaanidde kwetegeka bwetegesi n’okwemalira ku Katonda nga tonnasembera ku Kijjulo, naye era osaanidde okwekuuma n’obwegendereza mu kwemalira ku Katonda ng’omaze okutoola Ssakramentu. Okwekuuma n’obwegendereza oluvannyuma tekwetaagibwa kitono okusinga okwetegeka n’okwemalira ku Katonda nga tonnasembera, kubanga okutunula n’obwegendereza oluvannyuma kwe kwetegeka okusinga obulungi okufuna ekisa ekisingawo. Omuntu bw’aleka ebirowoozo bye okuwaba ne bigoberera essanyu ery’ebweru, abulwa ddala obwetegefu.

Weekuume okwogera ennyo. Beera wekka mu kasirise onyumirwe Katonda wo, kubanga olina oyo ensi yonna gw’etayinza kukuggyako.

Nze nzuuyo gw’osaanidde okwewaayo gy’ali ddala, olyoke okuva kati obeere mulamu, si mu ggwe wekka, wabula mu nze, ng’emitawaana gyonna ogisudde eri.

fields.title: Emmeeme Eyeemalidde ku Katonda Esaanidde Okwegomba n’Omutima Gwayo Gwonna Okugattibwa ne Kristo mu Ssakramentu
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

KIMPEBWE okukusanga ggwe wekka, Ayi Kristo, okukuggulirawo omutima gwange gwonna, okukunyumirwa nga emmeeme yange bw’eyagala, obutataataaganyizibwa muntu yenna, obutasikambulwa wadde okutawaanyizibwa ekitonde kyonna, olyoke oyogere nange era nange njogere naawe wekka, ng’omwagalwa bw’ayogera n’oyo gw’ayagala, era ng’omuntu bw’anyumya ne mukwano gwe.

Kino kye nsaba, kino kye nneegomba, okugattibwa naawe ddala, n’okuggya omutima gwange ku bitonde byonna, nga njiga okuwoomerwa eby’omu ggulu n’ebitaggwaawo okuyita mu Kijjulo Ekitukuvu n’okusoma Missa emirundi emingi.

Woowe, Ayi Mukama Katonda, ndiddi lwe ndigattibwa naawe ddala ne mmirwa mu ggwe, nga neerabidde ddala? Ggwe mu nze, nange mu ggwe? Kkiriza tubeere bwe tutyo awamu. Mazima ggwe Mwagalwa wange, atabula ne mu bantu omutwalo, emmeeme yange gw’esanyuka okubeeramu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwayo. Mazima ggwe musingo gw’emirembe gyange, mu ggwe mwe muli emirembe egisinga obunene n’okuwummula okwa nnamaddala, era awatali ggwe waliwo okutegana n’ennaku n’obuyinike obutakoma.

Ddala oli Katonda eyeekweka. Okuteesa kwo tekuli wamu na babi, wabula onyumya n’abeetoowaze n’abantu abataliimu bukuusa.

Ayi, omwoyo gwo nga mulungi, Mukama, ggwe, okulaga obuwoomi bwo eri abaana bo, asiima okubaliisa emmere esinga obuwoomi, emmere eyava mu ggulu! Mazima tewali ggwanga ddala lirina mukisa nga lino okubeera ne katonda waalyo okumpi nalyo, nga ggwe, Katonda waffe, bw’oli buli wamu eri abeesigwa, b’owa okukulya n’okukunyumirwa olw’okubudaabudibwa kwabwe okwa buli lunaku n’okuyimusa emitima gyabwe eri eggulu.

Mazima ggwanga ki eddala eryatiikirivu ng’abantu Abakristaayo? Kitonde ki wansi w’eggulu ekyaweebwa ekisa ekinene ng’emmeeme eyeemalidde ku Katonda, Katonda gy’ajjira okugiriisa Omubiri gwe ogw’ekitiibwa? Ayi ekisa ekitayogerekeka! Ayi okwetoowaza okwewuunyisa! Ayi okwagala okutaliiko kigero, okwaweebwa omuntu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo!

Mukama ndimusasula ntya olw’okwagala kuno, olw’ekisa kino ekitaliiko kkomo bwe kityo? Tewali kye nnyinza kuwaayo ekisinga okumusanyusa okusinga okuwaayo omutima gwange gwonna eri Katonda wange, nga ngugatta ku gugwe ddala. Olwo nno obulamu bwange bwonna obw’omunda bulisanyuka, emmeeme yange bw’eriba egattiddwa ddala ne Katonda. Olwo alingamba nti: “Bw’onoobeeranga nange, nange nnaabeeranga naawe.” Nange ndimuddamu nti: “Siima, Ayi Mukama, okusigala nange. Nnaabeeranga naawe n’essanyu. Kino kye nneegomba kyokka, omutima gwange gugattibwe naawe.”

fields.title: Okwegomba Okw’Amaanyi kw’Abantu Abeemalidde ku Katonda olw’Omubiri gwa Kristo
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI MUKAMA, obulungi bwo, bwe waterekera abo abakutya nga buyitirivu!

Bwe ndowooza engeri abantu abamu abeemalidde ku Katonda gye basemberera Ssakramentu yo n’okwemalira ku Katonda n’okwagala okusingirayo ddala, emirundi mingi nkwatibwa ensonyi era ne nsoberwa olw’okuba nga nsemberera ekyoto kyo n’emmeeza y’Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu n’obunnyogovu era nga sifaayo; olw’okuba nga nsigala nga nkaze bwe nti era nga sirina kwagala kwa mu mutima; olw’okuba nga saakidde ddala mu maaso go, Ayi Katonda wange, era nga sisikiriziddwa na kusendebwa n’amaanyi ng’abantu bangi abeemalidde ku Katonda, abaali tebasobola kuziyiza maziga gaabwe olw’okwegomba kwabwe okungi okw’Ekijjulo n’okwagala okw’amaanyi okw’omu mutima, wabula baayaayaananga okuva mu buziba bw’emmeeme zaabwe n’emibiri gyabwe okukuwambaatira, ggwe Ensulo y’Obulamu. Abo tebaasobola kukkakkanya na kumalawo njala yaabwe mu ngeri ndala yonna wabula okutoola Omubiri gwo n’essanyu lyonna n’obunyiikivu obw’omwoyo. Okukkiriza kw’abantu abo kwali kwa mazima era kwa maanyi — obukakafu obumatiza obw’okubeerawo kwo okutukuvu. Abo abalina emitima egyakira bwe gityo munda mu bo nga Yesu abeera nabo, ddala bategeera Mukama waabwe mu kumenya omugaati.

Okwagala n’okwemalira ku Katonda okw’engeri eyo, okwagala okw’amaanyi bwe kutyo n’obunyiikivu, emirundi mingi bisukka nnyo ku bye nnyinza. Nsaasira, Ayi Yesu omuwoomu, omulungi, ow’ekisa, ompe nze, omwavu wo akwegayirira, waakiri ebiseera ebimu okuwulira mu Kijjulo Ekitukuvu akatono ku bugonvu bw’okwagala kwo, okukkiriza kwange kulyoke kweyongere amaanyi, essuubi lyange mu bulungi bwo lyeyongere, era okwagala, bwe kulimala okukoleezebwa ddala munda mu nze olw’okuwooma emmaanu ey’omu ggulu, kuleme kuggwaawo emirembe gyonna.

Okusaasira kwo kuyinza okumpa ekisa kye nneegomba era kuyinza okunkyalira n’ekisa ekingi ennyo n’obunyiikivu bw’emmeeme nga bw’osiima. Kubanga wadde nga kaakano saakidde na kwegomba kunene ng’okw’abo abeewaddeyo gy’oli mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, naye olw’ekisa kyo nneegomba ennimi z’omuliro ezo zennyini ennene, nga nsaba era nga nnoonya ekifo mu bonna abakwagala bwe batyo n’omuliro, ndyoke mbalibwe mu kibiina kyabwe ekitukuvu.

fields.title: Ekisa ky’Okwemalira ku Katonda Kifunibwa olw’Obwetoowaze n’Okwefiiriza
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

OTEEKWA okunoonya n’obunyiikivu ekisa ky’okwemalira ku Katonda, okukisaba n’omutima gwonna, okukirindirira n’obugumiikiriza n’essuubi, okukitoola n’okwebaza, okukikuuma mu bwetoowaze, okukolera awamu nakyo n’obwegendereza, era okulekera Katonda, bwe kijja, obuwanvu n’engeri y’okukyalirwa okw’omu ggulu.

Bw’owulira ng’olina okwemalira ku Katonda okw’omunda kutono oba nga tolina n’akatono, osaanidde okusingira ddala okwetoowaza, naye tonakuwala nnyo wadde okuba n’ennaku ey’ekisukkirivu. Emirundi mingi mu kaseera katono Katonda awa ekyo kye yamala ebbanga ddene ng’agaana. Ebiseera ebimu awa ku nkomerero ekyo kye yagaana okuva ku ntandikwa y’okusaba. Singa ekisa kyaweebwanga mangu buli kiseera, oba nga kibeerawo buli lwe tukyetaaga, abantu abanafu tebandikitwalidde bulungi. N’olwekyo lindirira ekisa ky’okwemalira ku Katonda n’essuubi eddungi n’obugumiikiriza obw’obwetoowaze.

Bwe kitaweebwa, oba bwe kiggibwawo olw’ensonga etamanyiddwa, teeka omusango ku ggwe kennyini ne ku bibi byo. Ebiseera ebimu kiba kintu kitono ekiziyiza ekisa ne kikikweka, oba nga kye kiziyiza obulungi obunene bwe butyo kiyinza okuyitibwa ekitono so si ekinene. Naye bw’oggyawo ekiziyiza kino, kibe kinene oba kitono, era bw’okiwangula ddala, ojja kufuna ky’osaba. Bw’onoomala okwewaayo eri Katonda n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’otonoonya kino wadde kiri olw’okwesanyusa kwo n’ekigendererwa kyo, wabula ne weekwasa ddala mu mikono gye, ojja kwesanga ng’oli mu mirembe, ng’ogattiddwa naye, kubanga tewali kirikuwoomera, tewali kirikusanyusa nnyo ng’okusiima kw’okwagala kwe.

N’olwekyo buli muntu aliteeka ekigendererwa kye ku Katonda n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, ne yeggyako okwagala n’okukyawa okutali kwa nkola ku kitonde kyonna, aliba asingira ddala okusaanira okufuna ekisa era aliba agwanidde ekirabo ky’okwemalira ku Katonda. Kubanga Mukama gy’asanga ekibya nga kyereere, eyo gy’afukira omukisa gwe.

Era bwe kityo, omuntu gy’akoma okulekayo ddala ebintu by’ensi eno, n’okufiira ddala ku lulwe ng’anyooma obwe, ekisa kino ekinene gye kikoma okumujjira amangu, gye kikoma okuyingira mu bungi, era gye kikoma okuyimusa waggulu omutima ogw’eddembe.

Olwo alilaba n’ajjula, olwo omutima gwe gulyewuunya ne gugaziwa munda mu ye, kubanga omukono gwa Mukama guli wamu naye, era mu kibatu ky’omukono ogwo mw’eyeeteeka emirembe gyonna. Bw’atyo omuntu bw’aliweebwa omukisa oyo anoonya Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna, era atafudde mmeeme ye bwereere. Omuntu ow’engeri eyo, bw’asembera ku Kijjulo Ekitukuvu, asaanira ekisa eky’okugattibwa ne Katonda, kubanga tatunuulira birowoozo bye ye, wadde okubudaabudibwa kwe, wabula okusinga okwemalira ku Katonda n’okubudaabudibwa kwonna atunuulira ekitiibwa n’ettendo lya Katonda.

fields.title: Tusaanidde Okulaga Kristo Ebyetaago Byaffe n’Okusaba Ekisa Kye
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

AYI MUKAMA ow’ekisa ennyo, ayagala ennyo, gwe nneegomba kaakano okutoola nga nneemalidde ku ggwe, omanyi obunafu n’obwetaavu bwe ndimu, ebibi n’ebikolwa ebibi ebinene bye nzingiddwamu, n’emirundi emingi bwe nzitoowererwa, bwe nkemebwa, bwe nnyonoonebwa, era bwe ntawaanyizibwa.

Gy’oli gye nzija okuyambibwa, gy’oli gye nsaba okubudaabudibwa n’okuwummuzibwa. Njogera n’oyo amanyi byonna, obulamu bwange bwonna obw’omunda bwe bweyolekera, era ayinza yekka okumbudaabuda n’okunnyamba mu bujjuvu.

Omanyi ebirungi bye nsinga okwetaaga, era nga bwe ndi omwavu mu mpisa ennungi. Laba, nnyimiridde mu maaso go nga ndi mwavu era bwereere, nga nsaba ekisa kyo era nga nkwegayirira onsaasire.

Liisa omusabiriza wo alumwa enjala. Koleeza obunnyogovu bwange n’omuliro gw’okwagala kwo. Mulisa obuzibe bwange n’okumasamasa kw’okubeerawo kwo. Fuula gye ndi ebintu byonna eby’ensi okuba ebikaawa, buli kinyiiza na buli kizibu okuba eby’okugumiikiriza, n’ebitonde byonna ebya wansi okuba eby’okunyoomebwa n’okwerabirwa. Yimusa omutima gwange gy’oli mu ggulu, era tondeka kuwaba ku nsi. Okuva kaakano okutuusa emirembe gyonna ggwe wekka obe omuwoomu gye ndi, kubanga ggwe wekka gw’oli emmere yange n’ekyokunywa kyange, okwagala kwange n’essanyu lyange, obuwoomi bwange n’obulungi bwange bwonna.

Okubeerawo kwo kunkoleeze ddala, kunjokye era kunkyuse okufaanana ggwe, ndyoke nfuuke omu mu mwoyo naawe olw’ekisa ky’okugattibwa okw’omunda n’olw’amaanyi agasaanuusa ag’okwagala kwo okwaka.

Tondeka kuva gy’oli nga nsiiba era nga ndumwa ennyonta, naye onkole n’okusaasira nga bw’okoze emirundi mingi era mu ngeri ey’ekitalo eri abatukuvu bo.

Kyandibadde kya kwewuunya ki singa nkoleezebwa ddala ggwe, ne nfiira ku lwange, kubanga ggwe muliro ogwaka bulijjo era ogutazikira, okwagala okulongoosa omutima era okumulisa amagezi.

fields.title: Okwagala Okwaka n’Okwegomba Okw’Amaanyi Okutoola Kristo
fields.body_html:
Omuyigirizwa

N’OKWEMALIRA ku ggwe okusingirayo ddala n’okwagala okwaka, n’okwagala kwonna n’obunyiikivu bw’omutima, njagala okukutoola, Ayi Mukama, ng’abatukuvu bangi n’abantu abeemalidde ku Katonda, abaakusanyusa ennyo olw’obutukuvu bw’obulamu bwabwe era abaali abanyiikivu ennyo mu kwemalira ku ggwe, bwe baakwegomba mu Kijjulo Ekitukuvu.

Ayi Katonda wange, okwagala okutaggwaawo, obulungi bwange obw’enkomerero, essanyu lyange eritakoma, njaayaanira okukutoola n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi era n’okussaamu ekitiibwa okusaanidde ng’okwo omutukuvu yenna kwe yali nakwo oba kwe yandiwulidde, era wadde nga sisaanira kuba na kwemalira kuno kwonna ku ggwe, naye nkuwa okwagala kwonna okw’omutima gwange nga bwe kiba nti nze nzekka nnina okwegomba okwo kwonna okusinga okusanyusa era okwaka.

Naye, buli ekyo omutima ogutya Katonda kye guyinza okulowooza n’okwegomba, nkikuwa kyonna nga bwe kiri n’okussaamu ekitiibwa okusingirayo ddala n’okwagala okw’omunda. Saagala kwekuumira kintu na kimu, wabula okukuwa, n’omutima gumu era mu ddembe lyonna, nze nzennyini ne byonna bye nnina.

Ayi Mukama Katonda, Omutonzi wange era Omununuzi wange, njaayaanira okukutoola leero n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, n’okutendereza, n’okugulumiza, n’okwebaza, n’obusaanyizo n’okwagala, n’okukkiriza, n’essuubi n’obulongoofu nga bye bimu ebyo Nnyoko omutukuvu ennyo, Embeerera ey’ekitiibwa Maliyamu, bye yakwegombera nabyo era n’akutoola nabyo, bwe yaddamu malayika eyamubuulira ekyama ky’Okufuuka omuntu, n’obwetoowaze era ng’ayemalidde ku Katonda nti: “Nze ndi muweereza wa Mukama, kibe ku nze nga bw’ogambye.”

Era nga omukulembeze wo eyaweebwa omukisa, asinga abatukuvu obulungi, Yokaana Omubatiza, bwe yasanyusibwa olw’okubeerawo kwo, n’ajaguza mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu ng’akyali mu lubuto lwa nnyina, era oluvannyuma bwe yalaba Yesu ng’atambula mu bantu, ne yeetoowaza, n’ayogera n’okwagala okw’okwemalira ku Katonda nti: “Mukwano nnannyini mugole ayimirira ng’amuwulidde, era asanyukira nnyo eddoboozi ly’oyo awasizza,” bwe ntyo nange njaayaanira okukoleezebwa okwegomba okunene era okutukuvu n’okukwewaayo n’omutima gwange gwonna.

N’olwekyo nkuwa era nkwanjulira essanyu ly’emitima gyonna egyemalidde ku Katonda, okwagala kwabwe okwaka, okusamaalirira kw’ebirowoozo byabwe, okumulisibwa kwabwe okusukkulumye ku butonde n’okwolesebwa okw’omu ggulu, wamu n’empisa ennungi zonna n’ettendo lyonna ebyakolebwa oba ebirikolebwa ebitonde byonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi, ku lwange ne ku lw’abo bonna abanneesigamizza okubasabira, olyoke otenderezebwe era ogulumizibwe nga bw’osaanidde emirembe gyonna.

Kkiriza, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, ebisuubizo byange n’okwegomba kwange okukuwa ettendo eritaliiko kkomo n’okwebaza okutaggwaawo, ebikusaanira mu bwenkanya olw’obunene bw’obukulu bwo obutayogerekeka. Kino nkikuwa era njagala okukikuwanga buli lunaku na buli kaseera, era mu kusaba kwange okw’okwagala mpita era neegayirira emyoyo gyonna egy’omu ggulu n’abeesigwa bonna okwegatta nange okukutendereza n’okukwebaza.

Abantu bonna, amawanga n’ennimi zonna bakutendereze, era n’essanyu eringi ennyo n’okwemalira ku ggwe okwaka bagulumize erinnya lyo eddungi era ettukuvu. Era bonna abakuza Ssakramentu eno ekulu ennyo mu Missa nga bakussaamu ekitiibwa era nga beemalidde ku ggwe, ne bagitoola mu kukkiriza okujjuvu, basange ekisa n’okusaasira gy’oli, era bansabire n’obwetoowaze, nze omwonoonyi. Era bwe banaamala okufuna okwemalira ku Katonda kwe beegomba n’okugattibwa naawe okw’essanyu, ne bava ku mmeeza yo entukuvu ey’omu ggulu nga babudaabudiddwa bulungi era nga bazziddwamu amaanyi mu ngeri ey’ekitalo, basiime okujjukira emmeeme yange enaku.

fields.title: Omuntu Tasaanidde Kwekenneenya Ssakramentu Eno olw’Okwagala Okumanya, Wabula Okukoppa Kristo mu Bwetoowaze n’Okugonza Amagezi ge eri Okukkiriza Okutukuvu
fields.body_html:
Eddoboozi lya Kristo

WEEKUUME okwekenneenya okw’okwagala okumanya era okw’obutaliimu ku Ssakramentu eno ey’obuziba ennyo, bw’oba toyagala kusuulibwa mu buziba bw’okubuusabuusa. Oyo eyeekenneenya ennyo obukulu bwayo ajja kuzitoowererwa ekitiibwa kyayo.

Katonda ayinza okukola ebisinga ku muntu by’ayinza okutegeera. Okunoonya amazima mu kutya Katonda ne mu bwetoowaze ajja kukukkiriza, okunoonya okuba okwetegefu bulijjo okuyiga era okwagala okutambulira mu kuyigiriza okw’amagezi okwa bakitaffe.

Bwesimbu obwo bwa mukisa obuleka ekkubo ekizibu ery’empaka, ne bugenda mu maaso ku kkubo eggolokofu era ennywevu ery’ebiragiro bya Katonda. Bangi bafiiriddwa okwemalira ku Katonda kubanga baayagala okunoonyereza ebintu ebisukka ku busobozi bwabwe.

Ky’osabibwa kwe kukkiriza n’obulamu obw’amazima, si magezi ga waggulu wadde okusima mu byama bya Katonda. Bw’oba tomanyi era totegeera bintu ebiri wansi wo, oyinza otya okutegeera ebiri waggulu wo? Weewaayo eri Katonda era ogonze amagezi go eri okukkiriza, era ojja kuweebwa ekitangaala eky’okutegeera ku kigero ekikugasa era ekikwetaagisa. Abamu bakemebwa nnyo ku bikwata ku kukkiriza ne ku Ssakramentu, naye okutawaanyizibwa kuno tekubalibwa ku bo wabula ku mulabe.

Totawaanyizibwa, tolwana nakyo mu birowoozo byo, toddamu kubuusabuusa okuleetebwa Setaani, naye kkiriza ebigambo bya Katonda, kkiriza abatukuvu be ne bannabbi be, era omulabe omubi ajja kukuddukanga. Emirundi mingi kigasa nnyo omuweereza wa Katonda okubonaabona n’ebintu ng’ebyo. Kubanga Setaani takema batakkiriza n’aboonoonyi b’akutte dda bulungi, naye omuweereza omwesigwa amukema era amutawaanya mu ngeri nnyingi.

Kale nno, genda mu maaso n’okukkiriza okw’amazima era okutakankana, era semberera Ssakramentu eno ng’ogissaamu ekitiibwa mu bwetoowaze. Ky’otosobola kutegeera kyonna kikwase Katonda Omuyinzawaabyonna, atakulimba. Naye omuntu eyeesiga ye yennyini alimbibwa. Katonda atambula n’abantu ab’amazima, yeeyoleka eri abeetoowaze, amulisa amagezi g’ebirowoozo ebirongoofu, era akweka ekisa kye eri abaagala okumanya ebitabakwatako n’ab’amalala.

Amagezi g’omuntu manafu era gayinza okulimbibwa. Naye okukkiriza okw’amazima tekuyinza kulimbibwa. Amagezi gonna n’okumanya kw’obutonde bisaanidde okugoberera okukkiriza, si kukukulembera, wadde okukuwakanya. Kubanga mu Ssakramentu eno entukuvu ennyo era esinga obulungi, okukkiriza n’okwagala bye bikulembera era bikola mu ngeri ekwekeddwa.

Katonda, ataggwaawo, atategeerekeka, era ow’obuyinza obutakoma, akola ebikulu, ebitanoonyezeka, mu ggulu ne ku nsi, era tewali ayinza kunoonyereza ku bikolwa bye ebyewuunyisa. Singa ebikolwa bya Katonda byonna byali bya ngeri amagezi g’omuntu gy’ayinza okutegeera amangu, tebyandiyitiddwa byewuunyisa wadde ebisukka ku bigambo okubyogera.
